comments: Arama knew we were travelling with a baby and she went above and beyond to accomodate us.

We had a wonderful experience with Arama, who was incredibly warm, welcoming, and delightful to meet. She gave us a great tour of the apartment and provided fantastic recommendations that really enhanced our time in Barcelona! The apartment itself is a perfect size for two people and boasts an absolutely amazing location, making it an excellent base for exploring the city.The apartment is on the basic side with older furniture, but the incredible location and hospitality made up for it. There is some street and building noise as noted in other reviews, but we found it completely manageable. We really enjoyed our stay thanks to the perfect location and our lovely host, Arama!"

El departamento estuvo muy bien, muy cómodo y con buena ubicación!
La amabilidad de su dueña y toda su predisposición, destacan!
Lo recomendamos!!

Stayed for one night. Very communicative, responsive host. Everything matched description and fairly clean; however, dishes, pots, pans, and cups were stained, dusty, and had (food?) particles on them. The bed barely accommodates two adults - it will be very cramped. Additionally, air conditioner is quite audible, which may not suit sensitive sleepers. Fridge is quite large, which I appreciated. No outside noise.

Arama a été très accueillante et réactive tout au long de notre séjour.
L’appartement était plus qu’agréable et vraiment très confortable, nous avons passé un très bon séjour et le logement y a fortement participé. À proximité de plein de transports. La Clim a été un gros plus en plein mois d’août.
Nous reviendrons sans aucun doute.
Host was very friendly and accommodating, felt right at home, great place to stay whilst in Barcelona, highly recommend to anyone
Appartement super ! Climatisé surtout !!! Très propre et assez proche de la ville. Restaurants à proximité. Hôte très sympathique et très disponible :)) Nous recommandons

Fantastic location, easy walking distance from many locations, but still outside of the busy tourist areas.
Living space is exactly as advertised, clean, air conditioned, and quiet. Well stocked to meet your needs.
Arama, the host, is amazing, she made great food and attraction recommendations, and was extremely helpful.
Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy the city of Barcelona

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. It was very clean and well maintained, and the host was incredibly friendly, helpful, and easy to communicate with. The location was excellent, with a metro station just a short walk away and plenty of bus connections nearby, making it easy to get around. Having a store right next door was also very convenient. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable and well-located place to stay!

Il soggiorno è stato molto piacevole, la proprietaria ci ha accolti con molta gentilezza ed è stata davvero molto disponibile. Il quartiere è molto tranquillo e residenziale, e l’appartamento dispone di molti confort. Lo consiglio!

Excelente, Arama es muy amable y siempre estuvo atenta. El departamento estaba limpio y ordenado, además de cómodo. Todo práctico. Está muy cerca a la estación del metro. Conseguimos comprar víveres en una tiendita en frente donde consigues de todo.
En conclusión 100% recomendando 🙌

We had the best time in Barcelona. Arama's place was perfect for us. She is a wonderful person and gave us many suggestions.  The place is located next to everything and we fell in love with it and the city.

Arama a étais incroyable.
Elle a étais super gentille, répondais bien à nos questions.
Nous a donner de super adresse pour manger ou même pour allez au marché.
Pas fr difficulté pour récupéré les clé et pas loin du logement il y a des casier pour déposé nos bagages.
Je recommande !!!
Un grand merci à Arama encore

Arama was the best host! Her place fit the description perfectly, it was very clean and the location was great. She offered plenty of recommendations for things to do as well. I would highly advise this accomodation.

Arama ist eine liebe und zuvorkommende Gastgeberin. Sie erklärte uns zu Beginn die Wohnung sowie die Ausstattung und gab uns Tipps für die umliegenden Café‘s oder Ähnliches.
Sie war stets erreichbar und antwortete innerhalb kürzester Zeit.
Die Wohnung liegt zudem in einer guten Lage, sodass alles notwendige schnell erreichbar war

perfect space to explore Barcelona. Arama was a friendly and helpful host. Apartment was great. air conditioning was kept us nice and cool. really appreciated a washing machine. local area is great. opposite a cool Belgian beer shop. the mercat Sant Antoni nearby is a brilliant place to get delicious food and  really close the city centre as well. Would come back again.

Arama was proactive and kind, and very helpful even before we arrived: when we were coming, how to get in, what metro/bus to take, etc.
The flat is as just on the pictures - cosy, clean, perfect for two. The kitchen, the bathroom and the rooms are well equipped, there are two A/Cs, the wifi is fast.
The location is perfect: metro is just 2 minutes - you could reach literally everything in just ½ an hour. The district was friendly, perfect for long walks to breathe Barcelona in.
100% recommended.

Arama was warm and friendly and so very helpful. She met me at the house to check in and gave me tips to help with the metro and a place to get groceries (across the street). She made me feel so welcome and comfortable in her home. I would definitely love to stay here again.
Arama is a wonderful host that makes you feel at home since the beginning. The place is beautiful and comfortable. We would go back anytime.
Thank you very much fantastic communication and lovely place

Great place, this is my first time using Airbnb and would definitely use it again based on this stay!
Thank you Jordi!
公寓非常好！推荐预定！

Appartement agréable et idéalement placé à proximité des lignes de métro 3 et 5 permettant de découvrir la ville facilement. Hôte réactif et facilitant pour permettre de répondre à nos questions. Bonne adresse

Todo muy bueno. Excelente servicio
Muchas gracias
Recomendado

This was my first time in Barcelona and Jordi’s home was perfect. It had everything I needed, and communication was great throughout. The apartment was comfortable, well‑equipped, and although it was just two of us, it could easily sleep around six. The location is ideal — close to several metro lines and set in a beautiful neighborhood with a great community feel. When I’m back in Barcelona, this will definitely be one of my first options.
like it here
Het was in orde
Logement très propre et fonctionnel. La literie est très confortable. dans un quartier calme, proche de la gare. Bien situé pour visiter Barcelone! Je recommande ce logement !
Très bien !

The apartment is as pictured and in a great location, walking distance to the main train station and metro. It has three bedrooms, an elevator, and enough kitchenware, although we did not use the appliances. The cleaning lady, Yeni, who met us for check-in, was very kind and helpful.
Most communication was with the co-host Elena, not the listed host, Jordi. She was initially nice enough to apply a small discount since the stay was above our budget but in an ideal location. Unfortunately, communication later became unpleasant. I realized before the trip that I had accidentally booked an extra day and asked if any small credit or help toward city tax was possible, but she was not flexible.
The biggest issue was the city tax. Elena gave the total in euros but I was unaware it had to be in actual cash. After we struggled with ATMs and banks, she was rude over the phone, then finally sent the Airbnb payment link I had originally requested. We also only received one towel per guest.
Gastgeber waren immer erreichbar! Alles ziemlich sauber nur etwas kleineres Wohnzimmer als erwartet. Es hat sonst alles gut geklappt:)
Super séjour ! Appartement très propre, bien équipé et agréable à vivre. Literie confortable et emplacement parfait pour visiter Barcelone. Tout s’est très bien passé, je recommande vivement.

Lejligheden var en fin størrelse. Man kunne sagtens have været 5 voksne indkvarteret.
Selvom lejligheden er beliggende ud til stor vej oplevede vi ikke en voldsom larm. Sengene var også dejlige at Ligge i, så vi sov fint.
Lejligheden lå tæt på metro, men man kunne også fint gå omkring derfra. Det tog for eksempel kun cirka 25 min at gå til Spotify Camp Nou.
Lejligheden var ren, men køkkenets kopper og service skulle lige gøres ekstra rent inden brug.
Alt i alt var vi meget tilfredse med kommunikationen om bookingen og ind- og indkvartering. Blev kun lidt overraskede over den nye turistskat, som er forhøjet til 9,5 euro pr person pr dag, så det skal man huske at tillægge prisen generelt når man besøger Barcelona.
ras, logement confortable et pratique.

Ringrazio veramente Jordi e la sua compagna per averci ospitato nel loro appartamento.Appartamento al settimo piano con un piccolo ascensore datato per tutto il condomino forse l’unico difetto.L’appartamento dispone di tutti i servizi necessari con una bagno nuovo ristrutturato e un balcone con una vista sul quartiere che a me personalmente è piaciuta molto.L’appartamento dista 4 minuti dalla metro Entenca,ottimale per spostarsi.
Buena calidad y ubicación
We stay every year with this company at one of their properties and we are very happy
Perfect location and spacious apartment

We loved the place! It's conveniently located close to all the tourist attractions, quiet, and cozy. It's nothing fancy but has just the right amount of everything a humble traveller may need :) Special thanks to our host Elena for always being helpful and responsive!
Great stay and near the train for easy access to public transportation!

Jessica a été de très bons conseils et très réactive.
L’appartement était conforme à la description et la terrasse est un véritable plus !!!
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Je recommande sans hésiter cette hôte.

Bonjour,
L’appartement de Jessica est bien placé dans le quartier Gracia à 10 min à pied d’une station de métro. L’emplacement de parking est très pratique large et haut permettant le passage d’un coffre de toit. Jessica est très réactive et efficace. Très bonne localisation pour visiter Barcelone.
Responsive and friendly host. Nice covered terrace. Acceptable distance to public transport
Au top je recommande jessica est très gentille je reviendrai sûrement merci pour tout
Super Kommunikation, sehr hilfsbereit, alles problemlos. Die Wohnung war zu fünft nicht über die Maßen groß, aber sehr sauber.
Très bon séjour

Un apartamento perfecto, una comunicación con el centro perfecta, y que decir de la anfitriona, un 10, antenta en todo momento.
100% recomendable.
En cuanto volvamos a Barcelona si no está reservado de seguro que volvemos a quedarnos en este maravilloso sitio

Le logement de Jessica est conforme à l'annonce. Il est propre et la terrasse est très agréable ! Il est dans un immeuble très calme. De plus, il y a plusieurs arrêts de bus juste à côté de l'appartement,  parfaits pour rentrer le soir.

Jessica estuvo pendiente de nosotros, contestaba rápido y nos ayudó en lo que podía
El apartamento estaba limpio y bien situado

Jessica est un hôte réactive et très professionnelle. Le logement est parfait pour découvrir la ville. Je recommande le parking car le stationnement dans le quartier est compliqué. L'appartement est agréable et propre. La terrasse et son barbecue sont un vrai plus.
A casa estava de acordo com todas as fotos apresentadas. Tudo limpo e bem organizado. Anfitriã sempre disponível durante toda a estadia e muito simpática. Recomendo sem dúvida!

logement bien situé, à proximité des transports en commun qui rendent les attractions principales de Barcelone très proches. jessica a été très disponible et nous a transmis les bonnes informations pour arriver sans encombre au logement même pendant la soirée
Muy bien

El alojamiento muy limpio, zona comunicada por un paseo a la zona de la Sagrada Familia, lo único la vuelta hay que subir una cuesta bastante larga.
En cuanto a Jessica la comunicación siempre rápida y atenta.
Lo recomendamos!

Excellent logement dans l’ensemble, il y avait tout ce qu’il fallait à l’intérieur et Jessica était très rapide si une question était posé. Cependant on aurait pensé que la localisation serait plus proche du centre et plus facile a accéder mais dans l’ensemble c’était un super séjour et nous la remercions. Je conseille.

Logement conforme à la description.
Très bien équipé, très bonne literie.
Bonne situation pour se rendre dans Barcelone par les transports.
De très bons échanges avec Jessica.
Nous avons fait une entrée autonome avec toutes les instructions transmises.
La terrasse avec le barbecue est un vrai plus, même le 1er janvier avec un beau soleil 😅
Autour de l’appartement il y a beaucoup de petites épiceries, il est facile de faire quelques courses.
Une bonne adresse pour le quartier, le bar-restaurant Las Delicias.
À noter que le logement se trouve en haut d’une rue en côte, l’arrivée par le métro n’est pas à privilégier avec des valises. De l’aéroport, il vaut mieux prendre le bus vers le centre de Barcelone puis récupérer la ligne 24 qui amène tout près de l’appartement.
Bref, nous recommandons vivement cette adresse, que nous gardons également précieusement 🤩😊
L’appartement est vraiment conforme au photo et tout est exceptionnellement bien
Logement très agréable avec une vue magnifique. Jessica est une personne formidable vraiment à l'écoute.

It’s a comfortable accomodation, and since the weather was unfriendly, we have spent quite some time indoor. The view is nice, the park is very close, which is helpful for dog walking. We had a good time!

Bonito apartamento con una terraza increíble y una buena barbacoa para estar con los amigos fuera, incluso en invierno. Hay calefacción en todas las esquinas. Sábanas limpias y suficientes toallas. El lugar es agradable con el Metro a 8 minutos a pie y las líneas de autobuses justo con parada cerca del alojamiento.

Wij werden met een warm welkom ontvangen in dit verblijf. Gelegen in een rustige week met alle voorzieningen in de buurt, is dit de perfecte uitvalbasis voor een bezoek aan deze stad. De woning was zeer schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien, het heeft ons aan niet ontbroken. Ook de ruimtelijkheid en de gezellige binnentuin was welkom en wij hebben daar prima ontbeten. Ik kan de Casa Del Mandarino aan iedereen die Barcelona voor vakantie of werk wil bezoeken van harte aanbevelen
Trevlig och flexibel utcheckning. Fick vara där ostört.
Great stay, had everything we needed and more. Such a comfy home and the kitchen was very well equipped. Would love to stay again.

The house is perfect – big and very cosy. I brought my parents with me and we had more that enough space for all of us. Also, location is very nice, because its not as busy as the center, but it's very easy to get to the certer via metro. Finaly, the owner is very sweet and helpful. She was very quick and helpful whenever we needed anything. 👌
Es war gut und so wie wir uns es vorgestellt haben
Top séjour

Had a great stay and would absolutely stay here again in the future. The place was great - it was clean and many of the essentials were provided. The host is very responsive and doesn’t hesitate to answer any questions you might have. It is also very close to multiple options for public transportation, such as buses and metro. There are also various nearby stores that are open late if you ever needed anything. Overall, very satisfied with my stay.

L’emplacement est très tranquille tout en étant à 30 mètres du métro. La Clim nous a sauvé des grosses chaleurs et le petites terrasses sont bien agréables.
Le logement était très propre et parfaitement équipé et plein de petites attentions : une bouteille de vin pour accueil, sel, huile, vinaigre, café, produits d’hygiène, etc. Tout est vraiment fonctionnel !
L’hôte est hyper réactif aux messages.
Je recommande !!
Thank you!

I’m so glad we stayed here. The neighborhood is a gem: close to so much but also in a more quiet and family neighborhood. Exceptional food recommendations from our host. Honestly the building / home is better than the pictures. Would absolutely stay again!
Spacious home with nice outdoor areas! Host was very kind and responsive!

We had a lovely stay here during our trip to Barcelona, the house was perfect for our group of four people. Extremely close to the metro, air conditioning in both bedrooms, very well equipped kitchen where we could actually cook. Only about 15 mins to the centre when taking the metro. The host met us at check in, she was very friendly!
The back patio was wonderful to have breakfast and the mandarin tree made it all the better. There was also beach matts and towels that we ended up using a couple of times. I would recommend this place to anyone!

Everything was great - the atmosphere and patios are amazing, the surrounding neighborhood is very nice and not touristy, and the convenience to the metro makes it easy to get wherever you want. Also, it’s very close to El Parc del Guinardó with amazing views of the city for free

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour à Barcelone. Le logement proposé par Sylvia était adorable et confortable. L'accueil fût chaleureux et convivial. l'appartement est plutôt bien placé sur les lignes de métro. Je recommande vivement !
Good place to stay at and at a reasonable price. Restaurants and bars and in walking distance. Then a taxi to downtown was short ride and not very expensive. The owner was very sweet and respectful.
C’était parfait !!!
logement fidèle à la description, propre, fonctionnel, à 3min à pied du métro. Hôte disponible et clair pour l'arrivée.
Lovely place with an excellent location on the city, I would definitely come back!

la casa è molto accogliente, super servita dai mezzi pubblici (2 metro e autobus a volontà) ben arredata e confortevole. Per nulla rumorosa e con tante attenzioni da parte dell'host.
Una dimenticanza non troppo importante: il frigo non era stato svuotato e vi erano alimenti degli ospiti precedenti. Unico aspetto che non c'è proprio piaciuto è che il sistema d'allarme ha le telecamere poste in casa e non sappiamo come siano usate, questo vieta totalmente la privacy. Quando ci siamo accorti abbiamo tirato giù il coperchio per impedire la visuale ma avremmo gradito non averle proprio o essere avvisate preventivamente. Ci sono diversi sistemi d'allarme, le telecamere non dovrebbero essere presenti in case che vengono affittate.
Appartamento ampio su due piani, fornito di tutto il necessario e proprietario molto preciso e gentile. Lo consiglio sicuramente:)

Godt renhold og høy standard, vennlige og villige til å innfri gjestenes ønsker.  Fin rooftop, men synd det ikke er stoler/solsenger der. Bare parkett/treverk man sitter på. OG bassenget er 3meter  og 1m dypt.

The best feature for this property is its location in Poblenou. The flat is of walkable distance to the beach and sea promenade, food shops (Aldi / Mercat del Poblenou 5min walk) and cafes and restaurants at Rambla del Poblenou. Very well connected to metro via Poblenou and Llacuna stations, or bus H16 straight in front of the building to take you to the centre. We booked 2 brd flat, which matched the description with spacious living room, kitchen and 2 bathrooms. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, and helpful when asked for assistance so overall impressions were good.
It was a really nice area, and the apartment was clean and well-maintained. The staff were very helpful and answered all of our questions. Overall, it was a pleasant experience.

Make sure to arrive at the apartment before 7pm.  Because of baggage claim workers strike,  we waited for our luggage for 4 hours.  We then had some difficulty reaching the person after 10:30 pm to give us the Keys.  Other than that, everything else was great.
Amazing location, clear instructions, superfast support staff response

We chose this place because my daughter was attending a seminar at the university, and the university was only 15–20 minutes away by bus. The bus stop is also very close to the property, which was a big advantage for us.
We received a very warm and friendly welcome. The location is really good. It is close to the beach and right next to Poblenou. There is a bus stop in front of the property and a metro station nearby. Getting around Barcelona is very easy by both bus and metro. Also, while walking around the city, you can really feel the Mediterranean culture and the warm and friendly nature of Spanish people.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Compared with hotel prices in Barcelona, you can get much better value and quality here for a much lower price.
We were very happy with the location, cleanliness, easy transportation, and value for money.
Es la segunda vez que nos hospedamos! Todo perfecto!
Apartment wie beschrieben. Ich könnte sogar früher ins Apartment. Sauber, sehr gutes Bett. Ruhig. Gerne wieder. Toll dass man Gepäck aufbewahren kann.

Preisleistung passt nicht.
Alles in Ordnung, aber für den Preis hätten wir definitiv mehr erwartet.
Ausstattung etwas in die Jahre gekommen.
Keine Liegen am Pool.
Küche teils dreckig.

I have nothing to say but good things about this place. It was exactly what they described it to be. It’s near the beautiful beach so that you can walk over in the morning or see the sunrise. It’s a bit far from the tourist sites like sagrada famila  but there’s nothing that renting out an uber bike and seeing under 20 minutes. so yeah overall amazing place and I highly recommend this to friend and family.
Best location! Best appartment! Best people! Barcelona and Lugaris has our heart. Highly recommend! We can't wait to come back!
It was a good stay, worth the money in general
Fantastic location right across the road from the beach next to great cafes. Relaxed vibe. Apartment was clean, spacious, cool! and the staff were great and super helpful
Отдыхали с семьей нам все очень понравилось, море близко квартира чистая в ней все необходимое есть . Мы остались очень довольны .
Great stay! Perfect for the beach. Excellent service from the Lugaris team.
Ruhige Lage, Strandnähe, Mitarbeiter sehr gut zu erreichen
I l

Our stay at the Lugaris was amazing, even that we came after 7pm we was welcomed with big smile, very kind man. About apartment, everything was cleaned, big  comfy bed and amazing view on Sagrada Família. Everything was perfect and cherry on the top of the cake was pool that was very good choice after a long day. Thanks for your kindness and making our holiday without any issues.

Appartement spacieux, parfait pour les groupes. La piscine en rooftop est un vrai plus.
La plage est à proximité, idéal quand on rentre de visite. Le quartier est sympa et le métro est accessible en 10min à pied.

We hebben heerlijk genoten van dit appartement. Voor ons lag het op een perfecte locatie, wat buiten het centrum maar alsnog veel te doen en heerlijke restaurants en koffie tentjes.
Personeel van Lugaris waren ook super vriendelijk en behulpzaam.
We komen zeker terug.

Abbiamo trascorso due giorni a Barcellona, soprattutto per ammirare la Sagrada Familia. L'alloggio, situato in posizione tranquilla, poco distante dalle stazioni della metropolitana, era ampio e dotato delle camere come da descrizione. Era dotato di aria condizionata, indispensabile per il clima esterno. Adatto a famiglie numerose, dati i numerosi posti letto. Dotato di due posti auto, utili per chi arriva con mezzi propri.

This penthouse was in a nice, quiet neighborhood, away from all the crazy hustle and bustle of the city. It's a beautiful 3-level place, with the bottom 2 levels for living space and a huge rooftop terrace with a view of the city, including the Sagrada Familia!
Each room has a terrace or balcony for fresh air. The AC was refreshing, as we were there during the hottest month--August.
We had all the appliances, dishes, pots, and pans we needed. There's a jacuzzi tub that for relaxing my sore feet after a long day of walking.
We had a large group with 2 adult couples, two teenagers, and two school-aged kids sans everyone had plenty of space and privacy.
Angela could not have been a better host. We were early, so she let us store our bags there until check-in. There were many pamphlets things to do in Barcelona. She was very responsive whenever I had questions about what to do locally.
My only regret is that I each not able to meet her and thank her in person! We'd love to come

Hôte très réactif et aidant pour des recommandations aux alentours.
Appartement spacieux et conforme aux photos ! Proche du métro et de diverses commerces. La qualité et la propreté des draps est irréprochable, par contre les siphons des douches/éviers mériteraient d’être nettoyer car mauvais écoulement .
Point négatif : nous avons dérangé le voisinage alors que nous mangions sur la terrasse en discutant ( on nous a demandé de nous taire ), pas d’éclairage sur la grande terrasse ni de chaise pour le nombre de voyageur, distance du centre ville à prendre en compte , taxe de séjour non comprises dans le prix du logement
Would recommend to anyone!!
Appartamento molto bello splendidi terrazzi e molto spazioso

Foi tudo perfeito, nossa família ficou super bem acomodada e com conforto, época de muito calor e o apartamento tinha todos os recursos (ar condicionado) e outros utensílios para uma ótima estadia.
Super recomendo a acomodação da Ângela, ela foi muito prestativa com as informações e ficamos muito felizes com a nossa passagem por Barcelona!
Angela est à l’écoute et très gentille. Je vous recommande fortement.

We had a fantastic stay, this place exceeded our expectation. Large space to accommodate our group of 8, location close to metro and central, yet quiet.
Angela was very responsive to questions we had before arrival, we'd definitely stay again.

What a great quiet spot in Barcelona. Our family really enjoyed it. Great shopping, restaurants and taxi services.
Very spacious and would recommend.
Thanks Angela.
超出想象的好，在上海 7 个小伙伴能住一起的压根没有这么舒畅的房子
Clean, great place to stay with family. Good location, easy access. Lots of space, comfy, good host.
Casa espaciosa, muy buena ubicación, excelente comunicación con la anfitriona.

We absolutely loved our stay in Barcelona. The apartment’s location made it easy to walk to groceries, restaurants, the metro, Park Guell, and the city center.
The building was so quiet, the apartment was spacious and gorgeous. So many unique touches. The rooftop terrace was a dream. It absolutely exceeded our expectations, and we consider ourselves fortunate to have stayed there. Thank you!

Le logement correspond parfaitement à la description, il est très bien. situé et tout est accessible à pied ou en transport en commun. Les espaces intérieurs et extérieurs sont parfaits, le rooftop est une vraie pépite !
Attention toutefois au bruit le soir car les discutions sur le rooftop peuvent déranger les voisins qui ralaient très facilement
Je recommande le logement d'Angela pour vos vacances à Barcelone
buona
Excellent stay.  Listing is just like the pictures.  There are plenty of restaurants and groceries stores walking distance.  Host's instructions were very clear.
The place is beautiful.  Lots of  outdoor spaces to relax.  We had 10 people and had a bed for everyone. Angela was quick to respond and very friendly.  I would highly recommend this place.

Superbe appartement.
Conforme à la description.
Bien placé; idéal pour une découverte de Barcelone entre amis.
Je recommande vivement.

The house was very spacious, beds were comfortable, and it was well furnished.  Communication was great.  Quiet location but need to walk down to the Main Street to get a taxi.  Would definitely recommend it for a group.  We were a family of 4 adults and 4 children and it was perfect.

Nous avons loué le logement d'Angela sur le week-end avec une dizaine d'amis à l'occasion d'un enterrement de vie de jeune fille à Barcelone. Le logement était incroyable, très grand et bien équipé. Nous n'avons manqué de rien ! Mention spéciale au jacuzzi, très apprécié après une grosse promenade sous un soleil de plomb, et à la jolie terrasse sur le toit qui donne une vue imprenable sur la ville. Il y a de nombreux commerces aux alentours, et des transports à 5 min à pied, notamment le métro pour aller dans le centre-ville. Attention toutefois, tolérance zéro sur les fêtes et le bruit - et cela se comprend, le quartier est extrêmement calme, rien que le fait de manger sur la terrasse dehors en papotant un peu s'entend depuis la rue. Cela ne nous a pas posé problème car nous avons passé presque tout notre week-end à l'extérieur et n'étions pas un groupe de fêtards. Merci encore pour les instructions claires, nous n'oublierons pas ce chouette week-end dans ce bel appartement :)

Miguel was an amazing host, very friendly, helpful, and welcoming. The apartment was comfortable and the rooftop was absolutely amazing, especially for relaxing and enjoying the views. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Barcelona!

The hot water in the bathroom also came through quite slowly, and although the weather was warm, it wasn’t always warm enough for comfortably bathing our child.
One thing to note is the Barcelona tourist tax, which was €9.50 per person per night. This is set by the local authorities and is not something the Airbnb host has any control over, but it’s worth keeping in mind when budgeting for your stay.

Das Badezimmer war teilweise schmutzig und verschimmelt. WC und Badezimmer konnten außerdem nicht abgesperrt werden. Die Ausstattung ist sehr einfach, alt und stark benutzt. Wasserkocher und Kaffeemaschine fehlen, das Bügeleisen funktioniert nicht richtig und der Backofen funktionierte bei uns ebenfalls nicht. Auch die beigen Möbel im Wohnzimmer entsprechen nicht den Fotos. Insgesamt haben wir uns leider nicht besonders wohlgefühlt. Für den Preis ist die Wohnung unserer Meinung nach deutlich zu teuer. Für etwas mehr Geld würden wir beim nächsten Mal eine modernere und besser ausgestattete Unterkunft wählen.

L'alloggio è carino, pulito e in una posizione ottima proprio davanti all'ingresso della metropolitana. I bagni sono però troppo piccoli e lo scarico funziona male. Roger è molto disponibile e gentile
Bel appart proche de toutes commodités. Roger est très gentil. Nous avons passé un super séjour en famille.
Defect spot and host was great

Bon emplacement, avec accès rapide aux transports mais un quartier peu agréable, faire attention.
Appartement Minimaliste mais pour seulement y passer la nuit c’est parfait.
Muy buena comunicación y recomendaciones locales, sin dudas recomiendo hospedarse en su alojamiento.

Roger was a very nice host, we got the keys from the nice cleaning lady right upon arrival and Roger gave us a call to give further details on the area and the apartment. The apartment was spacious and according to the description except it felt more worn down than expected. The large bathroom shower did not work upon arrival, we contacted Roger about this and were instructed to use a plunger, we did not manage to resolve the issue. Toilet paper was not allowed in the toilet which was less convenient when staying 6 people for a long weekend. There was fully functioning AC in the living room and master bedroom. Overall area was perfect and the view from the balcony was amazing!
I would recommend this apartment for someone who spends most time out and looking for a price friendly stay.
Have in mind for your budget that the host will ask for 9 EUR/night/person to be left in cash for the tourist tax. For us this was 162 EUR, so quite substantial amount which i did not get receipt for.

Thank you for making our family trip feels like home. Extremely easy to get to from the airport and its right in front of the metro and bus. We were able to get around the city super fast and convenient. Lovely host and cleaning lady.
Piso inmejorable,limpio tal y como se describe . Roger un excelente anfitrión ,muy atento y explicativo en todo momento. Repetiremos sin duda alguna.

Hôte très réactif, répond très rapidement aux messages. Nous pouvions arriver à l’heure que nous pouvions selon le trajet de Paris. Logement très propre, beau, climatisé et ventilateur au besoin. Tout était très bien

Lindo departsmento.
Bien amplio y cómodo
super Lage, sehr gute Preis Leistung

Muy buena ubicación, muchos restaurantes o comercio cerca, muy central.
Podría tener aire en todas las habitaciones y fáciles de manejar.

Nous avons passés un super séjour chez Roger. Très facile d’accès. Le métro est en bas de l’immeuble.
L’appartement est climatisé, et la literie est très bien. Je recommande ce logement
Very well located and comfortable place to stay.
Roger molto disponibile e preciso. Siamo molto soddisfatti!
Roger siempre estuvo atento a nuestras necesidades.

We had a wonderful stay, the house is spacious with high ceilings, artistic and feels like its part of a palace. Its like a house representing Catalan renaissance. Also it’s in a perfect location with great access to the city. And I must mention we loved our hosts Juan and his wife, they were very fun, friendly and hospitable; we felt lucky and grateful to meet them.
环境非常好，主人也非常的友好。
A uniquely beautiful and large home. The owners were incredibly kind and shared about its history and architecture. Recommend for anyone desiring a special stay in Barcelona!

We had such an amazing stay! The place was beautiful and exactly as described, with so much to do in the area. The metro is literally right on the doorstep, which made getting around so easy and convenient. We were given such an in-depth tour when we arrived, which I found really unique and lovely. We had no issues at all, and all of the hosts were incredibly kind, welcoming and helpful. They were always accommodating and ready to help if we needed anything, while still giving us complete privacy. We genuinely feel like we’ve made friends with them! My friend and I had such a lovely time and would definitely come back again.

This was, without question, the most extraordinary Airbnb we’ve ever stayed in. Casa Ramos is breathtaking—more like staying in a beautifully preserved work of art than an apartment. Every room reveals another incredible architectural detail, and the thoughtful blend of historic Modernista architecture with contemporary art makes the entire space feel magical. We also learned it has been featured in numerous films, including one by Almodóvar, which made perfect sense once we experienced it.
Just as memorable were our hosts. Juan, Frances, and Sean made us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we arrived. Although they live in a separate wing of the building, we had complete privacy while also enjoying their warmth and generosity. Juan proudly shared parts of their own home, and our son was thrilled when he invited him to play the piano.
We’ve stayed in many exceptional places, but this is one we’ll remember forever. If you have the opportunity to stay here, don’t hesitate.

Thank you Sean and Juan for the most wonderful stay at your beautiful
Apartment with my family. Everything exceeded our expectations - the apartment itself is stunning. The area is a perfect location and both Sean and Juan were always available to answer our questions and were very helpful and kind to us. A holiday to remember and we all hope we can return! Mu has Gracias 🙏☀️😊

Thank you so much for hosting me! Your lovely apartment made my trip to Barcelona absolutely wonderful.
I hope to come back and stay here again sometime！
这是我们住过的最美好的地方～ 非常喜欢房子的设计和搭配风格，每一个角落都让人感到无比时髦～ 房东Sean和他的太太也十分热情，会给我们介绍攻略，会主动和我们分享一些有趣的故事，Sean是我们在旅行中遇到的最好的朋友，如果可以的话真想一直住下去～这是一次值得牢记的体验，我想我们下次还会再来！

The best Airbnb of our lives - and we don’t say that lightly.
Sean’s apartment is simply extraordinary: a stunning home in a truly unique building, with fantastic interiors where every detail has been chosen with taste. Photos are beautiful, but the reality is even better - we kept walking around the first evening just admiring it.
The location in Gràcia is perfect: Park Güell within walking distance, wonderful restaurants around the corner, and the real, living Barcelona right outside the door.
And the hosts Juan and Sean are kind, warm, funny, endlessly responsive. They made us feel not like guests, but like friends who were being welcomed home.
We are infinitely grateful and left completely happy. If you’re coming to Barcelona - stay here. There is no better place.
Thank you, Sean and Juan! We’ll be back ❤️

Sean and Juan Enrique were wonderful hosts! The apartment is in an amazing, historical building and Juan was kind enough to tell us all about its history. The location is very good with the metro outside or it is a short walk to Passeig de Gracia with all of the fancy shops, restaurants and Gaudi buildings. We particularly loved the indoor balcony space in the house. The house was perfect for our weekend of sightseeing and exploring Barcelona. Muchas, muchas gracias to Sean and Juan!
Juan is very friendly and outgoing, always responsive and explains everything in detail, the place is also really beautiful
非常棒的居住体验，无论是住宿环境、地理位置。Sean一家非常热情，给我们介绍了很多当地的景点、美食。

The place has a historic charm and a special atmosphere that can be a highlight and a drawback depending on expectations. Overall, everything was functional and we had what we needed for our stay. Cleanliness was acceptable but not exceptional. Given the price level and positioning as a more luxurious apartment, the equipment and amenities could be significantly improved.
The garden was under construction and therefore not usable, although this was communicated and handled with the host. Privacy is somewhat limited, as the space cannot be fully closed off and the hosts live directly across with their door often open, which may not suit everyone.
The hosts were very friendly, responsive, and always available when needed. The location is excellent, with many great restaurants, bars, and shops nearby, making it very convenient to explore Barcelona. Overall, a characterful stay with great hosts and location, but with some compromises in privacy, amenities, and cleanliness for the price.

what an experience. Juan, Francis and Sean are wonderful people and made us feel very welcome indeed
our sons were encouraged to play the grand piano in their private apartment just across from us. They made us feel like part of the family. Juan and Sean gave us so much information about the history of the building and were so interesting. If you want a very special vacation we couldn't recommend more highly. Thank you so much for allowing us to share this beautiful place.
Excelente locación, muy lindo todo y la hospitalidad es increíble

Amazing hosts and a prize find for fans of architectural and vintage/historical design elements.
I would absolutely love to return and the hosts appreciation and love for the building, unit and city are the best I have experienced.

This extraordinary apartment is far more than just a place to stay — it is a true masterpiece of Modernist architecture, filled with history, art, warmth, and soul. The apartment, breathtakingly elegant, and incredibly tasteful, beautifully curated by architect Juan and artist Frances, and wonderfully managed by their son Sean.
What made our stay even more special was discovering that Pedro Almodóvar’s Oscar-winning film “All About My Mother” (“Todo sobre mi madre”) was filmed there. Many other famous artists and creatives have also stayed in this remarkable place, and you can truly feel its unique artistic spirit everywhere.
Juan, Frances and Sean are welcoming hosts we have ever met. They even kindly showed us their private part, which made us feel immediately at home and part of something very special.
This apartment is a rare jewel for lovers of beauty, culture, architecture, an unforgettable experience in every possible way, highest recommendation! We would return anytime!

This flat is a true gem! Extremely beautiful and well preserved, with historical decos from the past. The host Juan and Francesca have great taste - they are artist and architect, making every corner of the flat like a painting.
The flat is conveniently located near the city center, so you can walk on foot to Park Guell.
Juan has been very helpful, not only giving us a complete tour of the flat, but also offering help and being very responsive and welcoming.
This is a must-have experience in Barcelona! Only that you should book in advance as it is super popular!

Forget about Gaudi.
This place is the only reason I come back visit Barcelona. Absolutely amazing. Had I not travelled with my friend I would have spent one entire day taking photographs of this apartment.
Amazing host lol.
We absolutely loved our stay :) Flat is absolutely incredible, the host is amazing. Our best trip to Barcelona :)
Phil and Fiona were very accommodating. Flat had multiple rooms with AC that helped with the heat! Enjoyed the location!

Great place really enjoyed our stay at the place. Easy to get to and gain entry to the property and access also the Metro was a 5 minute walk. Place itself was as advertised, clean and had everything we needed. Kitchen was compact but had everything we needed and more. Bedrooms were great and a good size and the air-conditioning was good enough for us.
The amenities were great and I would look to book here again if I return to Barcelona. Communication was great and there was always someone that would respond.
Es war alles super, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und konnten den Aufenthalt in Barcelona genießen! Besten Dank

Phil and Fiona’s apartment was fantastic. They were very responsive and communicative throughout our stay. The apartment is also located very well, close to the metro and within walking distance to many different places. Would definitely stay again!

숙소는 너무 편안하고 무더운 여름이었음에도 시원하게 지낼수 있었습니다. 숙소 청결도 및 정리정돈이 매우 잘되어 있었습니다. 가까운 거리에 지하철역이 있어서 이동이 편리했습니다.
호스트는 궁금한사항에 대해서 답변이 빠르고 적절했습니다. 각종 편의 시설등이 잘 구비되어 있었습니다.(식기류, 세탁기, 식기세척기,낸장고, 전자레인지, 커피머신, 각종 양념류 등등) 그리고 체크아웃 후 짐을 보관해 주셔서 너무너무 감사했습니다^^.
단점은 세면대와 욕조의 물 배수가 잘되지 않았습니다.(하지만 호스트에게 알린 후 바로 수정조치되었습니다) 3층 계단이 좁아 큰짐을 옮기기에 조금 힘들었습니다. 다음에도 꼭 방문의사가 있습니다~~.
Loved our stay in this beautiful apartment, hosts were very accommodating and responsive. Thanks for having us!

地理位置挺好的，离圣家堂步行也只需要20分钟。 离地铁站也很近，附近也有超市和餐厅。
有空调地方也大，基础设施都充足。

We felt right at home, although outside was very hot, inside was fresh. There is a lot of natural light and the details like the tiled floors and windows are characteristic of the architecture of this beautiful city.

Vi hyrde Phil och Fionas lägenhet, och blev jätte nöjda. Otroligt fin lägenhet som hade allt man kan önska sig. Otroligt rent, sköna sängar och tre stora sovrum.
Bra läge, på en lugnare gata. Vi hade gärna stannat längre. Får bli nästa gång helt enkelt! Tack så mycket.
A wonderful place with an incredible interior. It has everything you need for a comfortable stay.

My family and I had a great time at Phil and Fiona’s. The place was charming, clean and felt very homey. The host met us on our check-in day to ensure everything was perfect. We had no issues from start to finish. All instructions were very clear. The best part for us was the location! There are many restaurants, bars and shops within walking distance, however our street never felt loud or crowded. Overall, a great place to stay!

Great property in a great neighborhood that was walkable to cafes/restaurants/metro train. It felt like a truly local (less touristy) experience, which was welcomed. The hosts were friendly and responsive to all questions - definitely recommend!

Nous étions 5 et nous avons passé un très bon séjour, l’appartement est très agréable, lumineux et bien décoré. La literie est confortable et la climatisation est un plus.
Le quartier est vraiment super, plutôt calme, et à 15 min à pied de la Sagrada Familia.

A wonderful, authentic apartment in the heart of Barcelona. We were able to walk to pretty much everything we wanted to see, and the atmosphere of the immediate neighborhood was safe and comfortable. Phil and Fiona were responsive to the handful of questions that we had, and we felt that the stay was well worth what we paid. We would definitely stay there again given the choice!

la zona è tranquilla, appartamento pulito e funzionale, abbiamo avuto un problema con la doccia ma è stato risolto e ci hanno anche omaggiato di un bouquet floreale, non c'è ascensore e ci sono 3 rampe di scale ma è specificato nell'annuncio e un po' di attività fisica non fa male, stanze ampie e tre letti matrimoniali comodi con lenzuola pulire, cucina ben fornita e ampio soggiorno e tanti balconi, zona centrale e comoda con fermata bus e diversi bar e supermercati , lo consiglio
Bel appartement, tres bien placé. Nous sommes tres contents de notre sejour et recomandons sans reserve ce logement.
Des hôtes très réactifs avec qui j'ai pu échanger avant mon arrivée et qui lors de l'arrivée ont été flexibles et serviable. Bel appartement agréable ou nous avons séjourné à 6 sans aucun problème.

Good location for exploring Barcelona, close to public transport. It's fairly quiet despite being so central. The flat was very spacious and had a well equipped kitchen, easy to prepare breakfast or cook although there are plenty of restorants nearby. Sagrada Familia is about a 20 min walk away.
We liked that the flat is in an old building, full of character. We didn't use the aircon, but one of the bedrooms had it. We enjoyed our 4 nights stay there.

Beautiful apartment in a beautiful neighborhood.  So happy we did not stay in one of the many touristy neighborhoods nearby. Quaint restaurants, bakeries, and grocery stores are all within walking distance. Beware there are 57 steps you have to reached to get to the apartment since there is no elevator. This helped us burn off all of our calories, but was challenging for my older mother. The apartment is beautifully decorated and full of light.  The neighborhood is full of families and felt very safe. Highly recommended if you want to feel close to the everyday culture Barcelona rather than the tourist vibes of many other neighborhoods.

We had a lovely stay at Phil and Fiona's apartment as a family of 5 with 3 young kids.
The apartment had everything we needed, and the hosts were super proactive with useful info and quick to respond to any questions.
​The rooms were spacious, bright, with comfortable beds and cool decor. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything we needed.
The location is convenient, with the Joanic metro just around the corner, making it easy to get around the city. Park Güell is a brisk 20 minute walk away too.
The neighborhood felt very relaxed, and we found plenty of great cafes, restaurants, and supermarkets nearby.
Highly recommend!
Alojamiento muy espacioso y por sobre todo con buena ubicación y el Anfitrión estuvo atento y me ayudó con las llaves !!

One of the best professional apartments I’ve been in BCN. Easy access, trendy comfy deco, Sarah’s been a FUNtastic host and I definitely recommend. I’ll get back thanks much for everything dear Sarah&team
Really nice apartment. Good for a stay in Barcelona :)
Gracias Sarah! Muy atenta con todo, siempre dispuesta a ayudar y a que la experiencia, tanto en el espacio como en Barcelona sea especial y agradable!

Great stay, lovely apartment. Had all the amenities you needed like coffee grounds and coffee maker, salt/pepper etc which really makes the difference. Really felt at home! Also great that it had a smart TV.
It was close to the metro, so really easy to get around. The local area itself was nice - recommend El Tap for the best patatas bravas!
Super endroit ! Bien situé ! Séjour agréable.

Sarah’s place was truly perfect for a stay in Barcelona! It’s so big and perfectly cool during the hot summer days. Incredibly conveniently placed, not to far from the airport and walkable to the train station. With a gelato place on the same corner, which we went to everyday of our stay. If you’re thinking about staying here, do it!!
Our second stay and would highly recommend for a beautiful area of Barcelona with great connections and food on the doorstep.
Logement bien situé

Such a nice an modern apartment in a less touristy part of Barcelona. Stick easy reachable to all the important sights. Great restaurant nearby as well. sarah was very helpful when we needed her and always friendly. muchas gracias
Beautiful apartment in a great location, well connected but also lots of beautiful places in the area and lots of places to eat. Very responsive host. Highly recommend.

Sarah‘s place was very clean and comfortable. It was less than a block to the subway which made things really easy to get around. It was clean and comfortable after a day of exploring the city. I would highly recommend and would definitely stay there again.

Logement très grand et spacieux avec deux lits. La cuisine est très fonctionnelle ! La bouche de métro est à la sortie de l’appartement c’est très pratique. Cependant, la rue est assez bruyante jusqu’assez tard et le logement est assez mal isolé… le matelas est mou : attention si vous avez mal au dos ! Malgré cela, c’est un bel appartement !

We only needed a place to sleep for one night before taking the train early next morning, and the apartment was perfect for that. The tiny room with the second bed did not offer a lot of privacy as it only has a curtain to close the door and also a window to the main room, but we knew that from the listing and it was fine for a night.
We really liked the furniture and decoration of the apartment.
We had an amazing stay here the location was perfect! We would definitely come back !
Todo perfecto, con la anfitrión y con la estancia

Fantástico el alojamiento!!
Muy contentos con la estancia.
Muchas gracias ❤️
Thanks
we really enjoyed our stay, good apartment with easy access to any part of town

Séjour agréable, proche métro.
Instructions claires.

Alles super. Tolle Ausgangslage für Unternehmungen, gute Infrastruktur mit Markt, Supermarkt, Bäcker und Restaurants. Nur 3 Minuten zur Metrostation. Nur 30 Minuten vom Flughafen. Man fühlt sich ausserdem sehr sicher und Alba ist eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin. Ich würde jederzeit wieder kommen.

The cleanest airbnb i’ve been so far.
The place is big enough for two and our luggages. Easy to find, good location, close to Camp nou and next to a Metro that connects to everything.
Alba is very sweet and paid great attention to us. Would definetely recommend.

L’hôte est accueillante, les instructions sont claires, l’appartement en lui-même est propre, confortable et climatisé.
Nous avons passés un très bon séjour.
Pas de problème correspondait à l’annonce nous avons passé un très bon séjour.

The apartment is very clean, spacious, exactly the way it is shown in the pictures. Instructions are very clear. Overall I'm very happy for the experience with Alba's place, sadly we couldn't stayed more due to work schedule. If you're looking for a place where you can go visit attractions very easily, cook and also very quiet area, her place is gonna fit for you very well. Muchas gracias Alba, if the opportunity to come back again to Barcelona comes, I'll try my best to come again to your place!

Alloggio perfetto, in una posizione comoda e tranquilla. La metro è molto vicina e consente di spostarsi ovunque. La zona ha attorno mercati, negozi, ristoranti. Alba è davvero gentile, educata, disponibile e chiara nelle indicazioni che ci ha fornito. Se dovessimo tornare a Barcellona, prenoteremo di nuovo lì! ⭐

Lovely flat in a quiet area. Plenty shops, restaurants nearby. Collblanc Metro is a 5 min walk away giving excellent access to the City Centre and the Airport.
Great base for exploring.
The host is very nice and responsive, the place is very clean and easy to get around
Tutto perfetto tranne un po la terrazza che non avevamo capito fosse condivisa

Alba was a very helpful and responsive host. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. The location was very handy and just a short walk to the metro station. Would definitely recommend!

J’ai passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement à Barcelone Le logement très propre et parfaitement entretenu. Le rapport qualité-prix est vraiment excellent. J’ai été très satisfait de mon séjour et je recommande vivement cet appartement. Merci pour cet accueil !

Tous les éléments indiqué était bien présents il y a tous ce qu’il faut et la terrasse gros plus en tant que fumeur
Ou même pour prendre l’air , l’appartement était juste un peu plus petit que je l’imaginais et niveau confort c’est assez moyen le mobilier.
Il y a eu un problème de toilettes et de portes mais ils ont très vite réglé le soucis alors ça n’a pas dérangé mon séjour et Alba m’a beaucoup aidé et à su m’indiquer que faire et les bons emplacement après m’être fait voler mes affaires dans ma voitures(il ont pété ma vitre et volée toute mes affaires). Oui attention quand vous aller à Barcelone vous avez une chance sur cinq de vous faire voler un truc en temps que touriste si vous laissez votre voiture dans la rue prioriser les parkings payant (d’ailleurs c’est l’enfer d’être en voiture à Barcelone )… Un bon 4/5 car vous avez accès à tous facilement et que Alba ma sauvé mon séjour .
Es war sehr gut, und die Lage ist auch sect angenehm.

Pasamos unos días excelentes en el apartamento de Alba, todo muy limpio y ordenado , cómodo. Alba estuvo al pendiente en todo momento , muy servicial . El apartamento estaba cerca de la línea del metro y de los autobuses lo que nos facilitó poder movernos . Sin duda volvería a alojarme allí.
Super

The host was very friendly and available to help us with everything we needed, early check-in (if possible, it was for us 😂) luggage storage upon departure if we have a late departure, the room was clean and everything necessary was available, the metro and bus are a few minutes away, market and terraces near the location, Specifically, it was very good!

Nice apartment, in a very nice area. I met Albas husband who was extremely pleasant to speak to and very happy. Great air ventilation so no worries with the heat. The numbers on the front door keypad are a bit faded so it takes a few tries to type in the code when entering for the first time.
Estuvo bien

Alba est une hôte merveilleuse et disponible à n’importe quel moment, les informations d’accès au logement était parfaitement bien détaillées, le logement en lui même était très propre et sympathique. Le quartier est assez calme et il y a beaucoup de rues piétonnes ce qui est agréable !
this place was great! good location and attentive hosts

Geweldige locatie. Rustig, maar toch dicht bij genoeg stedelijke voorzieningen. Heel blij ook met de tips die Cesc had gegeven. Daardoor heerlijk lokaal geluncht. We waren met z'n 3-en en het appartement was meer dan groot genoeg. Mooi ingericht en schoon. Bij vragen werden wij ook direct geholpen. Ik zou hier zo nog een keer heen gaan bij een volgend Barcelona bezoek.

L'hôte est vraiment super réactif et très gentil.
L'hébergement correspond tout à fait aux photos et est très fonctionnel.
Nous étions 5, tout le monde etait satisfait. Le seul mini bémol est peut etre l'emplacement de la boite à clefs, pas super accessible, disons quil ne faut pas etre petit !

I had a wonderful time at this listing, Cesc is truly a wonderful host! Not only was the place as described and in a great location, Cesc was proactive in suggestions over messages and through his wall of information inside the airbnb. Would absolutely recommend this to anybody who wants to explore Barcelona. The location was great, the hosts were amazing, the airbnb was as listed.

Super netter Host, stets gute Kommunikation, einfacher Check In und alles wie beschrieben :)
Gerne wieder!!

This place was nearly perfect except I would not recommend staying here during the summer. Unlike everywhere else we stayed in the region, there were no shutters on the back windows. This turned the apartment into a greenhouse against which the air conditioning, feeble even by European standards, was useless. On full blast, the living room was 28 degrees C/82F which was fine, but we couldn't get one of the bedrooms below 32C/90F except from 2-5am when it went down to 30C/86F. The only way to have air circulate is to have every door open which meant everyone woke up with the baby, and that was at sunrise because there were no shutters to block out the light. The local guidebooks and recommendations were the most useful of any Airbnb I've ever stayed. The location is incredible, and all the beds were comfortable including the fold out couch. Note for people in larger bodies, the shower is tiny.

Sehr angenehmer Gastgeber.
Stets erreichbar mit kurzen Antwortzeiten.
Gab Tipps (hierfür sogar eine Infoecke in der Wohnung eingerichtet) und half auch bei Nachfragen.
Insgesamt ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt in der Wohnung. Die Klimaanlage im Wohnraum half, die Temperatur auf ein angenehmes Niveau zu senken.
Vielen Dank!

Had a great stay in Barcelona! Host was super responsive and accommodating.
Place was comfortable for our family of 4. Private and peaceful. Host also gave lots of recommendations regarding activities and food options around. It has good connectivity to all the tourist spots.

My friends and I enjoyed our stay a lot, it was our first time in Lisbon and everything was great. The location was excellent and the apartment was completely clean and as pictured/described. Communication was quick as well.

Fue una estancia muy agradable, la pasamos muy agusto en el piso si tuviera que hacer alguna sugerencia sería acerca de la ducha, cambiarla por alguna más grande pero aún así se logra el objetivo 😜 de ahí en fuera la comunicación fue muy efectiva y todo súper bien 👍
Great flat, Cesc was helpful and provided everything we needed. Cesc kindly allowed us to check in earlier. 10 minute walk to Sagrada Família
Great location and lovely place! As described. The host was responsive and willing to help.
Tavsiye ederim. Merkezi ve temiz bir ev.

Cristina was friendly throughout our stay. She informed us in advance about the tourist tax, which had to be paid in cash upon arrival (€9.50 pp/day). The apartment is in a quiet location and is on the first floor, with a small elevator available. However, guests should be aware that this is the only Airbnb in a residential building, so noise restrictions are very strict. There is a noise monitoring device in the apartment that notifies the host when noise exceeds certain levels. During our stay, Cristina sent us a screenshot from the device showing the decibel level and later called us to keep the noise down. While she was polite throughout, the reported level was still below 70 dB, which is generally a normal conversation level. The monitoring and follow-up made us feel somewhat uncomfortable and less at home in the apartment. Another downside was the air conditioning. The only AC unit is in the living room, and the cool air does not reach the bedrooms. The rooms got super hot!
