Jordi is an outstanding host - hospitable, generous with sound advice, leaves you food and drink treats and is very supportive whenever you have a question. A real professional whose varied language skills made everything easy navigate. I would love to come back again.

If you want to immerse yourself as a tourist in authentic Spanish family life in the local community this is the place to stay because of the location in a quiet environment. The apartment is located less than 50 m from a Metro station serving the airport directly on a street having restricted traffic flow with many eating places in a friendly neighbourhood that is quiet during the night and day. The kitchen is well equipped (no dishwasher), and the apartment comfortably furnished with a modernised bathroom having a shower over the bath. There are some steps to climb after getting the lift. The host provided a very well provisioned welcome pack including a cold beer on a hot day and was present to allow very early access in the morning and explain things. Greatly appreciated Jordi. Recommended for a short stay

Ho soggiornato con i miei figli dal 5 al 12 settembre.
Alex e la sua assistente Irina somo stati fantastici. Sempre attenti e premurosi ci hanno consigliato diverse cose dai trasporti ai ristoranti alle gite.
Veramente molto carini
Great place, very close to Sagrada familia.

Séjour de 4 jours agréables.
Logement dans les hauteurs de Barcelone.
Un bus vous dépose a proximité. Métro en contrebas pour bien profiter de la ville.
Alimentation proche.
Bien au calme.

Extremely helpful host, great communication, extremely helpful recommendations
The place itself was exactly as described and pictured in the photos. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and would definitely recommend to anyone coming to Barcelona

We had a fantastic trip, the apartment was great & the recommendations from the host were brilliant.
Great communication too, always available if we had questions & sent us lists of things to do & places to eat.
Location is excellent for local shops, supermarkets & transport.
Flat was a home from home, beds were comfy, air con very welcome, shower was great & gold star for coffee machine!
Thank you 😁

Alex and Irina were absolutely wonderful. They were both extremely informative, kind and accommodating. They truly made our stay in Barcelona a breeze, not to mention their apartment was very clean and comfortable.  We would definitely book here again!

El apartamento es pequeño pero funcional, está a distancia caminando del Parque Guel, y la sagrada familia. Para otros lugares puedes ir en transporte público o uber.
La comunicación fue buena, el apartamento estaba limpio y las intrucciones para el check in fueron claras.
Good Apt
Recalcaría la buena comunicación con el anfitrión. La casa es cómoda y esta bien equipada. Si volvemos a Barcelona a poder ser repetiremos.

Alex and his team were very responsive and the place is easily accessible by public transport
Close to the Sagrada and Gaudi park and quite a few good restaurants .. cafés .. grocery stores just a 5-10 min walk away

Appartement bien situé au calme à proximité du parc Güell et de la sagrada familia . Desservi par les bus et le métro à 800m , l’endroit est idéal au calme de la ville. Petit appartement mais bien conçu , avec la climatisation 👍

Nous sommes restés 1 semaine avec ma copine, appartement super, propre qui correspond parfaitement à la description.
Les instructions était claires avec une communication rapide et beaucoup de conseils (transports, restaurants, activités, parking…)
Ce fut un super séjour merci encore beaucoup !!

ci siamo trovati benissimo, appartamento pulito e con tutto il necessario per un soggiorno di pochi giorni dove di base non ti porti dietro nulla. zona super collegata con tutto, appartamento luminoso e arieggiato

Апартаментът беше чист, подреден и на удобна за нас локация. Кварталът е приятен, в близост до спирки на обществен транспорт. Хубава гледка към града, чудесни пекарни наоколо с хубаво кафе и невероятни кроасани с шоколад! Хазяите са много отзивчиви, предлагат подходящи места за посещение и хранене. С удоволствие бихме посетили отново апартамента! ☺️🥐☕

Alex and Irina were wonderful hosts! The apartment had a beautiful view and was perfect the week-long stay for our family of 3. Alex and Irina gave us lots of information about things to do, how to get around, and restaurant suggestions. Anytime we had a question, they were quick to answer. They even adjusted their schedule to let us check in early. Thank you for  a great place to stay!

We had a great stay! We were there for 8 days so we were able to make the apartment feel like our home! Alex was always very quick with responding and very helpful! Place was not near Barcelona center but we didn’t mind it was nice to get our steps in but could be considered inconvenient depending on what you’re doing there. Overall I would recommend their place and would love to come back!

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in diesem Apartment in Barcelona. Die Unterkunft war sauber, komfortabel und gut ausgestattet. Die Lage war ruhig und bestens für Familien geeignet. Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber verlief unkompliziert und freundlich. Wir haben jede Menge Informationen und Tipps erhalten. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen und können die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen!

Die Wohnung liegt perfekt: ruhig und gleichzeitig so zentral, dass man mit dem Fahrrad/ Taxi/ öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder auch zu Fuß problemlos überall hinkam. Die Wohnung sieht genauso aus wie auf den Fotos und ist gut ausgestattet. Ich hatte Kontakt mit Irina, die jederzeit erreichbar war.

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié de nous reposer après des journées bien remplies. Nous avons bien dormi dans le lit et la vue changeante au gré des lumières nous a vraiment plu. Les équipements correspondaient à notre besoin et Alex et Irina sont des hôtes très « professionnels »: ils réagissent vite, font des suggestions touristiques et savent être flexibles.

The hosts were very kind and they gave us every indication and every useful information about the city and the culture of Barcelona. The apartment is situated nearby the bus station and also the metro station. Very clean, quiet and cozy place. Hasta luego!✌️
Schöne Wohnung mit guter Lage
Adequate space for the five of us that stayed and walkable distance to Sagrada Família and Festival Major De Gracia (when it is going on). Plenty of places to eat nearby and very responsive host.

Nous avons passé un très bon et court séjour à Barcelone. Seule avec 4 enfants, la disponibilité et les conseils de l'hôte en amont de notre arrivée était une précieuse aide. L'appartement est fonctionnel et bien équipé. Le metro à proximité est très pratique pour les déplacements.
Tout etait au top situation,logement,communication rien a dire excellent
Tres bien, le menage realiser et assez leger dans l'ensemble sinon le logement est tres bien.

I really enjoyed everything. The host was always available and helpful. It’s very close to downtown, check-in was quick, and having two keys was very convenient. The kitchen is great—it has everything you need for a pleasant stay. It was well worth the money, and I’d definitely stay here again.

We absolutely loved Monica’s and Guillermo’s flat. It’s spacious, well-equipped, and very tastefully decorated. The washer/dryer work perfectly (allows for lighter packing) and the full sized kitchen is also a plus.
The location is ideal for exploring Barcelona by foot (or catching ride shares just meters away from the front door). Our son (15) and his teammate were with us the first and last nights of our stay and there was plenty of space for four.
There’s a wonderful little coffee shop and cafe across the passage—literally 10 meters from the front door. The people who work there are so pleasant and the coffee/food is delicious.
Be prepared for the hustle and bustle of city living. It’s definitely an active area so if you’re looking for long sleep-ins in a quiet bed and breakfast type setting, I wouldn’t advise it. But if you’re like us and love listening to a new city come to life every morning and can’t wait to get outside and start your adventures, you found a great home base!

The place is centrally located but is a bit run down. The mattresses are saggy and had seen better times. The bathroom was a bit of an issue since the shower glass is just half the length. Looks nice but less practical since it’s almost impossible to prevent water spilling out. The drain was blocked the first day when we checked in but they fixed it. The same with the vessels where the non stick pan had seen better days. There was no more non stick coating on it.
Small things add up and makes the stay feel very ok. Would recommend the owners to look into these things and fix.
I really enjoyed my stay here. The hosts are absolutely great. Extremely helpful and very fast responses for any questions you may have. Highly recommend!
离市中心很近、出行很方便！
¡Excelente atención desde que llegamos! El apartamento es muy amplio, cómodo y el trato fue impecable. ¡Muchas gracias por todo!
Easy access to and from attractions. Peaceful street, safe.
Nice place to stay, it was nice and close to the coffe shops and the attraction's . We walked  everywhere didn't need a car .

La pasamos de maravilla, una gran parte de eso se debe al alojamiento de Monica y Guillermo que por cierto siempre estuvieron atentos, coincide tal cual con las fotos y la ubicación es muy buena, un barrio muy tranquilo y agradable

This apartment was spacious and suited our group of 4 adults.
The hosts were very responsive and helped coordinate a drop off for our bags prior to the check in time. Throughout the stay responses were within minutes and always helpful.
The apartment is in a neighborhood that’s a short walk to Sagrada Família. It’s safe, relatively quiet and there was lots of room to spread out. We really appreciated having room to store things in the bathroom and the ample hot water for showers.
We were only left 3 bath towels for 4 people and only a couple rolls of toilet paper so that could have been better.
Overall we had a wonderful stay at Monica & Guillermo’s.
Amazing hosts. Very responsive and accommodating.

We had an excellent day for eight nights at Monica‘s place. The space was roomy with well stocked kitchen, washer, and dryer, comfortable living room and sleeping area. The area in which this is located is walkable to many grocery stores, restaurants, and attractions.  Monica was helpful and always responsive..  thank you for a great day in Barcelona

First of all Guillermo was a very kind Host and was always quick to answer when i had any questions. The AirBnb is a short walk from the Sagrada familia and using E-Bikes you can reach the beach within 20 Minutes. For the price youre paying the AirBnb offers everything you need for your stay. If i ever come back to Barcelona i will defenitely see what Guillermo offers first.

El lugar esta mejor de lo que esperaba, muy cerca de la Sagrada Familia, restaurantes y mercados y las recomendaciones de restaurantes que nos dieron fueron muy buenas, definitivamente me gustaria regresar.

Unsere Unterkunft hat uns rundum überzeugt. Die Lage war einfach ideal – nur etwa 10 Minuten zu Fuß von der Sagrada Familia entfernt. Zudem gab es mehrere Bushaltestellen in unmittelbarer Nähe, was die Fortbewegung sehr einfach gemacht hat. Direkt gegenüber befand sich ein Supermarkt und um die Ecke gab es einen Bäcker sowie weitere Einkaufsmöglichkeiten – wirklich sehr praktisch.
Die Gastgeber, insbesondere Guillermo, waren äußerst freundlich, hilfsbereit und jederzeit schnell erreichbar. Man hat sich sofort gut aufgehoben gefühlt.
Auch die Unterkunft selbst ließ keine Wünsche offen: Sie war sehr sauber, gut ausgestattet und das WLAN hat einwandfrei funktioniert. Der Check-in und Check-out verliefen unkompliziert und problemlos.
Insgesamt eine sehr empfehlenswerte Unterkunft – wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

The flat was clean, cozy, and comfortable, and our overall stay was great.
The only issue was check-in: we waited an hour for Mae to arrive despite messaging her. Once she got there, she was fairly demanding about the house rules, which was frustrating given we had been patiently waiting for an hour. Despite that, we recommend the place and would stay again.

No locks on window/ door access. Big security concern. No communication response from host. A/C not working and bedroom A/C very bad smell. Unfair money fine for being 10 min late when precinct access was closed for the festa and we had to run with luggage for nearly one klm. The check in person fined us, did a QUICK introduction to the house - about 7 min and left. There was no further communication about anything. Much report and upgrade is needed including all cracked and chipped crockery  A/C systems, security issues. It was a very bad experience in the dreadful heat

The place was close to the city centre and was clean and felt comfortable to live in. We really appreciated the air conditioning during the hot weather and it was enough to keep the whole apartment cool. Thank you.

We absolutely loved our stay here! The apartment is beautiful, comfortable, very clean, and has everything you need for a great stay in Barcelona.
The location was one of our favorite things about it. There are so many wonderful restaurants, cafés, and places to explore right on the street and within easy walking distance, while the neighborhood itself still feels nice, quiet, and relaxing. It was a great balance — close to everything we wanted to do without feeling like we were in the middle of a busy tourist area.
The apartment was very well equipped, comfortable, and a wonderful place to come back to after spending the day exploring Barcelona. Everything was easy and convenient, and we felt very much at home.
We had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
sejour impeccable,un peu court mais nous reviendrons.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans l appartement de Teodor. Il est très bien situé pour tout visiter, dans une rue où on trouve tout : petits supermarchés, boulangeries, glaciers, métros pas loin. Joliment décoré, parfaitement conforme aux photos, l appartement est très agréable, très propre. Merci beaucoup à Teodor pour sa communication et ses conseils, je recommande totalement .

El departamento no está acorde con el precio que se cobra. Por llegar después de las 20 hs hay un costo adicional bastante caro. Creo que este tipo de situaciones se pueden solucionar con un locker con código donde el huésped puede retirar las llaves sin costos extras.
Un departamento muy ordenado y limpio, agradecemos sus atenciones
Sopi hyvin viidelle miehelle

Reservamos unas estancia para 5 personas, había 4 sillas. Mi hija tuvo que comer todo el rato tomada. El AIRE ACONDICIONADO NO FUNCIONA, había un ventilador ( sabían de antemano que estaba roto el a/a) imposible dormir con tanto calor en Barcelona, es fue la peor parte. Al piso le falta mantenimiento. Sábanas y colcha llenas de manchas de lejía. El trapo de cocina era una toalla de un gimnasio, puaggg

We had a great time staying in Teodor’s apartment. It is very spacious and in a great location for walking basically anywhere in the city. I would definitely recommend this place and if we come back to Barcelona then I’ll be hoping to stay at his place again. Thank you!

My family of 5 was very happy to stay at your apartment.  The location of the apartment was perfect if you are looking to be in the Garcia neighborhood.  The apartment was clean, especially kitchen and bathroom.  The apartment was spacious for party of 5. We loved the working washer/dryer.  We would stay here again in the future if we visit Barcelona. Thank you!

Wonderful stay! Tons of information given before you even arrive, lots of places to eat and a mini-mart right outside apartment. Elevator was great for suitcases & after a long day of walking. Recommend doing a hop on/hop off bus as a way to get around the city and see everything (plus AC is a great break from the heat). Hosts are very responsive and helpful!
Buena ubicación lugar tranquilo cómodo
Buena ubicación, contaba con todo lo necesario ,muy acogedor el departamento
Felt very much at home and great position to access all we wanted to do in Barcelona. Property very comfortable and Gracia a lovely area ! Thank you Teo. ☺️

Nos encantó el piso. Tenía todo lo que nos hacía falta. Perfecto para pasar un par de días. El barrio de Gràcia ofrece muchísimo de tiendas y restaurantes y el Metro también está cerca si queríamos ir al centro más turístico.
El día que vuelva a Barcelona, estaría encantado de poder quedarme aquí de nuevo.

comunicazione pre viaggio completa e immediata.
persona super disponibile
appartamento pulito, comodo e molto funzionale.

Desde el principio, el anfitrión fue muy atento. Me envió mucha información turística (que, yo que trabajo en el sector, se agradece un montón, ya que fue muy precisa y útil), y el piso estaba impecable. Fueron muy amables, ya que nos permitieron dejar el equipaje antes de hacer el check-in para que no fuéramos cargadas por la ciudad. El barrio de Gracia es precioso, muy tranquilo y lleno de cosas que hacer, además de muy bien comunicado. Si vuelvo a la ciudad, volveré a contar con este apartamento, que era muy cómodo y la experiencia ha sido perfecta. :)
Muy céntrico, limpio , todo muy bien.

Angeles’ place was amazing — easy access to many different locations as the metro was a minute walk away. Angeles was very responsive and it was amazing to have a laundry facility adjacent to the apartment

Angele loft is very spacious and comfortable, in a great location near the Mercat Nou station. I reallly liked the neighborhood. Angeles was a great communicator, and answered all of my questions immediately. I appreciated the ability to do laundry, and the restaurant suggestions.

Angeles est vraiment très arrangeante et sympathique et partage beaucoup de conseils.
L’appartement est un grand loft spacieux , avec une très belle hauteur sous plafond, il était très propre.
Il y quelques éléments atypiques, comme la salle de bain en deux parties, ou la cuisine qui fait un peu de brics et de brocs mais ça fait aussi partie du charme du lieu.
J’ai trouvé tout l’essentiel dans la cuisine.
Un supermarché est à deux pas.
Il y avait quelques cadeaux d’accueil très sympathiques.
Le seul point qui m’a un peu embêté c’est de découvrir seulement une fois arrivé qu’il était interdit de recevoir des amis alors que rien ne le disait dans l’annonce et que j’en avais l’intention lors de ce voyage.
Mais je ne pense avoir causé de tort à personne et il ne s’agissait bien sûr pas de faire une fête ou que quelqu’un reste plus d’une heure ou deux.
Świetne miejsce, dobra lokalizacja, blisko metro, miły, pomocny i komunikatowny gospodarz.
Loved my stay at the loft apartment. Was everything described.

I really enjoyed my stay here. the apartment is very spacious and well located for metro and night buses. it is very quiet and private. the kitchen is fully equipped. the mattress is not the best and has caved in. also, the bed is two single beds pushed together, which may be annoying for some.

This was one of the nicest Air Bnb’s I’ve stayed in. Spacious, nicely designed, comfortable, and it was so quiet (great for a light sleeper). It had everything I needed to sleep well and cook. Angeles was friendly and easy to communicate with, and kindly let me drop my bags early before check in. I will stay here again next time I’m in Barcelona!

El airbnb estuvo impecable al momento de hacer check in. El apartamento está en perfectas condiciones. La ubicación también es ideal, el metro está a 25mts y en unos cuantos minutos estás en Plaza Espanya o Catalunya.
Angeles fue súper comunicativa y siempre atenta. 100/100

I had a fantastic stay! The level of detail and care put into the studio was truly appreciated, every little touch made the space feel comfortable and welcoming.
Angeles was incredibly helpful, kind, and made sure I had everything I needed throughout my stay. It was a wonderful experience, and we would happily come back again!

Leiligheten var veldig fin, romslig og ren. Angeles gav veldig mye og god informasjon og sjekket at jeg hadde komme trygt inn. Jeg benyttet leiligheten for en Formel 1 tur og hadde kun ca 20 minutter gåavstand til togstasjon. Også mulig å ta metro rett ved leiligheten. Anbefales på det sterkeste.
O lugar é grande demais para apenas uma pessoa, mas definitivamente é MUITO bom. Me senti acolhido pelo espaço.
Escogí este apartamento por la cercanía con Sant y me sorprendió lo tranquilo del area, una excelente anfitriona que respondió a todas mis inquietudes y preguntas, volvería con gusto.
Está muy bien el apartamento y Angeles estuvo muy atenta en las comunicaciones. Ideal para pasar unos días por Barcelona, al estar absurdamente cerca del metro.

Confortable loft situado en el contra frente de la planta baja del edificio por lo que es tranquilo y no llegan ruidos de la calle. Tiene una cama cómoda, una buena ducha, se llega en metro a las ramblas en 15 minutos, tiene un supermercado en la esquina, el aire acondicionado funciona perfectamente y los anfitriones responden rápido. Lo recomiendo
Host was very responsive, helpful and friendly, ideal location next to the metro! Would absolutely stay again!
great location!
Sehr gerne wieder! Super Loft in ruhigem Quartier.

I recently stayed at a delightful Airbnb that was spotless, stylishly decorated, and filled with thoughtful touches like fresh flowers and complimentary tea and coffee. The cosy bedding and fully equipped kitchen made it feel like a home away from home, while its quiet location just a short stroll from local shops and cafés was perfect. The host was exceptional – friendly, responsive, and attentive without being intrusive – making the entire stay relaxing and enjoyable. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for comfort, charm, and convenience.
Amazing experience and an even more amazing location!!

lovely comfortable stay. right next to the metro so really easy to get into central Barcelona. very spacious and quiet
thank you

Koni’s place is one of the best Airbnb‘s I’ve ever stayed at for the price. It was large and perfectly centrally located to everything. Across the street was a great place to wake up and have coffee./breakfast.  Metro lines were right out the door to the left less than a minute away. we weren’t able to get in it first and find the key and so we called. Koni. They picked up right away and we found out we were on the wrong floor.. jaja koni is very kind and very attentive to guests. If we are ever in Barcelona again, this is definitely where we will stay.! also had a great balcony!
Es war super schön dort! Mega Lage & die Klimaanlage ist super wichtig und hat alles super geklappt 👍🏽

Great spot in a great location. Host was super responsive and apartment had everything you could need, including a washer which came in hand given how hot Barcelona was during our stay. AC was also perfect, only fan in the room but the AC was enough for the whole apartment.

Der Aufenthalt bei Koni war zufriedenstellend. Alles war sauber und Koni auch jederzeit erreichbar. Es gibt ein Schlafsofa sowie Schlafsessel im Wohnzimmer, die als mehrtägige Übernachtung aufgrund der schmalen Matratzen nicht ganz geeignet sind. Vielleicht könnte man in Zukunft eine zusätzliche Matratze drauflegen. Das Bett im Schlafzimmer war  bequem und einwandfrei. Das Internet ist nicht ganz so gut, zumindest nicht, wenn man mit fünf Leuten in der Unterkunft ist. Alles in allem war der Aufenthalt angenehm. Falls man täglich zum Strand möchte, ist es jedoch von dort aus ein sportlicher Fußmarsch.
Un lindo departamento. El metro muy cerca y céntrico. Lo disfrutamos mucho. Muchas gracias, Koni.

Bel appartement idéalement placé pour visiter Barcelone. A proximité des stations de métro, quartier gothique à pied.
Appartement calme, bien insonorisé
Todo muy bien

Nous avons passé un bon séjour chez Koni. L’emplacement central est idéal proche du métro et des bus.
L’appartement est impeccable et dispose de tous les équipements nécessaires.
Petit bémol pour le canapé du salon, le matelas est assez fin ce qui le rend inconfortable. Il conviendrait plus à un enfant qu’à un adulte.
Quartier animé le soir, assez bruyant du côté de la chambre.
Je recommande ce logement

L’appartement se trouve idéalement placé. Bonne isolation et très propre.
Les informations étaient si claires que nous n’avons pas eu besoin de Koni.
Séjour à la hauteur de nos souhaits.
Lo volvería a elegir todo estupendo

Great stay in a central, walkable location. The apartment had plenty of space for the three of us, a large bathroom, and lovely balconies that we really enjoyed. It was easy to explore the city on foot, with many attractions, restaurants, and shops nearby. We would happily stay here again.
Great place to stay, perfect location and Koni was really helpful throughout our stay!
Super lage, sehr sauber komme gerne wieder
Super disponibile, zona top, tutto perfetto
Had a great stay at this lovely apartment in an ideal location, thanks so much!

We had a great stay. The location is excellent, very walkable and conveniently located next to several bus stops and the metro station. We took the Aerobus from the airport and had only a short walk from the bus stop to the flat, just as Koni had described. The flat was clean, uncluttered, and featured a well-equipped kitchen. Although it is located on the second floor, it is easily accessible by both stairs and elevator. Despite being situated in a central and busy area, the apartment was surprisingly quiet inside. There appears to be a bar or nightclub across the street, but we were not disturbed by any noise at night. In fact, we did not even realize it was there until a few days into our stay. Overall, we had a wonderful experience. The only minor drawback was that the beds were somewhat firm for our preference.

Bardzo fajny apartament, świetnie urządzony i dobrze wyposażony. Gospodarz responsywny i pocny. Lokalizacja w zasadzie w ścisłym centrum dlategp przy otwartych oknach względnoe głośno, ale hej to Barcelona, miasto gdzie życie trwa 24h.  Byliśmy w 5 osób. Ocena 5/5 .

Super emplacement pour se balader dans Barcelone. Tout est à proximité, le quartier est parfait. Je recommande ce logement. Juste un petit bémol, les spots sont trop puissants et la lumière trop vive. Ce serait une bonne idée de les changer au profit d’ampoules moins blanches et moins fortes 😉

Le logement est bien situé pour visiter et vivre quelques jours en profitant de la ville.
l'equipement est simple et fonctionnel.
parfait pour ce quenouille avions prévu de faire
Logement très bien situé et très agréable. L'hôte est réactive et très claire dans ses explications. Nous recommandons fortement. Bonne continuation à vous Koni

Abbiamo soggiornato in questo appartamento per qualche giorno durante il nostro viaggio a Barcellona e ci siamo trovate molto bene. L’appartamento era pulito, ordinato e dotato di tutto il necessario per il soggiorno. Gli spazi erano accoglienti e ci siamo sentite subito a nostro agio.
Anche la posizione è stata comoda per visitare la città e spostarci facilmente. Nel complesso è stata un’esperienza molto positiva e consigliamo sicuramente questo appartamento per un soggiorno a Barcellona!

The place is really cute and aestethic. It worked great for the 6 of us (girl friend group). The location is amazing and really well connected with the rest of the city. The neighbourhood was a bit loud but otherwise beautiful. Ana was friendly and provided clear instructions for the check in and check out. She let us leave our lugagge in the building because we had a late flight. Overall I would definitely recommend this apartment.
Appartement bien situé. Grande pièce à vivre. Climatisation très agréable en cette période de canicule. Par contre, les matelas dans la chambre et le canapé lit mériteraient d’être remplacés.

We stayed at Ana’s place for four nights. The location was great, right in the heart of Barcelona, close to metro and bus stops, with supermarkets within walking distance.
Ana was a great host. We arrived in Barcelona quite early in the day, and she was kind enough to accommodate us and welcome us earlier than the usual check-in time.
The bed was comfortable enough, although the pillows were quite thin, and the shower was small. Overall, good value for money, especially considering the central location.

The location of Ana’s place is great, many sites are walkable. With the yellow and blue  metro line being close, you can get around the rest of Barcelona easily too. There’s also well connected buses! The space was small but worked fine with our family of 5 as we spent much of the day exploring the city.
Καλό αλλά όχι για 6 άτομα
Localização muito boa, mas acomodação antiga, falta manutençao

Overall, our stay was acceptable, but we'd like to share the following feedback:
1. The light in one of the bedrooms was not functioning for the entirety of our three-night stay.
2. The fan in another bedroom was broken; its cover fell off during operation, and the stand was unstable, preventing it from standing still.
3. Due to the broken fan and the absence of air conditioning in any of the bedrooms, we found it uncomfortably hot, making it difficult to sleep. Both the table fan and ceiling fan provided very weak airflow.
4. The accommodation is located on the 1st floor which we discovered by ourselves as we were not provided with clear instructions regarding the exact floor/unit number upon arrival. Additionally, there is no lift, and we struggled to carry five large pieces of luggage up the extremely narrow staircase.
We believe this accommodation might be more suitable for travelers visiting Barcelona during cooler seasons (definitely not summer) and those with minimal luggages.

We really enjoyed the staying.  Location is very convenient and clean room.  Strongly recommend!

Albert was a lovely, reponsive host and his place is a perfect holday getaway in a leafy green part of Barcelona close to lots of little coffee shops, restaurants and supermarkets, and walking distance to the beach.
Appartamento nuovo, confortevole e molto pulito. Quartiere bello, tranquillo e ben servito da autobus e metro. Hosting molto disponibile e gentile. Grazie Albert
Albert was a great host, he had lots of recommendations to help explore the area and the location is great!

Ich war sehr happy mit der Unterkunft! Das Bett war super bequem und es war alles da, was man brauchte! Albert hat auch tolle Tipps geschickt, rund um die Umgebung und er war immer freundlich und erreichbar! Jeder Zeit wieder!

Très bon séjour passé à Barcelone dans ce logement.
Propre et bien équipé.
Hôte à l’écoute, réactif et très gentil.
Un peu dérangé par les bruits de l’extérieur la nuit car l’appartement n’est pas bien insonorisé.
Mais l’ensemble du séjour est très bon je recommande.
Området var fridfullt och familjärt. Nära till havet, tunnelbanan, mataffärer och restauranger.  Bästa värden man kan tänka sig och en väldigt fin lägenhet. Kommer lätt att återvända.

Nous avions la chance de séjourner chez Albert.Appartement très propre dans un quartier calme très bien situé à proximité des supermarchés, des restaurants, d’un centre commercial. Proche aussi de tous moyens de transport tram au pied de la résidence et Bus métro aussi facilement accessible via les correspondance. A 15 min  aussi de la plage playa mar bella. L’appartement très bien équipé très bien décoré et aussi très propre. Albert est aussi un hôte très attentionné qui nous a partagé pas mal de recommandations et demande de nos nouvelles et très accessible en cas de besoin. Nous y reviendrons c’est sûr. Merci Albert pour ce beau séjour à Barcelone.

The place was absolutely brilliant. Albert gave fantastic recommendations nearby and the communication was top tier. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience in Barcelona. The place was well equipped and very clean, it was situated in a place with brilliant transport links. Highly recommend staying here

Spent a great week at this apartment with my partner. Great location, very close to tram/metro links into the city. Great food and drink spots nearby. Albert was very responsive to any questions and helped elevate our trip to Barcelona.
Wonderful city and Poblenou the perfect location

Top! L'appartamento di Albert è davvero molto bello e pulito ed ha tutto ciò che una persona in vacanza necessita.
Albert è impeccabile e sempre disponibile per qualsiasi cosa 🧡
Great place, modern, well located, far from the crowds. Good communication with the host

Séjour agréable, proche métro.
Instructions claires.

Alles super. Tolle Ausgangslage für Unternehmungen, gute Infrastruktur mit Markt, Supermarkt, Bäcker und Restaurants. Nur 3 Minuten zur Metrostation. Nur 30 Minuten vom Flughafen. Man fühlt sich ausserdem sehr sicher und Alba ist eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin. Ich würde jederzeit wieder kommen.

The cleanest airbnb i’ve been so far.
The place is big enough for two and our luggages. Easy to find, good location, close to Camp nou and next to a Metro that connects to everything.
Alba is very sweet and paid great attention to us. Would definetely recommend.

L’hôte est accueillante, les instructions sont claires, l’appartement en lui-même est propre, confortable et climatisé.
Nous avons passés un très bon séjour.
Pas de problème correspondait à l’annonce nous avons passé un très bon séjour.

The apartment is very clean, spacious, exactly the way it is shown in the pictures. Instructions are very clear. Overall I'm very happy for the experience with Alba's place, sadly we couldn't stayed more due to work schedule. If you're looking for a place where you can go visit attractions very easily, cook and also very quiet area, her place is gonna fit for you very well. Muchas gracias Alba, if the opportunity to come back again to Barcelona comes, I'll try my best to come again to your place!

Alloggio perfetto, in una posizione comoda e tranquilla. La metro è molto vicina e consente di spostarsi ovunque. La zona ha attorno mercati, negozi, ristoranti. Alba è davvero gentile, educata, disponibile e chiara nelle indicazioni che ci ha fornito. Se dovessimo tornare a Barcellona, prenoteremo di nuovo lì! ⭐

Lovely flat in a quiet area. Plenty shops, restaurants nearby. Collblanc Metro is a 5 min walk away giving excellent access to the City Centre and the Airport.
Great base for exploring.
The host is very nice and responsive, the place is very clean and easy to get around
Tutto perfetto tranne un po la terrazza che non avevamo capito fosse condivisa

Alba was a very helpful and responsive host. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. The location was very handy and just a short walk to the metro station. Would definitely recommend!

J’ai passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement à Barcelone Le logement très propre et parfaitement entretenu. Le rapport qualité-prix est vraiment excellent. J’ai été très satisfait de mon séjour et je recommande vivement cet appartement. Merci pour cet accueil !

Tous les éléments indiqué était bien présents il y a tous ce qu’il faut et la terrasse gros plus en tant que fumeur
Ou même pour prendre l’air , l’appartement était juste un peu plus petit que je l’imaginais et niveau confort c’est assez moyen le mobilier.
Il y a eu un problème de toilettes et de portes mais ils ont très vite réglé le soucis alors ça n’a pas dérangé mon séjour et Alba m’a beaucoup aidé et à su m’indiquer que faire et les bons emplacement après m’être fait voler mes affaires dans ma voitures(il ont pété ma vitre et volée toute mes affaires). Oui attention quand vous aller à Barcelone vous avez une chance sur cinq de vous faire voler un truc en temps que touriste si vous laissez votre voiture dans la rue prioriser les parkings payant (d’ailleurs c’est l’enfer d’être en voiture à Barcelone )… Un bon 4/5 car vous avez accès à tous facilement et que Alba ma sauvé mon séjour .
Es war sehr gut, und die Lage ist auch sect angenehm.

Pasamos unos días excelentes en el apartamento de Alba, todo muy limpio y ordenado , cómodo. Alba estuvo al pendiente en todo momento , muy servicial . El apartamento estaba cerca de la línea del metro y de los autobuses lo que nos facilitó poder movernos . Sin duda volvería a alojarme allí.
Super

The host was very friendly and available to help us with everything we needed, early check-in (if possible, it was for us 😂) luggage storage upon departure if we have a late departure, the room was clean and everything necessary was available, the metro and bus are a few minutes away, market and terraces near the location, Specifically, it was very good!

Nice apartment, in a very nice area. I met Albas husband who was extremely pleasant to speak to and very happy. Great air ventilation so no worries with the heat. The numbers on the front door keypad are a bit faded so it takes a few tries to type in the code when entering for the first time.
Estuvo bien

Alba est une hôte merveilleuse et disponible à n’importe quel moment, les informations d’accès au logement était parfaitement bien détaillées, le logement en lui même était très propre et sympathique. Le quartier est assez calme et il y a beaucoup de rues piétonnes ce qui est agréable !
Can’t recommend this apartment and location enough!

Wir hatten ein schönes Wochenende in Barcelona und Lyonel hat sehr schnell geantwortet, wenn wir Fragen hatten oder Ähnliches. Die Metro ist gut erreichbar und es sind viele tolle Restaurants in der Umgebung. Die Klimaanlage hat funktioniert und war bei den warmen Temperaturen wirklich gut, auch um nachts schlafen zu können.
Das Bad ist einfach und klein, aber es hat für ein Wochenende gut gepasst.
Beautiful place with great location! Lyonel was very kind and a great help. Definitely recommend!!

Bien situé car on peut tout faire à pied . Seul bémol en voiture compliqué de se garer c est que des parking payant.
Appartement très mignon et propre.
Nous avons passé une superbe semaine dans le logement de Lyonel. Le logement était propre, les instructions étaient claires. Je recommande fortement !
Vi var väldigt nöjda med lägenheten och bemötandet från värden. Väldigt fint läge och fin utsikt. Toppen! :)

Lyonel was very kind. The apartment itself has everything you need and feels cozy from the second you walk in. The air conditioning is great at keeping the Barcelona heat away. Overall the stay was pleasant and comfortable.
Très bon accueil de Lyonel. Quartier animer avec la Carrer de Blai à proximité où l'on peut prendre tapas et bière dans une rue piétonnisée agréable.
Bien
Gracias a Lyonel por alquilarnos su maravilloso piso donde pasamos una estancia muy agradable, recomiendo !
Eine wunderschöne Unterkunft. Größer als erwartet und viel Tageslichteinfluss. In der Küche ist alles was man braucht und die Wohnung ist sehr sauber :)
Really great place in a lively but quiet area.  Everything is really easy to reach by foot or public transport. Lyonel was always responsive and very helpful. Thank you!
This apartment was convenient and as described. Lyo was very helpful and met us at check-in to provide information about the apartment. The location was convenient and near nice local restaurants!

Endroit parfait avec un plus, la vue sur la Sagrada Família!
Merci pour ce séjour.
Muy lindo el piso, limpio y cómodo

The location of the apartment is excellent, providing easy access to transportation and making it convenient to explore the area, whether on foot or via public transit. Lyonel was particularly welcoming and accommodating, which significantly enhanced our overall experience.
The apartment itself is bright and small but it feels spacious.

Lyonel's apartment was cosy and clean. My partner and I loved the location as it was peaceful and very accessible at the same time.
Lyonel was very responsive and we were able to communicate promptly with him whenever we had questions.
We had a great stay!

Está diciendo que hemos destrozado el piso de malas maneras, faltando el respeto, etc.
Cosa que no es cierta. Grabamos el piso antes de la llegada y justo al salir.
Nos esta recriminando que hemos roto las plantas, cosa que es también mentira.

Grand appartement lumineux (pour Barcelone).  Super bien situé (tout se fait à pied ou en transport et commun) Meubles avec de l'âge, mais fonctionnel. Propreté correcte. Ascenseur fonctionne des fois oui, des fois non. À savoir comme au 4e étage.
Estadia tranquilo perto de comércio e restaurantes

We absolutely loved our stay at Phil and Fiona’s beautiful home in Gràcia. The location was perfect, central to everything we wanted to see and do in Barcelona, yet tucked away in a lovely, peaceful part of the neighbourhood that felt a world away from the busy city.
The house has clearly been so thoughtfully designed with guests in mind. Every space was functional, comfortable and had everything we could possibly need. It was the perfect accommodation for our family of four. The beds were incredibly comfortable, the shower was lovely, and the whole house was spotlessly clean.
One of the highlights for us was the nearby square, where our kids spent so much time playing and made friends with local children. They loved playing football and riding around on the scooters provided by Phil and Fiona, the scooters were thoroughly put to use throughout our sta
Heerlijke plek om tot rust te komen. In een fijne leuke buurt supermarkt dichtbij eet gelegenheden echt een top verblijf gehad!
Un lugar muy acogedor,y muy céntrico volvería sin dudarlo
Great place to stay. Characterful space, spacious & well-equipped, excellent location for exploring Gràcia. I would be very happy to stay here again.

This was our first time in Barcelona and we almost stayed in Eixample. That would have been a serious mistake. The neighborhood in Gràcia is so much more vibrant, with tons of things to do. We were there for 6 days, we walked everywhere and we didn't even make it to the Sagrada Familia.
As for the place itself: it is huge, it is beautiful, all the rooms are super well-isolated and have their own nice bathrooms, the kitchen was nice to cook in, it has secluded outdoor space, there were scooters for our kids to ride. We would 100% stay here again.
There were no problems with the air conditioning. I think other reviews complained of mildew smell: this was not something we experienced, but I do think you really have to pay attention to the instructions; we were very good about airing things out and everything was fine.
Do note the "cave" room doesn't have its own AC and can get toasty. Our kids still fought to be the one to sleep in there because it's so cool.
Agréable logement dans un quartier pittoresques de Barcelone proche du centre. Je recommande sans hésite.

We had an excellent stay at Phil and Fiona’s accommodation, they were very responsive and answered all questions in a friendly and timely manner. The apartment itself is furnished beautifully with everything one needs for short- and longer stays, we felt right at home!
On top of that the location is also amazing, it is quiet at night and within walking distance to bars, restaurants, stores and tourist attractions (they also provided a very handy booklet with guides on what you can do/visit).
I would definitely recommend booking this airbnb if you plan on visiting Barcelona.

Highly recommend! Lovely home, great neighborhood. Walkable, safe, fun. The house was so nice, the beds comfortable, air conditioning good, and they had personal touches with extras. Clean.  Hosts responded right away. Everything we needed for 4 adults, one child. Easy access to the Metro, shops, and the city. I would easily stay here again!
Great home, in a great location with great hosts. Very spacious and comfortable with good AC (except in the small bedroom at the front). Highly recommend it
The apartment is a hidden gem,fabulous location. So much more spacious than the photos suggest
Great location, hosts were very communicative, we would recommend!

Fabulous location in Gracia, near everything and with a supermarket located just in front of the house.
We loved the patio, but get some mosquito repellent because there are a few.
The owners were super kind and responsive too which we really appreciated.
The aircon in the bedrooms didn’t work (June) so it was really hot at night but there were fans.

We had an amazing time staying at Phil & Fiona’s place! It’s located close to the metro, and in a great neighborhood for shopping and dining. The house had everything we needed and was very well-organized and comfortable. 10 out of 10- we would stay again in a heartbeat!
Everything went very smooth and we very much enjoyed the Airbnb. Very spacious! Restaurant next door is fantastic

So there were 4 of us for this stay. We were happy with the location.
We had 2 issues that we believe needs to be addressed
1) 1st night staying…we stayed in the back bedroom and when I woke up in the morning I found a HUGE roach on floor of bathroom. At first I thought it was dead…boyfriend moved it into a ziplock bag I had packed and sealed it up…well let me tell you that roach wasn’t dead for at least 1 more day! I notified the owners right away with a pic of bug which I still have and the reply back was…we had pest control come in and spray!🤦‍♀️
2) there is ….hmmm what I’m calling a dampness smell? Mildew smell? Something that 3 of us could smell and it set off all of our noses..a LOT of coughing and sneezing during our stay.
While the place was conveniently located for us….I’d not stay there again
I honestly wasn’t happy 1 bit in the owners response to that HUGE roach! Totally gross and unacceptable

We liked the apartment. Its location, was excellent, the amenities were satisfactory and the list of local attractions, restaurants and facilities was very helpful. The next door Mexican restaurant, Kiltro, had great food, a terrific atmosphere and fun staff. Ask for Francisco and Frances.
A disappointment was the alfresco area, which needed a good cleanup. We only used it once. I also felt that the hosts were distant in messages, took time to respond and didn’t engage much when they did respond.
We did enjoy our stay and recommend the apartment to future travellers.

Merci à Phil et Fiona, et en particulier à Charlotte pour son accueil :)
L'appartement est idéalement situé, et parfait pour un groupe de 6 personnes comme le nôtre !

This was a last minute booking and was a great find for two of us. Big ground floor house in the centre of a really nice neighbourhood in Barcelona. Super quiet at night (except for a few birds in the morning 😂). Several really nice supermarkets within a five minute walk and same to get to the metro. There is a slight damp smell as you walk in but we opened the windows and it was no issue. I can highly recommend staying here. We felt safe in the neighbourhood and at night. Thanks Fiona and Phil.

Merci pour votre accueil pour notre séjour entre amis à Barcelona ! Excellent emplacement et logement confortable.
A noter que la chambre d’entrée donne sur la rue : mieux vaut prévoir bouchon d’oreille et masque de nuit.
So beautiful and great location! I would stay here again 100%

From the first moment we met with Vicky we felt at home and in good hands. Vicky speaks fluently english ad she is very responsive and ready to help. The apartment is as described . Nice clean with everithing you need in it. Complementary water and icecream in the fridge. Nice building with two elevators small but quick. My only regrets are that I didn't stay longer. Excelent conection with bus and subway anywhere you want to go. Super food oportunitys great bakerys all around. I would love to go back in th near future and stay at Vicky's place. Highly recomend.

The place was amazing, very close to a lot of good restaurants, and a walkable distance to attractions and with a beautiful view.
Vicky was a great host, very friendly and very helpful. I would recommend staying at her place if you’re visiting Barcelona.

We really liked everything. Great location, with everything you need nearby. Restaurants, stores, public transportation. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. It has everything you need. Vicky and her assistant are quick and easy to communicate with. They are always available.

Was a great stay and Vicky is a lovely host who communicated with us very well.
Location is easy to walk to Placa Españya and straight forward from there.
Vicky siempre atenta y amable, sus indicaciones y disponibilidad excelentes. El apartamento céntrico, limpio y con todos los servicios
Lovely balcony with great view of Mt Tibidabo & Temple Expiatori del Sagrat Cor.

Excelente relación precio-calidad. Los taxis llegan en un minuto y muy tranquilo para descansar después de un dia de caminatas.
Muy buena opción como punto clave para visitar los lugares de interés en Barcelona.

The apartment is really great, with absolutely everything you could need for your stay! A big bonus is the gorgeous terrace with its beautiful city views. It’s a perfect spot for sunset lovers, as you can enjoy the sunset right from the terrace.
The location is excellent, with plenty of supermarkets, cafés and public transport nearby. The host is also very friendly and helpful.
A great place offering excellent value for money. We would definitely recommend it!

We had a lovely time and Vicky made sure to communicate clearly and promptly. The kitchen was fully equipped and the terrace was great for a late afternoon glass of wine!
Thank you Vicky for your kindness and hospitality. ✨

The place was nice. Good location.  Very clean and cozy. Vicky and her father were awesome host, they answered promptly to all of our questions. The only thing I would say is that the onlyl air conditioner in the living room is not enough to cool down any of the bedrooms or the kitchen . The minute fan in the main bedroom was not sufficient to cool down the bedroom, even after we left the door open. The ceiling fan in the other bedroom was not enough to cool down either.  We had to close the door that connects the living room  to the kitchen and the other bedroom to have a comfortable temperature.  My son  could not sleep in the additional bedroom. Besides this the apartment was to our satisfaction.
Enjoyed our stay. Highly recommended

We thoroughly enjoyed staying in Vicky's apartment. Very clean, comfortable, good location especially if one needs to be near Montjuic. Vicky was very helpful and professional. I highly recommend this place and the hostess.

Vicky’s place was beautiful and had great views! Nice location that’s easy to get around and peaceful! Air con could be a little stronger however, but we did go during the peak of summer. Very helpful to have a lift and laundry facilities.

Amazing attic apartment in a lovely area..host was very responsive at all times..balcony was lovely with an amazing view .the area was very nice and walkable to plaza espanya which is lovely..plenty of places to eat drink and shops..would 100% recommend..in fact I definitely will be returning
Le séjour était parfait ! Vicky est une hôte réactive et accueillante avec un logement idéal pour Barcelone.

Vicky's apartment was perfect and cozy. Great location with lots of restaurants, bakeries and supermarket nearby. Transportation was within walking distance as well. Vicky was wonderful with proactive communication and helped check us in. Highly recommend!
干净整洁的房间，还有很好的阳台，出入便利，周边餐厅很多，去火车站，地铁站都比较方便，推荐

Staying at Vicky’s place was absolutely amazing. From the moment we arrived, someone greeted us, showed us around, and explained everything we needed to know. Communication was excellent throughout our stay & they were extremely responsive, helpful, and flexible.
The apartment was spacious and exactly as described. While it’s not located in the city center, the metro and bus stops are very easy to access, making it simple to get around Barcelona. We also enjoyed being in a more local neighborhood rather than a tourist-heavy area.
One of our favorite features was the large balcony. We spent every morning drinking coffee and reading outside, and it was such a peaceful way to start the day. The hosts also provided great local recommendations, which made our stay even better.
The apartment has one AC unit in the main living area, so the bedrooms can get a little warm at night during hotter weather, but this was a minor issue overall.
We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely stay again!

Siisti, kaunis ja tyylikäs ylimmän kerroksen huoneisto, jossa oli tilava terassi sisäpihan puolella. Keittiötä emme juurikaan käyttäneet, mutta se vaikutti siistiltä ja hyvin varustellulta. Kaksi wc:tä/kylpyhuonetta helpotti kolmen naisen elämää ja aikatauluja.
Saman peiton alla nukkuminen jonkun muun kuin oman puolison kanssa tuntuu omassa kulttuurissamme oudolta, joten pyysimme lisää lakanoita, joita toiseksi yöksi saimmekin.
Kaikenkaikkiaan kuitenkin todella upea asunto, joka vastasi kuvia ja kuvausta. Sijainti on hyvä ja vaikka asunto on suuren ja meluisan kadun varrella olevassa talossa, sijainti sisäpihan puolella teki siitä hiljaisen. Suosittelemme.

L'appartement de Vicky est vraiment très agréable et très silencieux. Il est très fonctionnel, très lumineux. Très bien placé (5mn à pieds du métro Hostafrancs), tellement mieux que cette insupportable Plaça Espanya. Je recommande vraiment cet appartement!
Bonito lugar para alojamiento, de fácil acceso
We loved our stay here! The location was super convenient and easy to get to, and the host was so friendly and helpful. Everything was great and we would definitely recommend staying here! 5/5 ⭐️

El apartamento de Laia está bien localizado, a una cuadra del metro y si quieres caminar también es agradable. La estancia para mí y mis hijos estuvo muy buena. Además que hay ascensor. Agradezco a Laila porque responde rápido las dudas.
Excelente estadía, el apartamento es tal cual su descripción! Laia es muy buena host, super clara y pendiente. Muy recomendable!

One of the best AirBnB experiences i have ever had. Hosts were friendly, apartment and kitchen had everything we needed, perfect location right next to the Metro in a great area with tons to do. Highly recommend staying here!

Nous venons de passer 10 jours à 5 cinq dans ce logement, et ce fut un excellent séjour. L'appartement est propre, bien agencé, bien équipé, et placé dans un quartier agréable.
Nous avons apprécié l'emplacement, puisqu'on peut se rendre facilement à pieds dans le centre. Pour les activités plus éloignées, le métro se trouve juste au bout de la rue.
Les hôtes se sont montrés très disponibles et la communication avec eux était très agréable.

We had a wonderful stay, The apartment is in a very quiet and beautiful area, and the location is excellent. The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Communication through Airbnb was easy and clear, and the check-in instructions were simple to follow. We would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Barcelona.
Excellent logement, à proximité du centre et très proche du métro. Appartement propre et bien agencé, bien équipé et rénové. Convient parfaitement à 4 personnes.
We loved the apartment and the location. The hosts left us great recommendations and made it easy for us to orient and get around.
Tutto corrispondeva a quanto descritto e Laia è sempre stata disponibile
Muy recomendable, todo mas que bien. Bien equipado para 4 personas, a escasos metros del Metro. Muy limpio y ordenado.

Muy conformes en todos los aspectos. Excelente comunicación y facilidades en el check in.
Apartamento amplio, limpio, con todo lo necesario para cocinar y desayunar. Silencioso a pesar de estar en el centro de gracia.
I would totally recommend staying at Laia’s place if you have 3 or more people. Very clean and had all the amenities that are needed. The metro is a 2 min walk away which made the location perfect.
Appartement très facile d’accès, à quelques mètres du mètre ligne 4. Très propre, bien agencé. Très bien pour 4 personnes. Un peu juste pour 5 adultes.

Realmente una excelente experiencia, desde nuestra llegada hasta nuestra partida nos sentimos como en casa.
Lugar súper recomendable y entorno muy disfrutable.
Laia siempre atenta y nos atendió todas las necesidades, excelente anfitriona!
apartamento perfecto para pasar unos días en Barcelona. Barrio con muchos servicios y cómodo alojamiento
Feels like home!! The environment was well-furnished and comfortable. Really responsive and helpful host. Would definitely revisit the place! 無得頂！👍

The place itself is ok, and it was clean.
Rooms are very small and not perfectly furnished.
The bathroom was also very small.
Laia was very kind and gentle

The apartment is close to subway, has lots of restaurants and grocery stores around. There're three single beds in total which is a decent price for the location and amount of people they can have. There were no AC in the bedrooms, AC is only in the living room.
The only issue is that there were very limited usable outlets for charging (a lot of them were blocked by giant furnitures etc.) Everything else was nice and exactly like the picture.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour en famille ( 3 et 7 ans). Une aire de jeux juste en bas.
Appartement fidèle à sa description, propre et bien placé. Je recommande.

Wij verbleven 3 dagen in de flat van Mireira. We werden hartelijk ontvangen, gezellig ingerichte flat, in een rustige buurt waar toch veel te beleven valt. Vlotte communicatie met onze gastvrouw.  Een aanrader. Wij komen nog terug.

My wife and I had a wonderful time in Mireia's apartment and in the neighborhood. Our stay was during the Fiesta Mayor de Gràcia, one of a kind experience.
Our co-host Lola was one of a kind as well. A very lovely lady, who was always ready to help.
Overall I recommend it with both hands.
Unser Aufenthalt in dem wunderschönen Apartment war sehr schön! Die Lage ist perfekt. Die Kommunikation war ganz hervorragend. Wir fanden alles ganz toll. ❤️ Dankeschön

La estancia ha sido increíble! Hemos disfrutado mucho y nos hemos sentido en casa en todo momento. Además que se encuentra en una zona súper tranquila y céntrica, así que teníamos muchas cosas a disposición de nosotros. Sin duda volveremos. Gracias por todo 🫶🏽✨

Wir waren sehr enttäuscht von der Wohnung. Aufgrund der Fotos haben wir eine saubere Wohnung und insbesondere ein modernes Bad erwartet. Beides traf nicht ein. Die Wohnung war nicht sauber und ein Geruch von Zigaretten hing überall. Auch die Handtücher haben gestunken und es war sehr unangenehm zu duschen. Auch der Boden war unsauber: auf den Ablageflächen und Sitzkissen war es teils staubig oder fleckig. Dazu lag in einer Schüssel in der Küche ein Haar und das Licht im Bad flackerte. Immerhin war Mireia sehr nett in der Kommunikation und hat uns eine erneute Reinigung angeboten. Wir sind dann eine Nacht früher abgereist und haben diese eine Nacht zurückerstattet bekommen.

Le logement est très conforme aux photos, cependant comme l’indique les commentaires précédents l’arrivée ne s’est pas passée comme prévue. J’ai attendu quasiment une heure devant l’immeuble, sans aucune indication d’où sonner à l’interphone (3-1 pour les prochains). J’ai attendu devant alors que je suis arrivée à l’heure indiquée, et Lola m’a accueillie en me disant que j’étais en retard (non, je n’avais simplement aucune info, j’ai appelé l’hôte 7x, j’ai envoyé 3 sms). Demandez bien les infos en amont !!
We loved our stay at Mireia's place. The apartment was beautiful and the location was great. Would highly recommend!

authentic Barcelona...  we loved rinsing out small clothing and hanging out to dry in the sun on a clothesline...   late night outdoor dining in the middle of the neighborhood ...  the feeling was family and safe..

I am grateful have found Mireia’s place for a quick 18 hours in the city before heading back to the airport. It was a perfect spot for an evening stroll to the Sagrada & catching up on rest. Very easy to communicate with and get checked in, etc.

Die Unterkunft war super schön und zweckmäßig eingerichtet, gut zu erreichen, sauber und wir haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt. Die Kommunikation mit Miranda war gut und hilfreich. Es hat uns an nichts gefehlt. Gerne wieder.

The space was comfortable and stylish.  We were able to get around Barcelona from there easily on foot and by Uber when needed.  There were restaurants and grocery very close.  Mireia was a pleasant, thoughtful host.

This was the perfect spot for our Barcelona vacation. We felt right at home. Very welcoming. The kitchen had everything we needed for a leisurely breakfast before heading out on our adventures. The location is in a fabulous neighbourhood that allowed us to walk to everything we wanted to see…we do like to walk…but public transit is also very close. We had a rental car and could park right next door to the apartment. Very convenient. The bathroom was a little small, but to be expected in an older building. The furniture is comfortable and the decor was so much fun. I would highly recommend staying here.
The location is perfect, the apartment absolutely beautiful, and the host is very kind. Mireia was very responsive, and shout out to Lola for being awesome!
这套民宿非常好住。房东非常热情。床很舒适。

Perfetto per chi vuole scoprire Barcellona senza dover necessariamente alloggiare nel centro città, ma ad un passo da questo.
La posizione permette di raggiungere anche a piedi le bellezze cittadine soggiornando in un quartiere davvero autentico e vivo che abbiamo molto apprezzato.
Tutto è andato per il meglio .Alla prossima e grazie molte

I absolutely LOVED this airbnb. So much character, great decor, cozy, in an incredible location and fun neighborhood and SO dog friendly. They had treats and towels and water waiting for my little guy. Elevator is a huge plus. Loved the balcony. Tea and coffee supplied and well-appointed kitchen. Only thing to mention is that there is no shampoo or conditioner, so plan to bring your own. (There are numerous supermercats within two minutes to pick some up.) Would 100% stay here again.
Súper bonito, muy ubicado y te sientes dentro de la vida de Barcelona
We loved staying here! Has everything you need and in a great location.

Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Lola dès notre arrivée. Très bon emplacement dans le quartier gracia de Barcelone à deux pas de la Sagrada família.
Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans ce logement.

appartamento molto carino con tutto il necessario per un bel soggiorno. Quartiere molto bello. Noi nel letto siamo stati comodi ma forse 2 persone molto grandi stanno un po strette. Mireia e Lola molto carine

Séjour agréable, proche métro.
Instructions claires.

Alles super. Tolle Ausgangslage für Unternehmungen, gute Infrastruktur mit Markt, Supermarkt, Bäcker und Restaurants. Nur 3 Minuten zur Metrostation. Nur 30 Minuten vom Flughafen. Man fühlt sich ausserdem sehr sicher und Alba ist eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin. Ich würde jederzeit wieder kommen.

The cleanest airbnb i’ve been so far.
The place is big enough for two and our luggages. Easy to find, good location, close to Camp nou and next to a Metro that connects to everything.
Alba is very sweet and paid great attention to us. Would definetely recommend.

L’hôte est accueillante, les instructions sont claires, l’appartement en lui-même est propre, confortable et climatisé.
Nous avons passés un très bon séjour.
Pas de problème correspondait à l’annonce nous avons passé un très bon séjour.

The apartment is very clean, spacious, exactly the way it is shown in the pictures. Instructions are very clear. Overall I'm very happy for the experience with Alba's place, sadly we couldn't stayed more due to work schedule. If you're looking for a place where you can go visit attractions very easily, cook and also very quiet area, her place is gonna fit for you very well. Muchas gracias Alba, if the opportunity to come back again to Barcelona comes, I'll try my best to come again to your place!

Alloggio perfetto, in una posizione comoda e tranquilla. La metro è molto vicina e consente di spostarsi ovunque. La zona ha attorno mercati, negozi, ristoranti. Alba è davvero gentile, educata, disponibile e chiara nelle indicazioni che ci ha fornito. Se dovessimo tornare a Barcellona, prenoteremo di nuovo lì! ⭐

Lovely flat in a quiet area. Plenty shops, restaurants nearby. Collblanc Metro is a 5 min walk away giving excellent access to the City Centre and the Airport.
Great base for exploring.
The host is very nice and responsive, the place is very clean and easy to get around
Tutto perfetto tranne un po la terrazza che non avevamo capito fosse condivisa

Alba was a very helpful and responsive host. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. The location was very handy and just a short walk to the metro station. Would definitely recommend!

J’ai passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement à Barcelone Le logement très propre et parfaitement entretenu. Le rapport qualité-prix est vraiment excellent. J’ai été très satisfait de mon séjour et je recommande vivement cet appartement. Merci pour cet accueil !

Tous les éléments indiqué était bien présents il y a tous ce qu’il faut et la terrasse gros plus en tant que fumeur
Ou même pour prendre l’air , l’appartement était juste un peu plus petit que je l’imaginais et niveau confort c’est assez moyen le mobilier.
Il y a eu un problème de toilettes et de portes mais ils ont très vite réglé le soucis alors ça n’a pas dérangé mon séjour et Alba m’a beaucoup aidé et à su m’indiquer que faire et les bons emplacement après m’être fait voler mes affaires dans ma voitures(il ont pété ma vitre et volée toute mes affaires). Oui attention quand vous aller à Barcelone vous avez une chance sur cinq de vous faire voler un truc en temps que touriste si vous laissez votre voiture dans la rue prioriser les parkings payant (d’ailleurs c’est l’enfer d’être en voiture à Barcelone )… Un bon 4/5 car vous avez accès à tous facilement et que Alba ma sauvé mon séjour .
Es war sehr gut, und die Lage ist auch sect angenehm.

Pasamos unos días excelentes en el apartamento de Alba, todo muy limpio y ordenado , cómodo. Alba estuvo al pendiente en todo momento , muy servicial . El apartamento estaba cerca de la línea del metro y de los autobuses lo que nos facilitó poder movernos . Sin duda volvería a alojarme allí.
Super

The host was very friendly and available to help us with everything we needed, early check-in (if possible, it was for us 😂) luggage storage upon departure if we have a late departure, the room was clean and everything necessary was available, the metro and bus are a few minutes away, market and terraces near the location, Specifically, it was very good!

Nice apartment, in a very nice area. I met Albas husband who was extremely pleasant to speak to and very happy. Great air ventilation so no worries with the heat. The numbers on the front door keypad are a bit faded so it takes a few tries to type in the code when entering for the first time.
Estuvo bien

Alba est une hôte merveilleuse et disponible à n’importe quel moment, les informations d’accès au logement était parfaitement bien détaillées, le logement en lui même était très propre et sympathique. Le quartier est assez calme et il y a beaucoup de rues piétonnes ce qui est agréable !

Eduard siempre estuvo atento, proactivamente nos consultó si estaba todo bien o si necesitábamos algo.
Al salir, olvidé una maleta en el alojamiento y por suerte Eduard tenía un plan de contingencia para solucionarlo al instante.
Fantástico

Чудесно място и локация!
Собственикът е много отзивчив и приветлив.
Апартаментът беше безупречно чист!
Бяхме трима човека,настанени на голяма спалня и походно легло.Може би още една завивка щеше да е полезна,тъй-като бяхме трима възрастни,а не двойка с дете.
Може би много дребни неща като неработещи лампи и отдушник, но не беше въобще проблем.
Бяхме подканени да преведем в добър вид апартамента и да изхвърлим боклука, извиняваме се но последния ден не успяхме за боклука,защото имахме доста ръчен багаж и определен час за напускане 11.00 ч.
Оставихме прибрани нещата.
Оценката ни е много висока и пак бихме се върнали,успех на Едуард!
Great apartment value for money, safe area for a family, plenty to do around.I'll comeback for sure.
Great stay for a decent price. Really good host aswell
Perfect please for a couple of days
El espacio es muy cómodo y la ubicación es fantástica. Ampliamente recomendado
El departamento es exactamente como se describe en la publicación. La ubicación es muy buena para un turista, pues todo quedaba a distancia caminable.

A cozy place located in the center of Barcelona, walking distance from most shops and attractions. Eduard was very responsive and kind, providing us with recommendations and checking in on us everyday of our stay ensuring our comfort.

Terrible experience! We got to the apartment and people were already inside.  We sent messages and call Eduard and he did not answer. We contacted Airbnb and they could not contact the host either!! After three hours we had to go to a hotel and pay excessive fees.
we will be back ❤️

El apartamento está ubicado en una excelente zona, muy cerca del barrio gótico y la plaza Catalunya. El transporte es bastante fácil. El apartamento es grande, iluminado y cómodo, el baño también es muy grande. La comunicación con Eduard fue excelente, pudimos entrar un poco antes al apartamento lo cual le agradezco mucho, todo fue perfecto, sin duda volveremos 😁
Eduard communicated early and provided helpful suggestions.  The location is excellent; the Metro and bus stops are steps away.  Our experience was wonderful.
nos gusto mucho la ubicacion todo muy limpio y ordenado

Eduard is an exceptional host. He's a great communicator and very attentive. My high school graduate and four fellow graduates traveled alone to Europe and Barcelona was their first stop. Eduard was very helpful and hospitable.  The apartment was just as described--spacious, well maintained, and centrally located. I'd highly recommend staying at this apartment, on behalf our my son and his friends!
가격대는 조금 비싸지만 정말 좋은 곳입니다! 위치가 훌륭하고, 맞은 편에 클럽이 있어 새벽에 시끄러운 것만 빼면 아주 만족스럽습니다!!
Nos encantó la ubicación y Edu fue muy atencioso y amable!
Awesome spot in the city. Our host Edu was so responsive and helpful. He gave lots of recommendations, and he was helpful with any questions we had. I would totally recommend booking this Airbnb.

Ev konumu itibari ile gayet iyi bir yerde çoğunlukla her yere yürüyebiliyorsunuz. Semt güzel ve güvenli. Ev sahibi Eduard her konuda yardımcı oluyor. Ev temiz ve içi gayet güzel. Biz konaklarken çok keyif aldık ve rahattık.
La ubicación excelente y nos dio toda la info no solo del Depto si no donde comer y que visitar en la zona! Eduard muy amable
Parfait

Perfekte Lage für einen Barcelona Aufenthalt. Metro Station Arc de Triomf fußläufig zu erreichen. Wohnung liegt an einer ruhigen Seitenstraße. Parc de Ciutadella in unmittelbarer Nähe. Geschmackvolle und gemütliche Wohnung. Alles vorhanden, was man braucht. Die Wohnungsübergabe verlief sehr gut. Wir konnten die Koffer eher abstellen.  Die Eigentümer sind sehr sympathisch.
Maria and Ed’s place was fantastic! Great location in Barcelona and such a homey apartment.

This was a great find for the location and walkability. The place is slightly smaller than we thought it would be from the photos. We also did not see that the place DOES NOT have AC and we were staying amidst the heat wave in August with a 1 year old… who was very unhappy temperature wise at night. Completely our fault for not seeing that detail. So travelers be wary if you’re used to AC. We would return in cooler months for sure!

Perfect place in Barcelona, easy to walk everywhere and metro/ train line very close by. Eduard was super friendly and recommended great places and a local restaurant for tapas which was amazing. Easy to meet him for keys, explained everything really well.  Plenty of space, lots for kids to do in the apartment.  Would stay again and highly recommend!

This was a beautiful flat! My children really enjoyed the games and toys in the living room and kid’s room. It was perfect for our family. Unfortunately, during our stay my husband had a medical problem and needed to go to the hospital. Édouard was so kind and offered help and assistance. I was very moved by his kindness.

We had a great time here. Friendly and helpful hosts, comfortable furniture and close to transport links. Quiet area, nearby shops and a nice cafe just below the apartment meant we had everything we needed. Ed was brilliant in explaining everything we would need!
We could not recommend highly enough and would stay here again no problem. 😌
The host was very helpful and welcoming, and the AirBnB is in a great walkable location, perfect to explore Barcelona

Eduard was a lovely host, let us drop our bags early. He was kind and gave us fantastic tips. I had a couple of concerns and they were quickly rectified as best as possible. All communications were pleasant.
Casa in posizione strategica , comunicazione chiare e rapide e flessibilità sull’arrivo e partenza!

Tres bel accueil . L appartement est magnifique, et l emplacement parfait.
Nous y reviendrons si nous devons séjourner de nouveau a Barcelone !

Nydelig og sjarmerende leilighet med perfekt beliggenhet. Basisvarer tilgjengelig og supermarked rett ved siden av. Hyggelig og oppmerksom vert som ordnet slik at vi fikk sjekket inn rett etter ankomst i Barcelona.
Gute Lage, Haus und Wohnung etwas in die Jahre gekommen dennoch bequeme Betten, sauber. Preis Leistung völlig in Ordnung
very willing to flex check-in when my train was delayed three hours

Great location and good amount of space to feel like you are living in Barcelona, as a local. We didn't get the chance to meet Maria but Eduard was here to meet us at both check-in and check-out. Very friendly and helpful. We loved the location close to the Ciutadella park and El Born. It feels like a home which is good. Just a little bit too cluttered with personal things for our personal taste but most people would love that. The living room is the best spot because its where you get all the day light. All the best to Eduard and his family.

We loved staying at your apartment. Eduardo was very friendly and accomodating! The apartment had everything we needed - kitchen was well equiped and we enjoyed the bottle of wine waiting for us upon arrival.
The location was great - easy access to public transportation and walkable to the old town. Nancy & John

Our family of 4 had a enjoyable stay.  There are games/toys for kids, fans worked great to cool down rooms, washing machine was perfect, no outside noises (I am a light sleeper) and communicative hosts.  There is a juice/coffee shop right next door. We had a lovely time.

Great stay in Barcelona!  We went for the Formula 1 race.  The Apartment was very comfortable and had everything you might need.  The location is super convenient to the Metro and easy walking distance to shops and restaurants.  Recommended!

Our family wasn't in Barcelona long, but we truly enjoyed our stay here. Extremely kid friendly. Toys to entertain and cups, bowls, etc that were kid safe too. This apartment is walkable to A LOT of what the city has to offer. We enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this place, especially if you're a family with young children.
Great host!
Beautiful place, located right in the core!
Appartement confortable et bien situé.
El apartamento está excelentemente bien ubicado, cerca del metro, con tiendas y farmacias a unos pasos. Todo excelnte

Нормальный вариант для проживания в Барселоне, в пешей доступности Рамбла , пляж и архитектура Гауди
Но довольно дорого, есть вопросы к чистоте
Хозяин отвечает быстро
Городской налог не включен в стоимость что усложняет проживание в виду необходимости посюиска точной суммы наличных денег
Сойдет, если ищете жилье в августе в последний момент
Нет никакого вида из окна
Из плюсов : кофе машина, удобное расположение
Het appartement van Jacques is enorm fijn! Genoeg ruimte, mooie en ruime badkamer. De communicatie met Jacques was ook heel fijn. Aanrader !! ☀️🐠
Appartamento molto ospitale, pulito e in una zona veramente comoda. Jaques ci ha aiutato con tutto in tempi veramente molto brevi di risposta.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour à Barcelone dans l'appartement de Jacques (nous étions 3). L'appartement est très bien situé : à proximité du métro et des diverses lignes de bus. En bas de l'appartement, il y a des petites rues animées le soir où on peut facilement se restaurer. De plus, il y a beaucoup de commerces aux alentours. L'appartement est pour autant calme, reposant et climatisé.
C'est une très bonne adresse que je conserve pour un éventuel prochain séjour à Barcelone et que je recommanderai à mes amis.
Merci aussi pour les informations de Jacques concernant le trajet aéroport à l'appartement (nous avons prix l'aérobus : c'est très pratique).
Michèle
Thank you Jacques, you were very hospitable and kind. The apartment is well located and easy accesible to the metro line.

Good central location! It’s an easy walk to the Boqueria Market and about 20 minutes to the beach. The place was acceptable, but the powerful AC and the host made our stay much better. Cleanliness can be improved. Thanks for having us.
Communicative, helpful, and very nice! Thanks for your hospitality.

Jacques was super quick to respond and was very accommodating when we ended up arriving a little later than planned. Although our check-in time was later in the day than when we arrived, he allowed us to drop off our things so we didn't have to bring our luggage around the city with us. The apartment is super close to one of the bus routes (which was perfect for going to the beach) and to a metro station. It made traveling around the city super easy. There were plenty of good bars and places to eat in the neighborhood, too.
Jacques is very attentive and answered all my questions on time.

Pros- Jacques accommodation was in a great location. Seconds from the metro connecting you to the main city and grocery store, restraunts and shops all steps away. 2 bedrooms and a futon bed that were fairly comfortable to sleep on. Equipped with espresso machine and full kitchen. Big bathroom with enough hot water for 3 people to shower after one another.
Cons- not super clean- the bed sheets didn’t seem washed to be honest and there was pieces of sand and some sort of bug in the double bed (not a bedbug I don’t think). The pillowcases were dirty and we had to put t shirts over top of them to keep them clean. The walls and bed frames were quite dirty as well. The accommodation also needs more pillows for 3 beds. Slightly overpriced once mandatory tourist tax is added on.
Overall I did enjoy this accommodation but could be improved with more thorough cleaning.

Jacques and Aline's place was a lovely stay for us to explore Barcelona. It's located in the Poble Sec neighborhood which gives you a more authentic feel of the city away from the more touristy neighborhoods while still being within walking distance of the sights. Photos were accurate and Jacques kindly was very flexible to accommodate our arrival and departure times.

Apartment layout is quirky. Two bedrooms, neither had windows although light did come in from adjacent rooms. Washing machine broken. Kitchen cramped
