That said, we enjoyed our stay, especially the location.
Our plane arrived in the morning. Jacques allowed us to bring our luggage to the apartment prior to the 4pm check in.
I wish the visitor taxes were included in the price.
It was a great location and very nice communication.

Appartement bien aménagé, spacieux, offrant un confort satisfaisant pour un séjour à Barcelone.
Notre fille a pu avoir un super lit, avec une chaise haute et même quelques jouets! C'était super!
L'appartement peut être humide, ce qui est propre à ces constructions espagnoles.
(et zut, des taxes de séjour un peu élevée...)
Merci pour tout.
Très bonne communication avec Jacques, qui a été très arrangeant pour les horaires d'arrivée et de départ.

Excelente lugar para quedarse en Barcelona, cerca a todo, el apartamento estaba muy bien dotado, detalles a destacar: Camilo siempre estuvo disponible ayudándonos desde nuestra llegada hasta la salida; aseo perfecto; café disponible y básicos de cocina. Muy recomendable !!!
Die Unterkunft war gut gelegen, nahe Bars, Bus und Metro. Die Kommunikation mit dem Host war sehr gut, sehr unkompliziert und er war super freundlich. Wir hatten eine gute Zeit.

Pro:
• Perfekte Lage – alles ist sehr gut erreichbar. Shoppingmöglichkeiten und Sightseeing-Spots befinden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe.
• Sehr freundlicher und hilfsbereiter Besitzer.
• Die Kommunikation war jederzeit schnell und problemlos.
• In der Wohnung ist alles vorhanden, was man für den Aufenthalt braucht – sogar mehr Ausstattung als in vielen anderen Ferienwohnungen.
Contra:
• Die Wohnung ist leider sehr hellhörig. Wenn Nachbarn eine Party machen oder laut sind, bekommt man das deutlich mit.
• Die Wohnung befindet sich im 1. Obergeschoss und ist daher nicht für gehbehinderte Menschen geeignet. Es wäre sinnvoll, diesen Hinweis deutlicher in der Beschreibung aufzunehmen.
Fazit:
Im Großen und Ganzen war es ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt. Die Lage ist hervorragend und der Besitzer ausgesprochen nett und hilfsbereit.
Great apartment with easy access to public transportation. Wonderful and friendly host! We have enjoyed our stay here

Moi et mon conjoint avons adoré notre séjour chez Mireya.
Beau studio fonctionnel.
Il y a un marché vraiment proche, beaucoup d’endroits où déjeuner le matin et prendre un bon café.
Le quartier est plutôt tranquille situé près de deux lignes de métro.
Beaucoup de petites attentions dans le logement 💕.
Elle nous a donné de très bonnes suggestions sur des choses à voir et endroit ou manger.
L’appartement était super propre, les draps et serviettes sentaient vraiment bons.
Si j’avais une petite suggestion : plus de lumières d’ambiance et de couvertures plus épaisses ☺️ mais ça ne m’empêcherait pas d’y retourner.
Merci énormément de nous avoir accueilli!
Excelente alojamiento para una buena experiencia en Barcelona

Mireya è stata estremamente gentile e disponibile, la casa era perfetta e confortevole. I servizi perfetti, siamo state dotate di davvero qualsiasi cosa.
Consigliatissima!
Mireya’s place is in a great location, very close to the metro and convenient for getting to the main attractions. Mireya was also very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend staying here!

Logement conforme à sa description, propre et confortable. Mireya reste à notre disposition pendant tout le long du séjour. En revanche prévoyez environ 45 minutes pour atteindre le centre de Barcelone depuis l’appartement.
Todo como en la descripción del alojamiento, Mireya es excelente anfitrión de verdad.

Mireya’s place was perfect for me for a quick one night stay while I was traveling. I came in on the train and walked to the place easily and then it was a very short ride to the airport in the morning. I also would’ve been happy to stay here for a longer trip. The apartment is small but well laid out for two or three people. It has terrific amenities, thoughtful decor, and is in a vibrant neighborhood. Mireya was extremely friendly and helpful. I enjoyed meeting with her and appreciated her kindness.

Nous avons passé 3 jours dans le logement de mireya avec plaisir
La literie est très confortable
L'appartement est soigné
Un style très sympa
Mon épouse,moi,et notre petite fille de 15 ans sommes ravis.
Proche du bus et métro pour un un accès total à Barcelone.
Mireya a pensé a tout
En plus le petit déjeuner est prévu.
Le quartier est sympa, authentique proche
5 minutes a pied du mercat nou avec mercadona pour les courses.
Et café,bar , restaurant a quelques Pas...
Je le conseille sans aucun soucis
Merci a bientôt j'espère.
Samuel isabelle anna

巴塞罗那的住宿相比欧洲其他城市其他国家，是真的没有性价比，不是针对老板。
房子在一楼，稍微有点吵和气味。老板提供了很多物品，特别是对女生友好。除了贵，整体还好吧。

Appartamento molto carino, piccolo ma perfetto per 3 persone. Tutto in ordine e perfettamente funzionante. Mieya sempre gentile e disponibile anche per consigli non inerenti all'appartamento (luoghi da visitare, dove mangiare ecc).
Zona leggermente periferica ma comodissima ai trasporti pubblici (2 fermate della metro vicine e diversi autobus).
Da non perdere!

Excelente lugar y anfitrion. Siempre pendiente de cualquier detalle.
Zona muy accesible con conexiones para movilizarse a diferentes lugares turisticos.

Muy buen alojamiento, metro cerca y diferentes comercios. Mireya a sido súper atenta y muy buena anfitriona. Si buscas un alojamiento bien comunicado con el centro, tranquilo y con una gran anfitriona este es tu lugar. Gracias por todo mireya un saludo, si volvemos a Barcelona repetiremos en tu alojamiento sin pensarlo.

Mireya is nothing short of an incredible host. We were truly so grateful for her. We never thought that an Airbnb host could make you feel so comforted. She had incredible amenities and constantly communicated everything with us. She gave us the most incredible recommendations and always was so accessible if we had any questions. I have no doubt I’m coming back to Barcelona, and I specifically want to stay at Mireya’s place again. She is truly one of a kind and I  can’t wait to stay in her place again next year. If you are thinking of booking this place, please do!! It’s an amazing location so close to the metro, super cozy and super amazing with the best host.

Gostamos muito da nossa estadia em Barcelona no apartamento da Mireya. Ela foi uma anfitriã excelente, sempre atenciosa e prestativa, fazendo com que nos sentíssemos muito bem-vindos. O apartamento correspondeu às expectativas e contribuiu para uma experiência maravilhosa na cidade. Recomendo com satisfação!

We had a lovely time at Mireya's. The apartment is very well located near the subway in an authentic and cosy neighborhood. The apartment is very welcoming and equiped. We particularly enjoyed the mini courtyard that was perfect for breakfast and to play safely for our baby. Mireya was really welcoming and helpful.
El departamento estaba excelente, muy limpio y con todas las comodidades. Nos sentimos como en casa. Y Mireya nos brindo una atencion excelente, muy buena persona. Sin duda volveremos a ir.

L’appartement de Mireya est juste parfait: confortable, très propre et idéalement situé dans un quartier authentique et super agréable.
Mireya est pleine de petites attentions très appréciables, nous reviendrons c’est sur!
Merci pour tout :)

Mireya responded very quickly. She warmly welcomed us in person and prepared many maps and handwritten notes about the neighborhood, which made us instantly feel immersed in Barcelona’s warm and vibrant atmosphere.
The location of the apartment is very convenient. Most of the famous attractions can be reached within 20 minutes, and it is very close to two metro lines, so you can easily choose the route that best suits your plans. Mireya is one of the warmest hosts I have ever met—responsible, attentive, and full of enthusiasm.🥰💕

Abbiamo avuto il piacere di soggiornare in questo appartamento a Barcellona e l’esperienza è stata davvero eccellente. L’alloggio è completo di tutti i comfort: Mireya ha pensato davvero a tutto, mettendo a disposizione qualsiasi cosa possa servire durante il soggiorno. Abbiamo trovato anche bevande e tutto l’occorrente per la colazione, un’attenzione che abbiamo apprezzato molto.
L’appartamento è inoltre in una posizione comoda, ben collegata alla metro, che permette di raggiungere facilmente tutti i principali punti di interesse della città.
Mireya e suo marito si sono dimostrati sempre disponibili, gentili e premurosi. Un gesto che abbiamo particolarmente apprezzato è stata la possibilità di lasciare i bagagli anche l’ultimo giorno, permettendoci di goderci Barcellona fino alla fine senza pensieri.
Nel complesso, è stata una bellissima esperienza che consiglio assolutamente a tutti!

The accommodation was very comfortable. The host was always available and also gave us helpful recommendations for spots to check out near the apartment. We enjoyed our stay a lot and are already looking forward to coming back.
Value for money place. Vaishali is really sweet and provide me and my friends everything we needed. Close to trasports in a really nice neighbourhood. Would stay again!
Beau petit logement très convivial dans un quartier tranquille près de toutes les commodités (bus et supermarché). Superbe accueil et flexibilité pour l'arrivée.

Nice apartment, got everything we needed.
Near a mall, good for the groceries and/or shopping.
Near a beach 🔥
5 minutes from the metro who takes us to the center in 10 minutes
2 minutes from buses too.
Vaishali explained us everything we needed to know and allowed us to leave our backpacks in the apartment before the hour of arrival, really practical and sweet!
I’ll come there again for sure
Hôte très accueillante, et disponible. Parfait
Thank you Vaishali and family for this lovely stay. We thoroughly enjoyed our time in Barcelona and appreciate your kindness with flexible check-in and out.
Perfeito
Vse bylo perfetkni. Hostitelka nas uvitala a podala veskere info potrebne. Mohu jen doporucit. Moc dekujeme.
Great stay! Everything was exactly as described. Communication was easy and smooth throughout, and the apartment was well connected with convenient access to public transport.
Alles super, gerne wieder.
it was not the greatest
The stay was not worth the money. :-(

Excellent stay! Space was great, as described & very relaxing.
Vaishali was very good at communicating, would recommend.

Very nice place with a location right next to the Metro.
Very kind host who assisted with an early check in.
Unfortunately the shower temperature could not be regulated which caused extremely hot showers.
todo perfecto, repetiremos

Vaishali welcomed us super friendly and had clear instructions. There were minor flaws, like the temperature of the shower wasn't adjustable. But that wasn't an issue for us. Overall we had a fantastic stay, everything you need is closeby or easily accessible with public transport. Thank you for letting us stay!
super apartment in a great location, away from the tourists and surrounded by great bars and restaurants!

Nice place in a good location well served by public transportation. The price is too high in my opinion and the apartment needs a lot of maintenance. Unfortunately we had issues with late check-in with kids waiting outside without any valid reason. No detailed input received at check-in. With a small effort this apartment would be much better for families.
Tuvimos un hermoso encuentro con Barcelona y mucho de eso fue gracias a este hermoso hogar. Cómodo, nuevo, accesible y muy amplio

El departamento es cómodo y espacioso, tiene todo lo necesario para hacer tu estadía amena, el barrio es tranquilo pero las principales atracciones de Barcelona quedan a una distancia q no cualq puede hacer a pie.
De todos modos el tranvía y los buses están en frente y la estación de metro a una cuadra. Está bien comunicado . Hay negocios cerca y un shopping a 300 metros.
I wish we would have known ahead of time that in Spain the 2 nd floor is actually two flights up because they start counting at 0 for ground level.
Had a great stay, this apartment was clean, centrally located, and had everything you’d need. The host was responsive and kind.

Lovely stay! Beautiful apartment that felt we were getting a true local experience of Barcelona. Very clean and tidy. Easy to walk to local attractions including Sagrada and Park Guell and close to metro system which was very convenient for our stay.

The place was perfect for what we needed. Our uber was confused and dropped us off at the wrong place but the hosts helped us and met us outside . The hosts were very nice and the place was very cute.

Dolors and Enric were amazing hosts. They were extremely kind, communicative, and made sure we were taken care of. I think what describes their character best, is when we asked them if they could schedule us a cab for our drive to the airport, they actually drove us and made sure we were at our flight promptly. Not many hosts will do that for you. When I go back to Barcelona, we will definitely be staying here again.
房东非常热心地给我们推荐周边餐厅和游玩路线攻略，有什么问题也能及时回应，房间里地铁站非常方便，房屋设施很全面
We had a wonderful time at Doloros and Enrique’s place! Thank you so much

Super schöne Unterkunft mit noch viel schönerer Dachterasse, ein wahres Fundstück in einer super Gegend von Barcelona. Die Kommunikation lief super und viele Sehenswürdigkeiten und Restaurants in der Nähe empfohlen. Der Check-In und -Out lief super reibungslos. Einziger Hinweis: im Sommer kann es ohne Klimaanlage etwas warm werden, die Ventilatoren helfen in der Nacht aber etwas Abhilfe. Alles in allem hat sich der Aufenthalt mehr als gelohnt, der Wein zum Empfang war auch sehr lecker!

Dolors & Enric’s place is so lovely, super clean & comfortable. It’s as described and even better in person with its cosy vibes, brilliant location, both walkable (easy walks around and also to/from different tourist attractions) and with close access to transport (Metro, buses), nice restaurants & lovely shops around. Very safe & gorgeous area.
Dolors & Enric are great hosts. Enric went above and beyond to make us feel "at home". He’s attentive, kind, generous and communication with him was always quick & smooth. Any question or concern we had, Enric attended to us immediately. Even when we had issues with the times, he was understanding & so kind. Enric gave us a very warm welcome at check-in and provided us with lots of very helpful information, which contributed to our smooth stay, helping us to enjoy Barcelona to the fullest. Check-out was straightforward too.
Highly recommend Dolors & Enric. We had a fantastic stay and can’t wait to come back. Muchas gracias, Dolors & Enric!
Hadde et veldig fint opphold hos Dolors & Enric. De var veldig på tilbudssiden og hjalp med bagasje da vi ankom☀️

I needed a flat near the sights of Barcelona, convenient for metro, own place to cook and handy for a supermarket. It had what we needed. The building has a historical look from the outside and along with the three small balconies and the roof top terrace, it felt like we really were living a Spanish lifestyle.
We had no need to disturb the owners - there were a few laminated cards and maps for us and everything just worked.
It was a very hot 35C week and while aircon would have been useful, the fans sufficed for us. We were there to enjoy the heat.
15 minutes walk to Segrada, 15 minutes bus ride to Park Guill and the beach was 15 minutes on the Metro from Alfons X to Barceloneta - good for evening strolls on the sand.
On last day they stored our cases during the day in their flat for us to collect for our late night flight. We communicated with Enric by text on arrival to clarify metro route from airport - about 80 minutes - very convenient.
Yes I'd stay here again. Gracias.

Our stay at Dolors and Enric's place was perfect. We were in Barcelona visiting family. We were close to the metro which made travel around the city very easy. Our place was very clean and exactly as described. Would definitely stay here again if needed.

I enjoyed my stay and the hosts were very welcoming and helpful. I struggled a bit in the heat without air conditioning but fans were supplied so that helped mitigate my discomfort! Something to be aware of is that the apartment is on the second floor, up several flights of narrow stairs. The host met me and helped get my belongings up to the apartment which was great. Also there is a lot of construction noise on weekdays as the building next door is being renovated. On the whole though this was a great place to stay, close to amenities, attractions and the metro.

We enjoyed our stay. Enric was great, easy to talk to and proactive. He must have been watching for our arrival, and came outside when our taxi dropped us off and we were on the sidewalk figuring out our next steps. The place was lovely, inviting and clean. The two room fans definitely made the heat more tolerable. We enjoyed the walkability of the area. We did a number of things Enric recommended we do, and enjoyed them all including local restaurants. Having a washing machine there was definitely a plus. Thank you for the lovely bottle of wine. We enjoyed our conversations with you. Thank you for a lovely stay.

We’ve stayed in many AirBNBs - this was one of our favorites. Our host greeted us and patiently explained everything to us - she was very friendly and easy to know. The apartment has a lot of charm - we enjoyed opening the windows up to get a pleasant flow of air when we were there. Access to Park Güell and Sagrada Família was easy. We strolled all over Barcelona taking in the sights, the people, and the local culture. We truly had a great stay. Thank you Enric & Dolors!
Wonderful stay! The hosts were incredible and so thoughtful! Definitely would stay here again.

Vi var meget glade for at bo i Dolors og Enrics dejlige lejlighed. Alt var fint, rent og smukt. Fantastisk hus, gulve og tagterrasse, som vi nød at være på..! Et dejligt sted at være, som vi holdt meget af. Vi kommer meget gerne igen..!

Dolores and Eric’s apartment is in a great location in walking distance to Park Guell and a walk or short metro trip to Sagrada Família. The metro station is a few mins walk. The apartment was very secure, clean and comfortable with everything we needed. We arrived later than expected and Eric was very accommodating and we were met at the door when we arrived.  Would definitely stay again.

My boyfriend and I absolutely loved our stay in Dolors and Enric's apartment.  It's the perfect location as it is 1 block from the metro so we could get anywhere we wanted very quickly.  The hosts were extremely responsive and gave us lots of valuable information on the city.  I highly recommend their apartment for anyone visiting Barcelona!

Dolores & Enric were extremely helpful and accommodating. They provided lots of information about the neighbourhood including how the transit system worked and local restaurant recommendations. Their place was great and we would happily recommend it.
L’appartement est bien placé, à quelques minutes de la plages et ses restaurants mais aussi près d’un métro pour aller aileurs en ville.
Все хорошо 👌

Alloggio comodo, per quattro persone.
Ideale per base di partenza per visitare Barcellona, con tutti i punti di interesse facilmente raggiungibili con i mezzi pubblici.
Vicinissima alle spiagge, ottimo per il relax dopo aver visitato la città.
Locali e ristoranti vicini per concludere la giornata.
Viaggio in famiglia con due figli grandi… ottima soluzione!
Le logement était vraiment très bien emplacement très tranquille à recommander sans hésitation

Ми зупинились в помешканні Джейн та Ксавєра і були задоволені. Господарі дозволили заселитися раніше зазначеного часу, все чітко розказував та давав відповіді на наші запитання, дуже люб'язний чоловік. Джейн також завжди була на зв'язку, відповідала на наші повідомлення в будь який час, та уточнювала чи в нас все добре. Гарне розташування біля моря, в тихому районі. Поруч є кафе та магазини. До метро хвилин 5-7 і це пряма гілка до центру. Квартира підходить якщо вашою метою є відпочинок на морі а не шумні вечірки ❤️

I stayed at Jane and Javier’s Airbnb in Barcelona for 3 days, and it was an amazing experience. I highly recommend staying here! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location, making it easy to explore the city. Jane and Javier were wonderful hosts—friendly, welcoming, and always available to help. They even offer airport pickup, which made my arrival so much easier. I would definitely stay here again on my next trip to Barcelona!

Un apartamente muy cerca de la playa y del Metro.
El portal y las escaleras un poco lugubres, pero el apartamente muy bien y muy comodo para 2 ó 3 personas.

The place was fantastic and in the best location for the beach and public transport. We could not get the kettle to work and the coffee plunger was broken, but that was so very very minor, everything else was better than described!

Unser Aufenthalt war sehr schön. Wir konnten unser Gepäck bereits vor dem Check-in abgeben, was sehr angenehm war. Ebenso am Tag unserer Abreise durften wir länger im Quartier bleiben. Wir haben die Nähe zum Strand genossen.

Jane and Javier were absolutely wonderful hosts. The apartment was exactly as described and was in such a great location! Super clean and comfortable. I’ll definitely be trying to stay here again when I return to Barcelona!
Schnuckeliges kleines Apartment in direkter Fussentfernung zum Strand

Jane’s apartment is perfect for a long weekend in Barcelona, 7 minutes walking from the closest metro station and 10 minutes walking from the beach.
Apartment look exactly like in the pictures, nothing to complain about! A/C was working and was refreshing us during the hottest hours of the day. At night we didn’t need it since the sea breeze was refreshing the flat.
Jane’s communication is quick and reactive, recommended stay!
Apartamento limpio y acogedor con buena ubicación. Jane ha sido muy amable en todo momento. Recomendable 100%
Muy buen sitio recomendado, si surge la oportunidad iría de nuevo.
Apartamento muy cerca de la playa, es  tal y como se describe en el anuncio, bien comunicado e idóneo para pasar unos días.
Nice place, close to the beach and metro station! Jane is very friendly and helpful!

Excelente estadía. El apartamento estaba impecable, muy cómodo y en una ubicación ideal, cerca de la playa y en un muy buen punto para caminar y recorrer Barcelona. Agradecemos mucho la hospitalidad de Jane y Javier, siempre muy atentos. Sin dudas, una experiencia muy recomendable.
Tolle Lage, süßes kleines Apartment perfekt um für ein paar Tage Barcelona zu erkunden und den Strand auch gleich um die Ecke.

Die Unterkunft ist super für ein paar Tage Barcelona geeignet für 2 - 3 Personen, klein aber fein und die fußläufige Strandnähe ist für Meerliebhaber genial.
Die Straße ist Nachts sehr laut, aber mit Oropax konnte man gut schlafen.
Die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin sowie Check-In und Wegbeschreibung war super.

We had a wonderful time in Barcelona and having this nice apartment was one of the reasons. The apartment was very clean, the location is perfect, within walkable distance to the beach. The host is very responsive.

Ramon est un excellent hôte qui a bien communiqué en français.
Appartement propre et conforme a l'annonce.
Appartement super bien situé: à côté du metro.

The area was nice and quiet, the apartment was cozy and it had good soundproof. The ac only cooled down the living room so the bedrooms were pretty hot, but there was fans in the bedrooms to help a bit. Really nice host and easy to communicate. Thank you for the lovely apartment!

Ramon and his apartment were perfect. We enjoyed our stay since the apartment was exactly the same as the photos and the description. Ramon was super friendly and always helpful. The neighborhood is super peaceful and easy to get around using the metro. We loved it here and are super grateful to Ramon to let us stay! Me and our friend totally recommend!

Ramon est très accueillant et donne de bons conseils. L’appartement est conforme à la description. Il est propre et très bien équipé (lessive, produit vaisselle et gel douche à disposition). Il est situé dans un endroit calme et proche du métro. La literie est très confortable. Je recommande fortement cet appartement.

Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und Ramon war ein hervorragender Gastgeber. Wir können die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.  Toller Ausgangspunkt um die Stadt zu erkunden.  Man ist sehr schnell in dem Viertel Gracia, was wir sehr empfehlen können. Danke für den super Service und die freundliche Art empfangen und verabschiedet zu werden.  Wir kommen gerne wieder!

El apartamento de Ramon fue exactamente lo que buscábamos. Es cómodo, espacioso, cuenta con AC en el living y habitaciones cómodas. El barrio es tranquilo y estas a 5min de la estacion de metro y la del bus. Ramon fue un excelente host. Definitivamente volveríamos.

Nous avons passé en famille un très bon séjour à Barcelone. Nous avons reçu un très bon accueil de Ramon. Le logement est très bien équipé et très propre, avec beaucoup de livres culturels. Merci à Ramon pour ses bons conseils, toutes les mises à disposition, et la réservation du taxi pour le départ.
Extremely warm welcome and excellent communication. The flat is unpretentious. Great place for access to the city.

Ramon was an excellent host. Kindly assisted with luggage, met us and walked through the place.
The apartment was older but as shown in photos, with everything you need. Kitchen was well equipped, great washing machine and space, iron etc. lots of towels and sheets. Ramon was responsive and helpful.
Location is quiet and near park guell. Supermarket a couple of minutes away and lessops metro station maybe 5 minutes away.
The Aircon in the living room was great. Bedrooms were hot but it is July in Spain. Ramon also asked for feedback on the fans and mentioned upgrading the ones he had without me saying anything.
Excellent host and apartment - thanks Ramon!

Het is een geweldig huisje als je met auto naar Barcelona komt. Ramon is vriendelijk, hij stond ons op te wachten en begeleidde ons de krappe parkeergarage in. In het huis is alles aanwezig, fijne bedden, fijne douche en air conditioning. De lokatie is rustig en je bent binnen 10 minuten bij de metro die je overal heen brengt.

Super appartement, avec balcon très appréciable, et tout le nécessaire (lessive, sel et huile) pour passer un agréable séjour. Un lit pour bébé a été installé pour nous. La communication avec Ramon et son accueil ont été parfaits, un grand merci!
nous avons apprécié notre séjour appartement aux top et ramon adorable

We had a great stay at Ramon’s place. The location was superb as we could walk to places if we chose or take the L3 metro which took us nearly everywhere we needed without having to change. There were also very convenient and well stocked grocery stores just around the corner.
The apartment is exactly as described and suited us down to the ground. Ramon met us on arrival and it was all very smooth and he booked us a taxi for our return trip to
the airport as we had an early start. A very helpful and friendly man.
We will come back to stay again for sure as we love Barcelona and this apartment has everything that we need.

We really enjoyed our stay at Ramon's place. Ramon is a great host, very responsive, very welcoming, he met us and showed us around as well as recommended few places to eat in the neighbourhood and in the city centre.
Apartment is spacious, bright, very clean, located in a quiet neighbourhood away from the hustle and bustle of the city centre but well connected, easy walk to the metro to catch a train. Still lots of shops, cafes on the doorstep to eat locally.
Would definitely recommend Ramon's place for anyone visiting Barcelona!

Nuestra experiencia fue excelente. Ramón fue un anfitrión muy amable, atento y siempre dispuesto a ayudar, lo que hizo que nuestra estadía fuera aún más agradable. El apartamento estaba perfectamente equipado con todas las comodidades necesarias para sentirnos como en casa, limpio, cómodo y muy bien cuidado. Sin duda, es un lugar altamente recomendable para quienes busquen una estancia tranquila y confortable. ¡Volveríamos a hospedarnos allí sin pensarlo dos veces!
Πολύ ωραίο σπίτι στο κέντρο της Βαρκελώνης πολύ κοντά στο μετρό με υπόγειο πάρκινγκ. Πολύ φιλικός ιδιοκτήτης με καλή επικοινωνία.

What we appreciated most about this stay was how easy it made everything feel. The apartment was bright, comfortable, and spacious, with plenty of room to relax after exploring Barcelona. Daily life was effortless thanks to the well-equipped facilities, and having parking in the building was a real bonus.
The area was peaceful yet well connected, making it simple to enjoy the city without being in the middle of the crowds.
Ramon was a thoughtful and welcoming host who shared helpful local insights. Before you leave, take a walk up the nearby hill in the park—the view over Barcelona is well worth it. We would gladly stay here again.

Ramon's house is very cozy and beautiful, we really felt at home. We enjoyed the lovely record collection, played chess, cooked and washed our clothes, everything was on point. Ramon was really helpful and let us check out later without any issues. Great stay, would def come back :)

Otimo apartamento, vizinhança tranquila, é proximo ao Park Guell e ao Metro o que facilita muito a movimentação em Barcelona pois não tem como ir a pé em todos os pontos de Barcelona, e o metro funciona super bem lá podem usar

What a fantastic space. A true oasis. I had the best stay here, its a beautiful space for taking time to rest and relax. Sunrise was beautiful. Everything was spot on. Manuel was friendly, flexible and the perfect host.

Manuel was a fantastic host.  The rooftop garden is absolutely amazing.  The bathroom and especially the shower  is luxurious.  While the bedroom and kitchen a small, they are very well appointed and having a wardrobe on each side was very nice so we did not have to dig through luggage for clothes.  We cooked meals easily in the kitchen and ate outside with a view of Segrada Familia.  The sunrises will absolutely blow your mind!

Wir haben uns vom ersten Moment an rundum wohlgefühlt. Manuel ist ein sehr herzlicher und aufmerksamer Gastgeber, der sich für Fragen und Anliegen immer Zeit nimmt und sich sofort darum kümmert.
Die Unterkunft liegt in einem angenehm ruhigen Viertel, gleichzeitig sind Geschäfte für die täglichen Besorgungen bequem zu Fuß erreichbar. Das Bett ist sehr bequem und die Wohnung ist mit allem ausgestattet, was man für einen entspannten Aufenthalt braucht.
Besonders hilfreich fanden wir auch den von Manuel bereitgestellten Plan – damit konnten wir uns direkt sehr gut in der Umgebung orientieren.
Und nicht zu vergessen: Der Fahrstuhl ist definitiv ein kleines Erlebnis für sich und gehört irgendwie einfach zu dieser besonderen Unterkunft dazu. 😊
Für uns war es eine wunderschöne Zeit in Barcelona und eine Unterkunft, in der wir uns wirklich zuhause gefühlt haben. Vielen Dank, Manuel, für die tolle Gastfreundschaft! Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen. LG Chris und Sandra

Great Apartment with the lovely terrace. Make sure you reserve some time to enjoy it. Far from the rush city center, but easy to reach anything you want in reasonable time by public transport. Be prepared to pay the city tax in cash prior your check-out. Manuel communicated always quickly. Great spot!

This place was an oasis! Perfect location out of the way and easy to get bus or subway to anywhere quickly. If you are looking for a spot that is calm and makes you feel the real Barcelona this is it! With the corner store and the peaceful terrace we made our own tapas feast every evening overlooking the city. The bakery on the corner was terrific for breakfast and coffee before heading off to explore. Next time we are in Barca’ we will definitely shoot to stay here again.

Manuel’s tiny home and patio really is a haven amongst the hustle and bustle of Barcelona. We absolutely loved spending mornings and evenings on the balcony and looking over the sights. The apartment is well equipped with many things you need to self cater, with a lovely big shower. The patio area really is the star of the show - plenty of space to relax totally privately and enjoy a morning coffee or evening meal. Without a doubt our favourite part of our trip was this!
There are lots of transport options and amenities nearby which made it very easy to get around. The nearest metro station is only 5 mins away and gets you into central Barcelona in 5 mins.
The only issue we had was with the elevator - as the apartment is on the roof you have to use the service elevator which is quite small (would be a challenge if you have accessibility needs) and prone to breaking, meaning we did have to walk up 9 flights of stairs a few times! That said it was all fixed within a day.
Thanks!

We had a wonderful stay and would happily recommend this apartment. The location was great, not far from the city centre and within easy walking distance of the metro and bus stops, making it easy to explore Barcelona. We loved the nearby coffee shop, Blat, where we enjoyed fresh coffee and croissants each morning. They also serve delicious fresh rolls, sandwiches, salads and amazing pastries, with friendly staff who made us feel welcome.
The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, clean, well equipped and very comfortable, with a comfy bed and fresh sheets and towels.
Manuel gave us a warm welcome, explained everything clearly and provided excellent recommendations for local supermarkets, restaurants and cafés. His communication before and during our stay was excellent, and he was always easy to reach. We had a fantastic stay and would definitely return.
Manuel’s spot was perfect for our short stay in Barcelona! He was a lovely host and extremely responsive and communicative. We will definitely be back!!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Manuel ! Nous étions bien situé dans un quartier calme et proche d’une station de métro pour rejoindre le centre de Barcelone en quelques minutes.
Lieu calme et apaisant on recommande !
Manuel a été super du début à la fin ☺️
Great place for a couple, huge outdoor area

My wife and I had an incredible experience at this space. A private oasis hidden in the city, we fell in love with this quaint, private, beautiful tiny home. The view is incredible. Manuel is very nice and communicative. 10/10 we would absolutely return

Tolle Unterkunft über den Dächern von Barcelona mit unglaublicher Aussicht. Die Terrasse ist bei schönem Wetter ein fantastischer Aufenthaltsort. Das Haus befindet sich in einer sehr guten Wohngegend. Direkt vor dem Haus ist eine Bushaltestelle, von der man zügig an den Placa Catalunya kommt, andere Linien sind in unmittelbarer Nähe. Auch die Metro ist bequem zu erreichen. Es gibt Bäckereien, Metzger, Supermärkte, Cafés, Restaurants in unmittelbarer Nähe, ohne dass man sich durch Lärm oder Verkehr gestört fühlt. Hinweis: Der Zugang zum Tiny House erfolgt über einen engen und klapprigen Aufzug. Das ist nichts für jedermann. Der Vermieter ist sehr nett, hilfsbereit und wohnt im gleichen Haus. Unser persönliches Fazit: The moste beautiful place to stay at Barcelona.

Manuel fue un anfitrión extremadamente amable y atento.
Dedicó su tiempo a explicarnos todo lo que necesitábamos saber sobre el alojamiento y los alrededores.
Las vistas son sencillamente increíbles y el alojamiento está muy ordenado y limpio.
Este lugar hizo que todo el viaje fuera más agradable, al igual que Manuel.
Beautiful terrace with wonderful views and amenities!

Very unique place. Gorgeous terrace. Manuel was friendly and helpful. Overall a very nice stay. Comfortable bed with clean sheets and towels. Great shower. Lots of shops and restaurants close by. We used the outdoor grill, which was a really nice touch. This was our first time in Barcelona. We highly recommend visiting the church on the hill that you can see from the terrace. Thank you!

Beautiful terrace, which will look even more spectacular when the flowers and plants are in full bloom; it really is the wow factor of the whole apartment.
The apartment was just the right size for two people and had everything we needed.
Surrounding area feels safe and comfortable. At night it is extremely quiet too, which makes a big difference after the hustle and bustle of the day.
I would recommend to have an option of a brighter light in the main living space as it was quite difficult to see at times but other than that, no complaints! Lovely, serene and picturesque.
We had a wonderful few days - excellent location, amazing views, beautiful apartment! Manuel was incredibly helpful and available for questions throughout our stay. Thank you so much!

Selfishly, my only hesitation writing this review is that more people will discover this gem.
Manuel is an excellent host– he is very kind, responsive and accommodating. The rooftop terrace is just breathtaking, and in Manuel's own words: "all yours". From your two rooftop levels you can see all of Barcelona, from the hills of Tibidabo to the sea beyond Montjuïc– with La Sagrada Familia perfectly centered in the view.
We spent more time at the Airbnb than expected– taking afternoon naps to recharge, making the most of the private upper deck for sunbathing during the day, and enjoying wine in the evenings. You won’t want to leave the waterfall shower, with its beautiful indoor foliage.
The Catalan neighborhood is very quiet and beautiful. We found several great restaurants, coffee and tapas within walking distance– the metro is also extremely convenient being only three blocks away. We hope to visit Barcelona again and will definitely dream of returning to Manuel's amazing abode.

Die Unterkunft ist super gemütlich eingerichtet und die Dachterrasse mit Blick über Barcelona einfach der Hammer 🤩
Manuel ist super sympathisch und jederzeit bei Problemen zu erreichen. Die nächste U-Bahn Station liegt nur 5 Gehminuten entfernt.
Wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder 😉

Best airbnb I have used ever. Terrace is really quite special, the apartment has everything you need.
If you choose to visit Barcelona to explore and spend most of your time outside the apartment is more than enough.
The BBQ outside, loungers, sofas, benches are perfect enjoying panoramic views of the Barcelona

The apartment is perfect for a central Barcelona stay, minutes from the metro with all of Barcelona only a few stops away. We received many great recommendations from the host so we will have to return in order to test out those we couldn't get to! Comfortable, great neighbourhood, safe and plenty of places to relax, eat and drink within a few footsteps. Lots of supermarkets around and a Lidl just around the corner. We visited as a family of 4 with adult children and it was perfect. The host was amazing very friendly, super helpful, lots of wonderful recommendations and made the check in and check out super smooth. If you go to Barcelona, stay here!

This place was such a great stay, there was lots to do near by and so helpful with the metro being right down the street. There was a park near by as well as tons of places to eat. Our host was super kind and went out of his way plenty of times to help us with our stay! He gave lots of wonderful recommendations as far as restaurants, places to see and where to go with kids! He met us in person to give us our key for the apartment and talked about the home and gave us a map of all of his recommendations. I even forgot my water bottle after checking out and he met us with a spare key to grab it. A great host and would recommend time and time again to stay here!

Loved our stay here. Great apartment, host very generous with recommendations and brilliant communication.
Will stay again if we come back to this awesome city

When I entered the house, the rooms looked even better than in the photos—clean and tidy. It’s super convenient to get around, with both a metro station and a bus stop right nearby. There are also supermarkets and restaurants in the area—everything you could possibly need! The host was  easy to communicate with. I highly recommend it!!

Eccezionale, posizione ottimale, metro e treno a due minuti a piedi, parcheggio a 6 minuti a piedi, appartamento splendido, pulito e in ordine, con aria condizionata. Il padrone di casa è una persona squisita, ci ha dato un sacco di informazioni. Se dovete andare a Barcellona, venite qui. Stra consigliato !
Thanks for the tips and flexibility
todo muy bien solo las almohadas no eran de nuestro agrado,  deberían tener otra opción y hace falta una television

Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt. Die Unterkunft war sauber, gemütlich und genauso wie beschrieben. Der Check-in verlief unkompliziert und die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war freundlich und schnell. Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt. Vielen Dank für die tolle Gastfreundschaft!

What can I say! From our initial meet and greet with our host who provided so much information to having the train station right across the street from us Chic and Cheap was a great stay! We felt right at home! The elevator is very small but we worked it out and only my mother had to use it. Overall we had an incredible experience! The AC was so cold! The WiFi was fast and our host was incredibly helpful, kind, and proactive! Thankful he had some US adaptors since I left ours! If we could give him 10 stars we most certainly would! This location was perfect for our family of 4 (three adults and one child)! Don’t let the price fool you! You get way more than what you pay for here! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The host was very proactive with recommendations and provided us with maps on the sights to see, how to get around on the metro and restaurants to check out. We traveled with a baby and they were very accommodating with a crib and helped make sure the check in was easy. The laundry service was also a great perk. 10/10 would recommend!
We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was comfortable. Mave was an exceptional host!! Very friendly, responsive, and always happy to help. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience.
The location was excellent, and the room was very well equipped with great facilities. The host was also incredibly kind and helpful. I had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend it!

The location is perfect, 3 minute walk to the subway/ train/ bus stations. It is very easy to get to the tourist attractions by public transportations. Grocery stores, cafes and restaurants nearby. Very clean place and well equipped with everything needed. The beds were really comfortable, the balcony is great for drinking a coffee in the morning and the area is safe and peaceful. The host was amazing, very helpful friendly and kind, gave us great local recommendations and stayed in contact with us throughout our whole stay to make sure everything was okay and responded to any of our questions. This accommodation really felt like home and made our short trip to Barcelona unforgettable. I would kindly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and coquette place in Barcelona!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures—sparkling clean, spacious, and in an exceptional location just a few steps from the Fabra i Puig metro station, which makes it incredibly easy to get anywhere in the city.
​The real added value, though, was our host. They welcomed us personally and took the time to share fantastic local tips, city insights, and excellent restaurant recommendations. Truly 5-star hospitality! We highly recommend this cozy apartment; it genuinely felt like a home away from home.

ci siamo trovati benissimo! e sicuramente ritorneremo.
Casa ampia pulita e con tutti i comforts.
Host particolarme proattivo e gentilissimo.
grazie mille
Super séjour ! L'appartement est très propre et idéalement situé, à seulement 2-3 minutes des transports. L'hôte est extrêmement réactif et toujours disponible pour donner de bonnes adresses.

This is a great apartment ideal for a family visit to Barcelona. It is very close to the Metro and from there easy to get to the main sights. The neighbourhood is friendly with great restaurants and ice cream shops!

O Jamon foi realmente uma ajuda com tudo! Gostamos imenso de estar aqui hospedadas. Éramos 4 meninas e gostamos de tudo. Boa comunicação, localização e apartamento limpo!
Uma mini varanda muito boa.

Wij hebben een super fijn verblijf gehad! Een mooi schoon appartement om de hoek van de metro en omgeven door restaurants en koffietentjes. Het appartement zelf ligt in een rustig straatje, dus het is er lekker rustig. De host is super vriendelijk en behulpzaam,  een echte aanrader! Met de metro met 10 minuten midden in het centrum, alle locaties en bezienswaardigheden zijn goed bereikbaar met de metro vanaf het appartement.
sehr gut

Wir haben uns direkt in die Wohnung und den kleinen Balkon verliebt! Auch wenn sie ein bisschen außerhalb der Innenstadt liegt, ist alles sehr leicht und schnell zu erreichen. Oliver hat immer sehr schnell auf Nachrichten reagiert, was die Kommunikation sehr erleichtert hat. Wir würden die Unterkunft auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen!

We throughly enjoyed our stay at Oliver’s place! Super spacious, and wonderful rooftop area. Location is really calm but easy to get to everywhere you would want! Host was also very quick to respond to any of our questions. Would definitely recommend for a lovely visit in Barcelona!

What a fabulous place to stay. Its location to the metro was amazing.  You can get to anything but you also have a peaceful and lovely neighborhood to escape to from the chaos of touristy parts of Barcelona.   Oliver was great.  Due to the luggage strike we never received our luggage.  Oliver was responsive quickly when asked where we could replace our missing items. My favorite part was the balcony! Sarria itself is so charming and quaint. Would definitely stay again!
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans le logement d'Olivier, qui était parfaitement en adéquation avec la description. Nous avons aussi beaucoup apprécié le quartier.

A home from home. Oliver's place is very clean, had everything we needed, felt safe and welcoming. Stunning building, traditional features, beautiful rooftop terrace. We 100% will be returning.
The one and only issue that we had, which is not a fault of Oliver's in any way, is that beneath the bedroom / apartment is a store room for the restaurant opposite. Of which the staff would constantly slam the door all hours of the day.
Local area is traditional and beautiful. Food shops, bakeries, restaurants and bus stops just minutes away, very easily accessible. As a same-sex couple, we felt very safe.
Thank you Oliver for a truly great stay

We had a great stay at Oliver's apartment. It was spacious, clean, and comfortable, with plenty of room to relax after a day of exploring Barcelona.
The location was convenient. It's in a nice, quiet neighborhood and very close to public transportation, so getting around the city was easy.
The only minor downside was that it could get a little noisy at night because there's a restaurant across the street, but it wasn't a big issue for us.
Overall, we had a very pleasant stay and would happily recommend Oliver's place to anyone visiting Barcelona. Thanks for having us!

The apartment is great, well equipped kitchen, clean and peaceful place to stay!
Oliver is a great host , very friendly and responsive!
We definitely recommend this place!

Adoramos ficar no apartamento do Oliver. Super atencioso e gentil.
Tudo bem cuidado, limpo e organizado. Cozinha bem equipada, localização boa e tranquila!
Super logement, spacieux et au calme 👍

Lovely place in a great, quiet spot! The place was spacious, as described and Oliver was a great host, providing good recommendations and was very responsive. The place has a lot of light and there are a lot of good restaurants in the neighbourhood. Took about 20 mins to get into the centre of town too so was in a great spot!

Oliver’s place is a rare find and truly a gem.
Beautiful place, in a beautiful quite neighborhood and walkable to many areas we visited around the city. When we come back would love to stay there again and highly recommend this spot to anyone.
Great host!

The apartment is in a great location, old world charm, clean and with essentials. Two coffee machines but bring your own coffee, mini split air-conditioning units in both the living room and the bedroom. The landlord is quick to reply to messages and cares about the place. We found the air conditioner not working in the bedroom and within two days a brand new was installed. Walking distance to great restaurants, supermarket and a Michelin-rated traditional Catalan restaurant across the street. The bedroom is located above two entrances with heavy metal doors - one door to the two apartments upstairs and one metal door to the Michelin restaurant storage space. During the week the prep in the restaurant starts at 7:30 am and you can hear the metal door below slamming quite often, but that is a small inconvenience if you plan to rise early.  Overall this was a fantastic place with character and all amenities, located in a  great neighborhood, off the beaten path but close to everything.

L'appartement d'Oliver est situé dans le charmant quartier de Sarria qui propose de nombreux commerces de proximité et des restaurants de qualité. Très bien desservi par les transports en communs (bus et métro), le quartier permet de rejoindre très facilement  tant le centre de Barcelone que l'aéroport. L'appartement, avec ses jolies boiseries, est très propre et bien aménagé. Le petit balcon est un vrai plus. Une vaisselle plus uniforme, quelques plats de service et des sets de table viendraient parfaitement compléter les équipements proposés. Quant à Oliver, toujours  prompt à nous répondre et à nous conseiller. Nous le remercions très sincèrement pour sa gentillesse et sa grande disponibilité.
Appartement propre avec le nécessaire, quartier calme avec les commodités, toit terasse  très agréable. Je recommande
Super place. Quiet and restful yet very close to centre. Lovely and light apartment.
Great location and beautiful apartment.
Oliver was very responsive and helpful. His apartment is very convenient and is a great base from which to explore Barcelona. Would definitely stay here again.

Polecam nocleg u p.Olivera. Wspaniała cicha lokalizacja, 7 min do metra. Niedaleko pyszna kawa i lokalne pyszności. Super kontakt z właścicielem domku. Czysto, schludnie, wygodnie, świeżo. Jeśli bym miała wrócić do Barcelony, wybrałabym ponownie ten nocleg :)

Très conforme à l’annonce . L’appartement est très agréable , lumineux , joliment décoré et la cuisine est bien équipée. Le quartier est aussi agréable à découvrir. A l’écart de la frénésie du centre-ville on y trouve tout de même de jolies boutiques et d’excellents restaurants que nous partageons avec les résidents . Olivier a été prompt à nous répondre et accommodent concernant l’heure d’arrivée et le de départ . On y retournerait sans hésiter , d’autant plus que Barcelone est vraiment une ville fascinante !

Die Unterkunft von Oliver hat perfekt für uns gepasst. Schöne Gegend, gute Anbindung und Oliver war jederzeit erreichbar. Wir waren drei Nächte in der Wohnung. Sie ist zwar etwas hellhörig, für uns war das aber kein Problem. Vielen Dank auch für die tolle Flasche Wein vom Weinhändler ums Eck!

We had a lovely stay at Ana’s place.  It was cozy and comfortable with everything we needed.  We especially appreciated that she arranged for us to get the keys and drop off our luggage early so that we could start exploring the area without having to drag our luggage with us.  Highly recommend and look forward to coming back.  Thanks for everything Ana!

Ana’s place was perfect for my short stay in Barcelona.  It’s in a quiet but convenient part of town, and the apartment has great character and contains everything you need to feel at home.  Ana was a great communicator, very personable, and incredibly accommodating.  I highly recommend the apartment and the host!

Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt mit Baby. Es war alles da was man benötigt. Die ganze Wohnung war sehr sauber und die Bettwäsche sowie Handtücher ebenfalls - herrlicher Duft vom Waschen :).
Die Umgebung ist sehr nett und es sind Restaurants, Cafés etc. fußläufig schnell erreichbar.
Der Balkon bietet eine wirklich tolle Aussicht!
Ana ist eine nette Gastgeberin, jederzeit erreichbar und antwortet super schnell! Der Check-In verlief einwandfrei.
Ich kann die Unterkunft sehr empfehlen.
Bedankt. Was een fijne vakantie!
Sensacional! Perto de tudo, e ao mesmo tempo super familiar e calmo. Recomendo muito!!

My husband and I enjoyed a pre-cruise 5 nights in Barcelona and could not have picked a better spot. Each day we opened the door and walked - to Sagrada Família, to coffee shops, to La Pedrera, to Barceloneta and to Hospital de Sant Pau. We rode the hop on-hop off bus and the starting stop was nearby. Great markets were around the corner and having breakfast and a couple of dinners on the balcony was a huge bonus. The washing machine made for easy packing for the next week of our vacation. Ana was helpful and friendly. Even the old fashioned key to the spacious, comfortable apartment was fun to use ! It’s a quiet, safe neighborhood, the train is only a few blocks away and it’s easy to navigate.
Excellent place and had no complaints at all! Great location as well

Me alojé con mi pareja en el ático de Ana. La ubicación estupenda, estábamos a 8 minutos andando de la Sagrada Familia y el metro también estaba cerca. Ana y su marido muy amables y contestaban rápido.
El apartamento estaba ordenado y limpio.
Si vuelvo a Barcelona o si sé de alguien que quiera ir, recomendaré el ático de Ana sin duda.

Apartamento muito bem localizado, limpo e exatamente como nas fotos. A comunicação com a Ana foi excelente do início ao fim, sempre muito rápida e prestativa. Tivemos uma ótima estadia e voltaríamos com certeza.
Anna was a great host and super friendly. Will surely book again if am coming to Barcelona. Highly recommended 👌🏻

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Ana, dans un logement propre, très calme et avec tout le nécessaire pour s'y sentir bien. L'emplacement près de la Sagrada Familia et la vue sur celle-ci est vraiment un point fort !

We had a great stay at Ana’s with our 2 year old daughter. The apartment is well appointed and she helpfully provided a high chair and offered a crib. Critically, the AC works well and there is a lift which made life much easier. There are several good supermarkets within a one or two block radius and a nice playground and park immediately across the street, plus lovely Gràcia beyond that,  which includes a lot of great restaurants without the wall to wall tourists of Eixample.
Ana was a wonderful host. She facilitated an early check in process and was great at making sure that I was comfortable during my stay.

El apartamento es tal cual se muestra en las fotos, amplio, cómodo, limpio y super bien ubicado. hermoso edificio y mejor predisposicion de la anfitriona ante cualquier inquietud. Gracias, Ana!!!, volveremos!!!😍😍😍

My partner and I stayed at Ana’s home in Barcelona for a few nights and it was perfect. Incredibly accommodating check in time, walkable, and great view of Sagrada Família! We loved our stay and would absolutely stay again.

Couldn’t fault this apartment or the host at all! Ana went out of her way to organise an earlier check in for us which was much appreciated. It was the perfect space for what we needed and was clean, comfortable and close to metro stations. Ana was great at communicating with us and can’t fault our experience at all!
Very accommodating and so sweet!

It was a very cosy and nice place in Barcelona with super location just 7 min away from Sagrada Família. We were enjoying staying there, having a coffee in a cafeteria just right the corner. A lot of bars and restaurants around to have a bite or full dinner. Everything was available at the apartment and even more!

Bonne localisation, Airbnb propre et agréable.
Merci Ana
Thank you for everything Ana! The place was great, loved it.
Muy linda la casa , está ubicada en una zona muy linda , cerca de sants  , muy recomendable

Great accomodation right at the heart of the city!
Very quiet, which is quite hard to find in Barcelona
We'll come back!
Very quiet and central. Loved the patio.
Es perfecto!
Michou Bueno Gracias

This is an excellent place to encounter real culture. Located in a working class neighbourhood, it is surrounded by cafes, restaurants, bars, shopping.  Close the Plaça d'Espanya. We really enjoyed a trip to the huge market (shopping mall) that was formally a bull fighting arena.  If you're looking for the perfect Hilton, this place isn't for you. If you want to experience real Barcelona in a clean accomodation,  in a real neighbourhood,  surrounded by wonderful people, this place is for you!
Agradable
Buena ubicación, fácil llegar desde aeropuerto. Metro y bus muy cerca.

Dit appartement is absoluut een aanrader! Alles was zoals beschreven en we hebben een heel fijn verblijf gehad. We hebben Xabi zelf niet ontmoet, maar werden vriendelijk verwelkomd door Paulo.
Xabi zorgde ervoor dat alles goed geregeld was en de communicatie met hem verliep heel vlot. De ligging is bovendien ideaal om Barcelona te ontdekken. Wij hebben ervan genoten en komen graag nog eens terug. Zeker een aanrader😊
Très réactif, bel appartement, propre.
Sejour très agréable en famille. Appartement fonctionnel et parfaitement équipé. Xabi a toujours été très reactif pour toute question.
Xabi ist ein wunderbarer Gastgeber. Wir haben uns direkt wie zuhause gefühlt! Es war alles wie beschrieben, sogar noch besser!

We went during a very hot spell and our host provided very efficient air conditioning, as well as fans, so we looked forward to returning to the cool space after vigorous sightseeing excursions. The apartment provides room for our small group to spread out in private. Upon greeting us our host showed us little tips (the shower water can get very hot!) and reassured us that they would carry the trash out after we leave, so we didn’t need to be concerned about that.
There were several different coffee/tea systems available to start us up every day. The fridge was spacious and the freezer worked well.
There’s a lovely bakery at the corner, numerous markets and shops for groceries, a kebab shop that had people lined up outside because of their quality and price, and a fun little dumpling place around the corner.
We had previously arranged a ‘skip the line’ tour for Sagrada Familia and Park Gruea which went well. Later we did a tuk tuk tour. Wonderful city and stay. Highly recommend.
Beautiful apartment, and Xabi was a great host!
Super lokalizacja,mnóstwo lokali gastronomicznych w pobliżu,blisko do metra.Xabi jako gospodarz zawsze szybko odpowiada na wiadomosci.
Very nice apartment and location

We, a family of 5 including 3 teenagers, stayed at Xabi’s place for 2 nights. Barcelona was very hot and humid during our stay so the aircos were very welcome.  Closeby to a metro station (4 minute walk) and the National Museum. Parking with a car nearby is a challenge so we dropped of our bagage and drove our car to a parkingspot we booked  beforehand. Xabi responded quickly to any questions we had and gave us useful suggestions.
Very nice place, walkable distance to everything and Xabi was very helpful and responsive. We enjoyed our stay

Absolutely loved my stay! The place was spotless and located on a quiet street, perfect for a relaxing getaway. Despite the peaceful surroundings, it’s just a short walk to everything you might need—restaurants, shops, and local attractions. The host was amazing, friendly, knowledgeable, and shared some fantastic tips that really enhanced my trip.
Would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

We had a super nice stay at Xavi’s place. Close to the Metro - to go anywhere in Barcelona and close to local shopping.
The apartment had all that we expected and needed for our stay.

Valutazione: 2 / 5 stelle
Posizione ottima, ma la struttura necessita di grave manutenzione e pulizia
La posizione dell'appartamento è l'unico vero punto di forza: eccellente, super servita e vicina a tutto. Purtroppo, il soggiorno per la nostra famiglia è stato ben al di sotto delle aspettative a causa delle condizioni dell'immobile.
Le foto dell'annuncio sono del tutto ingannevoli, probabilmente scattate quando la struttura era nuova:
* Pulizia generale pessima: Abbiamo trovato polvere ovunque, forte umidità, stoviglie insufficienti e sporche, e un divano in condizioni igieniche davvero pessime. Nel cortile esternoe non pulito abbiamo perfino trovato un pezzo di pane a terra.
* Dotazioni insufficienti: Asciugamani e teli doccia del tutto contati e insufficienti per una famiglia.
* Manutenzione carente: La porta
Excellent accueil et parfait séjour

L'appartement est spacieux, propres et très bien équipé (clim + gel douche/shampoing/gel mains + tout ce qu il faut pour faire la cuisine que ce soit les condiments/epices ou les appareils/poeles...).
Antonio est adorable, disponible et donne de bons conseils.
La patio apporte air frais, lumière erevenons.
L'appartement est très bien situé. Sagrada familia a 15 minutes a pied, métro a 8 minutes a pied.
Supérettes et restaurants a proximité.
Nous reprendrons certainement cet appartement si nous revenons a Barcelone.
Ottima posizione,  check in anticipato, Antonio ci ha fornito di indicazioni per muoverci. Lo consiglio.

We had a great stay in Barcelona! The Airbnb was clean and in a great location, close to restaurants, supermarkets, and the Sagrada Família. Antonio was very helpful and gave us lots of information about getting around the city and places to visit. We really enjoyed our stay!
Nous avons passé un bon séjour, merci!
Um pouco sujo
Excellent stay in Barcelona. Antonio was a great host, always available and helpful. It's great value for the money as it's hard to find a two bedroom place in a desirable area.

Antonio nous a donné toutes les informations utiles avant notre arrivée, puis encore d’autres conseils personnalisés une fois sur place. Le logement était tout à fait conforme et disposait de tout le nécessaire.

Ormai molti usano il check-in a distanza, senza nemmeno conoscersi. Antonio no. Ed è assolutamente un vantaggio enorme. Simpatico, disponibile, reattivo alle comunicazioni, sa dare mille indicazioni sul da farsi. L'appartamento è in una posizione ottima, con due ingressi Metro a poca distanza e molto mezzi pubblici nei pressi, ma non è da escludere anche come punto di partenza per andare a piedi, vista la vicinanza con la Sagrada Familia. L'interno dell'appartamento può avere delle piccole migliorie da fare, è vero, ma nel complesso risponde alla descrizione e ha tutto il necessario. Per Barcelona - che è molto cara - ha un buon rapporto qualità-prezzo. Nel complesso, quindi, alloggio molto, molto  consigliabile.

Excellent séjour, Antonio nous a donné plein de conseils. Le logement est très bien situé, calme et suffisant pour une famille de 4 personnes. L’appartement est très bien équipé avec des attentions (eau fraîche, épices pour cuisiner, café, thé…)
Me gustó mucho el lugar, me sentí muy cómodo y el anfitrión fue muy atento!
El alojamiento estuvo muy bien, es cómodo y está ubicado en una buena zona, lo que hizo la visita más fácil. Un gran lugar para poder recorrer la ciudad. Lo recomiendo!

Antonio è stato molto disponibile, già dal nostro arrivo ci ha fornito tutte le informazioni necessarie per orientarci nella città. La casa era molto pulita e fornita di tutto l'essenziale, inoltre l'host è sempre stato disponibile per ogni nostro dubbio.

The apartment was large and comfortable and the AC was a welcome surprise. The neighborhood was very walkable with lots to offer. Antonio was very responsive and had great recommendations for where to go in the city.
Great experience, would recommend !

Localização excelente, acomodação conforme anunciado e anfitrião recebeu muito bem. O único ponto negativo foi o ralo do boxe do banheiro, que estava entupido desde o primeiro dia e causava transbordamento de água durante o banho. O ocorrido foi informado ao anfitrião no check-out.
Alloggio in posizione ottimale per visitare Barcellona, vicino alla metropolitana e in quartiere tranquillo e piacevole. Alloggio semplice ma funzionale e pulito.
El departamento está muy bien ubicado con todo cerca, Chloe nos dio todas las indicaciones. Siempre fueron rápidos al contestar, volvería sin dudas

Antonio un host gentilissimo, super disponibile. Ci ha dato tante indicazioni su come spostarci per Barcellona, come se fosse un amico. L'appartamento era pulito e ordinato, l'unica cosa che consiglierei edi cambiare le pentole perché quelle attuali sono un po' vecchie, per il resto tutto perfetto!

Tres jolie maison de centre ville.
Le patio et la terrasse sont très agréables.
Le quartier est relativement calme.
Le métro situé à 5 min à pieds permet de circuler très facilement dans Barcelone.
Le seul petit souci est le stationnement lorsqu’on est en voiture….qui revient assez cher.

Arrate was so helpful from booking right up to check out. We arrived at 1am after a big airport delay, she still met us at the door! We immediately felt at home, beds were comfy, space was roomy, especially the roof terrace! It was amazing to have this outdoor space to relax in. Close to the metro/bus stops, less than 5 minutes away for both, short bus journey to the beach. We got a five day travel pass exploring everything on our list with ease. There was a washing machine, line and pegs. Coffee pods, teas and other items were left which was great. Local square literally at the end of the quiet street was wonderful, sat easily the first time we went to eat, return visit was really busy so book table in preferred restaurant, really friendly staff all around. It was so  reassuring to know Arrate was around the corner had we have needed her. This was our second visit to Barcelona with our adult children who’d never been before, all 4 of us adore everything about the city. Thanks again 😍
Appartement parfait pour 4 personnes, loin du bruit du centre ville, mais suffisamment proche pour être rapidement vers tous les lieux touristiques de la ville !!

Arrate's place was perfect-it is quirky, airy and we loved the outside spaces. The home gave us the space and privacy that we needed as 3 generations of family holidaying together. Kitchen has all you need and the air con was heavenly 😍 Arrate was friendly, flexible and responsive.
The home is on a beautiful street with a square at the top which has lots of places to eat and drink. The neighbourhood is friendly, clean and felt really safe. There is a delightful little bakery a couple of blocks away and local supermarkets as well as pharmacies and a beautiful park. The metro is a short walk away from the home so location is fantastic. It was the perfect home for our week exploring Barcelona.

The host was extremely friendly and helpful, and the place was clean and welcoming. It was somewhat difficult to find the location, but the host met us upon arrival and helped us sort things out. The location is nice but not very central, easy access to the train nearby though if you want to get anywhere else in the city.
Alles top

Lovely apartment in a nice neighbourhood with local shops, bakeries and cafes. Lots of public transport links to places around the city.

Geweldig verblijf.  hele fijne centrale locatie, goede communicatie met Arrete, erg behulpzaam.

Ibamos con muy buenas espectativas, pr la verdad q nos defraudo bastante. La anfitriona si es amable, pr nos sugio el problema del televisor y esq no se ven apenas canales. La casa es espaciosa, cuenta con todas las comodidades y el patio exterior es muy agradable. Arrate ha sido disponible y amable, también al atender nuestra solicitud de check-in anticipado. Très agréable logement, meublé et décoré avec charme et goût, et ce supplément d'âme qui fait la différence avec la plupart des logements disponibles a Barcelone, souvent tous "identiques" et aseptisés.

La salle de bain est un peu petite rapportée a la taille de maison, mais tout en restant fonctionnelle.
Enfin Arrate a été très présente et attentive a nos besoins, et d'excellent conseil pour les restaurants a proximité.
Je recommande vivement !

Arrate è stata molto amichevole, disponibile e gentile. Una vera super host! appartement cosi et proche d’un métro

bel appartement et hôte très réactif.

alloggio molto bello, pulito, completo e con tutto quello che si possa necessitare per un soggiorno a Barcellona. la zona è vicina alla metro e alle fermate degli autobus. è tranquilla e con tutti i negozi e supermercati utili per il soggiorno. l’host è disponibile e sempre presente ed risolvere i problemi con la cauzione che viene sempre ridata se si seguono le regole della casa e dell’host

Mindig gyorsan válaszolt kedves volt. Amit ígért a szállás azt megkaptuk. A konyha eléggé felszerelt volt. Őrölt kávé, instant kávé, cukor, csomagolópapír, szalvéta, mosószer. A fürdő is felszerelt volt: tusfürdő, sampon, hajszárító, törülköző. Aki szereti a nagy várost és a belvárosi lakásokat nekik ajánlom inkább, mi nekünk kicsit zajos volt, de mi eleve nem szeretünk zajos helyen élni. Közel volt a belváros elérhető távolságban buszok, metrok, de mi rengeteget sétáltunk is! Hűtésre ventillátorok voltak az összes szobában, mi a végére már akklimatizálódtunk, de a városnak nagyon magas a páratartalma így a melegebb hónapokban csak azoknak ajánlom akik bírják a meleget!

That said, the kitchen could benefit from a few additional utensils. A decent frying pan was especially missing. The non-stick frying pan provided was heavily worn, with the coating peeling off. For hygiene and safety reasons, it should be replaced.
The bathroom could also use some attention. There were a few small mold spots on the shower tiles and the shower curtain. This should be addressed as soon as possible due to the potential health concerns.
Overall, it's a nice place to stay, and with a few improvements, it could be even better.

Paz herself was incredibly communicative throughout the trip. Sometimes she would be around in her studio if we needed anything, which added a really welcoming, personal touch. Logement proche du métro ligne 1 permettant de desservir les principaux sites touristiques de Barcelone. Hôte très accueillant et disponible qui nous a permis de s’installer plus tôt que prévu. Logement un peu chaud mais comprenant tout le matériel nécessaire.
Possibilité de se stationner dans un parking moyennant un petit supplément.
Quiet neighborhood very close to the Metro station with everything one needs for a brief stay in Barcelona.  Groceries in the same street.
Great location, comfortable and well equipped apartment and lots of useful info from host

Really convenient and close to metro station and shops. Easy to get to main sites of Barcelona. Very thorough welcome from Francesc, who was very helpful in letting us arrive early to the apartment. It was very hot in Barcelona, which was not the hosts fault, however it would have been helpful to have been able to cool the apartment a bit more, using the air conditioning as advertised.

Appartement au calme loin de l'agitation du centre de Barcelone. Métro proche pour rejoindre les endroits à visiter.
Francesc est un hôte très sympathique. Il nous a donné toutes les informations pour les transports.
Le logement est spacieux, propre, bien équipé et proche de tous les commerces. Un endroit à recommander.
Très facile pour s'y rendre en train depuis l'aéroport.
We loved the place and the host, the house was super clean and comfortable, it had everything you needed and more. Francesc was really nice and helpful, i loved the location which was very connected

Francesc was such a great host! He was very responsive, friendly, and gave us a lot of support on local recommendations as well as transportation methods. The apartment was very clean and well equipped, we enjoyed our stay!

Francescさんへ
まずは細やかなご連絡をありがとうございました！

アパートはとても清潔で、全てが揃っています。1番魅力だったのは、個別に別れた寝室です。4人で滞在しましたが、皆とてもリラックスした日々を過ごすことができました。バルセロナ滞在の際はまたお願いしたいです。皆様におすすめしたいです！

This place was exactly as described and was perfect for what we needed it for. Nice and close to all means of transport. Local shops near by for getting food. Please was lovely and clean and Francesc was a great host making sure we didn’t need anything. Overall good experience

From start to finish Fransesc kept in touch and checked in with us to make sure everything was okay.  He spent a lot of time giving us information on the apartment, surrounding area and transport.  The apartment was immaculate and very homely and it was so easy to navigate from Sant Andreu to other areas due to the great transport links.  If we went back to Barcelona I would not hesitate in booking Fransesc's place again.
Everything was perfect as described and our host was terrific!
Host molto gentile e disponibile, appartamento pulito e dotato di tutti il necessario, località non vicinissima al centro ma molto ben collegata

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour dans l'appartement de Francesc qui nous a très bien accueilli, a facilité notre arrivée, a donné plusieurs conseils de visite et pour nous aider. Nous recommandons l'appartement agréable, spacieux, très bien équipé dans une zone calme, avec des commerces et le métro à proximité.
Une adresse à découvrir et pour revenir à Barcelone.
