Great location! Perfect for sightseeing in Barcelona. Jordi was very responsive and helpful throughout our short stay. I struggled a bit with finding the key pickup but once that was settled everything was great.
The apartment was perfect for us and the location was great. Definitely one to recommend!
Отличная квартира, мы отлично в ней разместились, рядом в 5 минутах ходьбы Саграда Фамилия, хозяин всегда был на связи и решал все вопросы очень быстро!

Nuestra estadía en el departamento de Jordi fue muy buena. La ubicación es inmejorable, a solo tres cuadras de la Sagrada Familia, en pleno Eixample, un barrio hermoso, con edificios muy bien cuidados y una arquitectura realmente particular que invita a recorrerlo y disfrutarlo.
El departamento es muy amplio y cómodo, con dos habitaciones con camas muy confortables, un living con un sofá cama muy amplio, una cocina bien equipada, heladera grande y lavarropas. El lavarropas fue especialmente práctico, ya que después de nuestras largas caminatas por la ciudad pudimos lavar nuestra ropa y continuar el viaje cómodamente. Los aires acondicionados funcionan perfectamente.
Jordi fue muy gentil y atento durante toda nuestra estadía, siempre respondió rápidamente a nuestras consultas y tuvo detalles que valoramos mucho. Incluso nos ayudó a pedir el taxi para llevarnos a la estación de tren al momento de nuestra partida.
Un departamento muy recomendable, tanto por su ubicación y comodidad.
Beautiful place. I recommend it.

We really enjoyed our stay in Jordi's apartment. It was our first visit of Barcelona, and if I come again, I will try to book this apartment again. It has everything you need. It is in surprisingly calm location. You are literally 10 minutes by walk from Sagrada Familia and nearest metro station. So we used the apartment as a great base camp for trips, you don't need to rent a car, or come by car, and think about parking. In the neighbourhood there are many supermarkets and restaurants. Comunication with Jordi is great, he is really helpfull. I only recommend this apartment.
This is a good location. We were close to groceries, cafes, transportation and attractions. We would recommend! Jordi was quick to respond.

Die Wohnung liegt sehr gut gelegen und ist ideal als Ausgangspunkt um Barcelona zu erkunden.
Parken kann man in den umliegenden Parkhäusern.
Jordi war immer gut erreichbar.
Die Schlüssel für den Check In waren in einer 200m entfernten Postbox Filiale. Aber auch das hat super geklappt.
Jordi’s place is really close to La Sagrada Família, restaurants and transport. Ideal for spending a few days in the city.

Wohnung ist okay, könnte aber mal wieder renoviert werden. Einiges ist zumindest angeschlagen. Nachbarn waren in der Nacht leider sehr sehr laut und wir haben viele spanische Schimpfwörter lernen können. 🫣 Lage ist allerdings sehr gut und für den Zustand war es auch sehr sauber.
todo muy limpio y bastante bien
Todo impecable el departamento perfecto muy completo y excelente ubicación
Excelente localização fomos em família de carro o estacionamento que o Jordi nos indicou foii excelente nos respondeu rapidamente  indicamos o local e voltaríamos com certeza.
Great apartment, 10 minutes from Sagrada Familia, easy walk from Metros with lovely cafes nearby.  Totally recommend.  Thank you for a great couple of days.

Great place in a great location..
Clean and everything as advertised.
Highly recommend

Jordi is a host who communicated well
The apartment was close attractions and restaurants

Nous recommandons. hôte hyper dispo et arrangeant ! appart impeccable, incroyable, pratique et bien situé ! !!
super bon séjour !

Unit was clean and had all we needed.
Close to Sagrada Familia.
Excellent location.

Jordi was a great host and super responsive. This apartment is quietly located a couple of blocks away from Sagrada Familia and is surrounded by good restaurants. We also did the hop on hop off which has a stop nearby. Great stay!

Jordi a été un super hôte, il répond toujours très rapidement lorsque nous avons eu besoin. Le logement est très bien, légèrement bruyant la nuit, mais sinon ça demeure un excellent choix, à recommander!
Logement propre et bien desservi.  hôte réactif et flexible. Satisfaite de mon expérience

Nuestra estancia en este piso de Barcelona fue muy agradable. Nos gustó mucho su ubicación, ya que estaba relativamente cerca de los principales puntos turísticos, incluido el Park Güell, lo que nos permitió desplazarnos fácilmente por la ciudad.
El anfitrión fue muy atento y amable, siempre pendiente de que todo estuviera bien. Sin duda, una experiencia positiva que recomendamos. ¡Muchas gracias por todo!
The Apartment is great the Metro is quite near and in walking distance, there were also a few buses closer but we didn‘t use them as we like to walk.
Good people, good service. Thx
Un agréable séjour passé avec mes filles. L’appartement est bien situé notamment proche des transports en commun. Les propriétaires étaient très à l’écoute et réactifs. Je recommande!
I like the code system for Sergio’s place, made check in easy. Air conditioning was nice too. Would recommend for a visit, safe area too

The stay was great! Good size apartment, close to some main streets which were full of shops for our week there. Close to the metro and bus routes! Quick to respond when we needed some help with the aircon. Only thing to note is the shower is very small so a little turn can end up turning the water off🫣 thanks so much!

The apartment did not match the impression created by the listing photos. The pictures were clearly taken professionally, but in reality the apartment looked much older and quite worn out. Overall, it did not feel like good value for the price paid.
One major issue was the shower cabin- it was extremely small and inconvenient to use. Anyone over roughly 90 kg would likely struggle to fit comfortably.
Another downside was the noise insulation. Audibility throughout the apartment was very high, and it often felt like sleeping directly on the street because so much outside noise could be heard.
On the positive side, the beds were comfortable and the bed linen was clean, which we appreciated. Also the kitchen had all we needed for cooking
Logement bien situé pour visiter Barcelone avec 2 lignes de bus reliant le centre ville.
Good value apartment at a peaceful neighborhood.

Wir waren für einen Kurztrip in Barcelona und haben uns äußerst wohl gefühlt. Die ausziehbare Schlafcouch bietet genug Platz für eine dritte Person. Auch sind genügend Handtücher/Bettwäsche erreichbar. Rund um die Unterkunft sind fußläufig Supermärkte, kleine Shops, Cafés und die wichtigen Bushalte-/Metrostationen erreichbar. In nur 10min ist man zum Park Güell gelaufen und erkundet nebenbei das wunderbare Viertel Gràcia. Wir können die Unterkunft jedem empfehlen!

Die Unterkunft hatte eine super Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und war gut zu erreichen. Den Check-in konnten wir super flexibel nach unseren Wünschen gestalten. Die Unterkunft selbst war gut ausgestattet mit Föhn, Handtücher, Spühlmittel Waschmittel usw. Wir haben uns sicher und wohl gefühlt. Es war lediglich ein wenig kühl aber dafür war das Wetter verantwortlich. Die dusche war leider unten etwas undicht aber das konnten wir mit den Handtüchern ausgleichen.
Alles in allem war der Aufenthalt sehr einfach und angenehm gestaltet und die Gegend ist sehr ruhig und schön.

Σχετικά καλή τοποθεσία μόνο επειδή υπήρχε δίπλα μετρό και στάση λεωφορείου . Το κτήριο παρά πολύ παλιό , το σπίτι σχετικά βρώμικο με πολύ σκόνη στα έπιπλα πράγμα που δεν δικαιολογείται για τα λεφτά που δώσαμε . Στην Ελλάδα στα Airbnb υπάρχει η δυνατότητα να έρχονται να καθαρίζουν το σπίτι , πράγμα που δεν συνέβη καμία από τις 4 μέρες διαμονής μας. Δεν υπήρχε καν σακουλάκι σκουπιδιών για το μπάνιο , επαρκής ποσότητα σαπουνιών για 3 άτομα έστω για την πρώτη μέρα. Το ερκοντισιον δεν λειτουργούσε καλά και αργούσε πολύ να ζεστάνει ο χώρος. Κατα τα άλλα όλα ήταν εντάξει , απλά τα παραπάνω ήταν παράπονα σχετικά με την τιμή του σπιτιού. Γιατί ούτε ιδιαίτερα κεντρικά ήταν για να αξίζει τα λεφτά του.

O Sergio e a Laia foram sempre muito atenciosos e muito disponíveis para esclarecer qualquer dúvida e/ou pedido. A casa correspondeu às nossas expectativas e há mercados há volta para as compras do dia que nos acompanharam nos diferentes percursos que fizemos.
O Sergi partilhou também todos os transportes e quais as carreiras que poderíamos apanhar a partir da nossa casa, o que facilitou também a nossa deslocação.
Obrigada e até uma próxima oportunidade!

We had a great stay! The location was peaceful, safe, and perfect for walking around, which made it very relaxing. Sergi was an excellent host - very responsive, proactive, and always ready to help, which made everything smooth from start to finish. The place was clean, comfortable, and well organized, with everything we needed for a pleasant stay. We would definitely recommend this accommodation and would be happy to stay here again.

Gracias por recibirnos ! Hemos pasado 8 noches increíbles con mi familia. El apartamento es super el precio es razonable teniendo en cuenta que es un poco retirado del centro ! Hemos disfrutado caminar tomar el bus y el metro ! El apartamento es super cómodo !
no recomiendo

Good place, nice area, all that we need was nearby, it's comfortable.

The apartment is in a quiet neighborhood, but it’s close to all the tourist spots. It is walkable to Sagrada Familia and Park Güell right from here. loved exploring the area and feeling so peaceful while I was here.
The apartment, though a bit old, felt more spacious than the photos, and I loved the old balcony. It was equipped with everything I needed. Sergio even borrowed a hair dryer for my two-week stay. (TMI: It reminded me of my old apartment in NYC lived long ago, making me feel like I was back home!)
I also want to thank the host, Sergio, again. I had an international package that was supposed to arrive during my stay, but there were some issues with the delivery. I asked Sergio about it, and even though it was a bit of a hassle, Sergio tried to help me out. I also wanted to stay longer because of my night flight, and Sergio was so kind enough to let me stay after the check-out time.
Highly recommended Apartment!

This is in a convenient location and is walkable to the Sagrada Família. I do have to say there was only AC in one bedroom and the living room so the smaller bedroom was unfortunately very hot to sleep in otherwise it was fine. The kitchen was also very small but if you’re not cooking then it’s practical to store your food in the fridge and heat up your food if needed. There’s an elevator which made it convenient to bring our luggage upstairs. Carlos was very flexible with our check in time as our flight was very delayed. Overall it was a good place to stay for the few short days that I was there.

Appartamento molto pulito e comodo con aria condizionata funzionante.
Carlos è stato sempre molto disponibile ogni volta che gli chiedevamo qualcosa e ci dava anche delle indicazioni il primo giorno in cui siamo arrivate.
Carlos, se ha portado muy amable, tuvimos un retraso en el vuelo de llegada y fue flexible con el ingreso, es piso es espectacular y seguramente volveremos a hospedarnos en su piso.

Gute Lage, sauber und ordentlich für spanische Verhältnisse. Die Klimaanlage war ein Gewinn wie der unkomplizierte Austausch mit dem Gastgeber auch.
Leider war die Baustelle nebenan unter der Woche bereits ab 7Uhr sehr laut.

The location of the apartment is very convenient, around a 10-minute walk from the Sagrada Família. The apartment itself was generally clean, well equipped, and had a comfortable size for our stay.
There were, however, a few aspects that made the experience less comfortable. The furniture feels somewhat outdated, and there is very limited natural light throughout the apartment due to the lack of proper windows. The balcony area also does not offer much of a view or sunlight, as it faces a very enclosed inner courtyard.
In addition, the walls are extremely thin, so noise from neighbors could be heard very clearly, including late at night. At the same time, there is currently construction work nearby, with loud noise starting around 8 a.m., making it difficult to sleep in the mornings.
Before checkout, we were asked to take out the trash, which would have been completely reasonable, but unfortunately no trash bags were provided in the apartment.

Logement très propre, bien placé en centre ville, à 10 mn à pied du métro, dans un quartier résidentiel calme, avec de nombreux petits commerces à proximité, dont une excellente boulangerie juste en bas.
L'appartement dispose de 2 chambres séparées, d'une (petite) salle de bain et d'une cuisine. Carlos nous a expliqué avoir la consigne de ne pas mettre d'ingrédients type sel/poivre/huile à disposition pour des raisons d'hygiène, ce qui peut surprendre le voyageur français habitué à trouver de nombreux produits alimentaires dans les cuisines des logements de location. De ce fait il est compliqué de cuisiner à moins de tout acheter sur place, la cuisine sert donc surtout à réchauffer des plats achetés.
Des logements sont en construction juste à côté donc il y a énormément de bruit entre 8h et 18h, impossible de faire une sieste. Le soir, faute d'isolation on 'vit' avec les voisins, mais le calme revient vers 23h/00h.
Au total donc un bon point de chute pour visiter la ville.
Muy buena ubicación . Departamento muy cómodo
Hemos pasado unos dias excelentes en el alojamiento.

We had a great stay at Carlos’s place! 😊amazing location, the apartment looks better than the photos and Carlos was very accommodating

Carlos fue muy amable.

très bon appartement mais voisinage bruyant

Sehr gut gelegene Wohnung im Herzen von Barcelona. Die Kommunikation mit Carlos war zuverlässig und sehr hilfreich.

Carlos was a great host and the apartment clean and comfortable. Very centrally located for site seeing and dining. Great stay.

サグラダ・ファミリアへ歩いて行ける好立地です。

The location is good, close to Sagrada Familia, but the street is not crowded, especially not crowded compared to other central Barcelona areas, there are some good restaurants nearby. The apartment itself is spacious, but lacks natural light, some regular cooking products (like pepper, oil or more than 2 coffee pods). Overall, it can be recommended for a short stay.

Carlo's was very responsive since the beginning, clear instructions were given and check-in was tailored to our arrival (we had a delayed flight in the afternoon). A lady greeted us and handed the keys, all went well. The apartment is located near shops and bars/restaurants, few minutes walk from the Sagrada Familia, and well connected to public transport (bus and metro stations). It looks like exactly as on the pictures, kitchen well equipped and the coffee machine was much appreciated. It has a washing machine and a dryer too.
Me sentí como en casa. Nos explicó todo súper bien y se veía como en las fotos. Cerca del metro y de paradas de autobús, aparte nos recomendó sitios para comer... Súper cercano y sin duda repetiría.
L’appartement est situé dans un quartier calme à 15 minutes de la Sagrada avec plein d’épicerie tout près! Je le conseille fortement!

Andrea è Juan sono stati sempre presenti hanno risposto immediatamente ad ogni domanda, gentilissimo ci ha anche portato un ventilatore perché il primo era guasto in poche ore . Portando per scusarci delle cioccolate alle bambine.
Appartamento pulito comodo . Ci siamo sentiti a casa

Logement idéal pour 4 personnes à proximité de la Sagrada Familia. Quartier calme, à deux pas du métro pour visiter facilement l'ensemble des attractions. Notre hôte était très gentil et nous a donné des indications utiles sur les environs.

We really enjoyed staying at this lovely place. I would have given five stars if there was air conditioning. It was extremely hot even with the fans. But that was my fault for not double checking before booking.
Juan was friendly and we would definitely book again but in a fall/spring season. 🙂
Simpel maar goed verblijf

Our family of four had a comfortable stay in Juan's apartment. It is located in a comfortable safe neighbourhood with friendly bars, restaurants and cafes and a short walk from two metro stations. The apartment was clean and had all amenities we needed.
Juan’s place was incredibly clean, great location, flexible check in, and incredibly responsive. We loved our stay here and would love to stay there again sometime soon, thank you Juan!
Le logement proposé par Juan est très confortable et très propre. Juan est un hôte très accueillant et toujours réactif.  Je recommande vivement !
Great location!!! Thank you for a good place to stay.

Η περιοχή που βρισκόταν το κατάλυμα ήταν εξαιρετική καθώς σε 6 λεπτά βρισκόσουν στο μετρό και άμεσα μπορούσες να επισκεφθείς τα πιο δημοφιλή αξιοθέατα της Βαρκελώνης.
Ο χώρος ήταν πεντακάθαρος, ο κύριος Juan ευγενέστατος και ιδιαίτερα φιλικός.

Το μόνο μείον που θα μπορούσαμε να πούμε είναι ότι η πολυκατοικία δεν είχε ασανσέρ αλλά αυτό ήταν πρόβλημα μόνο τις μέρες που έπρεπε να ανεβάσουμε/κατεβάσουμε τις βαλίτσες.
Σας ευχαριστούμε ιδιαίτερα για τη φιλοξενία και όταν ξαναέρθουμε στην Βαρκελώνη θα σας επισκεφθούμε ξανά :)

El departamento realmente es muy bonito, cómodo y muy bien ventilado. está muy bien equipado y cerca de varios supermercados. El barrio es muy tranquilo. Tambien está cerca de la sagrada familia (se puede ir caminando) y de park guell (recomiendo ir  en taxi por 8 euros). si está  alejado del centro de Barcelona pero muyr cerca hay dos estaciones de metro que te permiten llegar en 15 minutos.

Juan l’ host è semplicemente una persona a modo ed amichevole sempre disponibile ad ogni nostra richiesta. L’appartamento è spazioso e molto carino dotato dei comfort per un soggiorno; silenzioso ed ubicato in un quartiere tranquillo e carino. Nelle vicinanze a pochi passi si trovano due fermate della metro. La zona offre più di un supermercato nelle immediate vicinanze con orari continuati fino alle 21/22 della sera. Lo consiglio in particolare per le famiglie. Alessandro
zona tranquilla a due passi dalla metro e 1.4 km dalla sagrada, ottima per spostarsi in ogni zona

Posto molto carino unica pecca senza ascensore al secondo piano un po scomodo la metro si trova a 10 minuti di camminata e anche l autobus tutto sommato la posizione è comoda c’è un dia a due minuti un po piccolo ma essenziale i vicini dopo le 22 sono molto intransigenti e anche tardo pomeriggio potrebbero rompere quindi la musica non si può tenere come posizione lontana dalle zone delle discoteche ma con uber è comodissimo i mezzi funzionano da dio nel complesso lo consiglio il rapporto qualità prezzo al top🫶🏻
Ďakujeme za úžasný pobyt, cítili sme sa ako doma a mali sme všetko potrebné.

Juans waited for us to arrive even when we were late and welcomed us and gave very good instructions and answered our questions about the house.
The house itself has everything you need for your stay including microwave, cooktop and washing machine. It is in a quiet neighborhood with nice local stores and restaurants. Plus its only a walk away from the Sagrada Familia.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Barcelona because of this. Thanks again Juan and Andrea.

Το διαμέρισμα ήταν σε ήσυχη περιοχή, είχε όλα τα απαραίτητα, ήταν ασφαλές.Ο οικοδεσπότης πολύ εξυπηρετικός και φιλικός.Απεχει 5λεπτα με τα πόδια απο την γραμμή L4 του μετρό και 7-8 λεπτά απο την L5.Γενικα οι ενοικιάσεις σπιτιών στη Βαρκελώνη είναι αρκετά ακριβές όμως το διαμέρισμα σε σχέση με την ποιότητα του είχε πολύ καλή τιμή.

La casa está muy bien, tiene de todo y es fiel a lo descrito, es muy acogedora. Como recomendación, cambiaría las camas de la habitación de 2 camas, ya que son muy vajas y los colch9nes so demasiado finos.
Pero de todos modos, repetía estancia en la casa de Juan y Andrea.

Great hospitality from Juan, he greeted us an arrival provided a great overview of everything necessary. Accommodation was spotlessly clean and was close to metro providing easy access to the entire city. We really enjoyed our stay and hope to return one day! Thanks Juan

If you want relax and have a good sleep, this is a good choice! Perfect location, calm but everything is there, metro station, supermarkets, shopping street. Tse is very helpful, gave us a lot of good ideas and recommandation, special thanks for Cadaques :)
Tse est une hôte très disponible, attentionnée et de bon conseils.  l appartement est à un bon emplacement (proche du metro des commerces) et est très agréable.  nous recommandons vivement.
La pasamos genial... gracias Tse por tus consejos e información para sentirnos a gusto y seguros en nuestra visita a Barcelona... eres una buena anfitriona ... Felicitaciones 👍👍😎
Casa com tudo o que é preciso, localização agradavel com varias coisas perto como metro supermercado cafes etc... Tse super simpatica e pronta ajudar em tudo.

Notre séjour s’est très bien passé. L’appartement est charmant, plus authentique et typique contrairement à la majorité des appartements Airbnb. Le quartier de Sant Andréu est légèrement excentré, bien qu’il soit facile de se rendre à peu près n’importe où en moins de 30min grâce au métro. Le quartier est en lui-même très agréable et sympathique, l’occasion de découvrir d’autres aspects moins connus de Barcelone. Rien à redire sur la propreté, le bruit ou la communication avec l’hôte, tout était parfait.

Le logement de Tse est dans un quartier très calme. On y  trouve toutes sortes de boutiques  et de bars. Il est parfait pour se reposer entre les visites.  Nous y avons logé à trois et l'avons trouvé  fonctionnel et agréable.

Tse's apartment is located in a quiet and peaceful area, with easy access to the city center and the major attractions. An ideal place to relax after exploring the city. The kitchen is small but well equipped, the bed was very comfortable.
Tse was very helpful, kind and friendly: she gave us lots of useful information during our stay (thank you for the welcome gifts!) Muchas gracias por todo!
Nice place, and Tse was welcoming, she provided a lot of useful information to me. At first the AC didn't work, but she later fixed it, so everything was nice.

Tse’s apartment is in the perfect location to explore Barcelona with only a short walk to the metro and shops. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed and we especially loved the balcony. We had a lovely greeting from Tse who is so kind and welcoming and answered any questions we had. Would definitely recommend this stay!
Tse was an incredibly helpful and communicative host! Very beautiful and cozy spot in a really convenient location. Will definitely be coming back next time I'm in Barcelona!

Lovely flat, very quiet and Tse is an excellent host - gave us lots of suggestions of places to go and things to do. The flat does smell a bit of smoke I found, but that might just have been from a previous guest I am not sure

Nos quedamos unos cinco dias en el alojamiento de Tse y nos fuimos muy contentos. Si vas para visitar el centro, tiene muy buena conexion en metro y vale la pena ya que solo son unos 20 minutos. Tse estuvo muy pendiente de nosotros y se aseguró de que estuviéramos cómodos. El alojamiento calidad-precio es muy recomendable.
El propio barrio es una maravilla. Recomendamos desayunar en el bar justo de debajo del piso, son rápidos, muy amables y la tortilla con morcilla esta riquísima. Y si eres fan de las hamburguesas gourmet, a solo unas calles esta la hamburgueseria Vicio (solo reparto o recogida de pedido). Tambien en la zona esta la Casa Bloc, si eres un friki de la arquitectura. Y las papas bravas del Hyde Park… muy ricas!

Tse is very good at communication. She shared a lot of good information about the apartment and its neighborhood. She also shared a lot of useful information about tour in Barcelona! She was so friendly and nice that I felt so welcomed.

작은 아파트. 관광지에서는 거리가 약간 있지만 집 바로 옆에 기차역, 지하철역, 나이트 버스정류장까지 다 있어서 전혀 불편하지 않았어요. 작지만 깨끗하고 있을것 다 있어서 완벽했습니다. 호스트가 매우 친절하고요 질문에 대한 대답도 매우 빨리해줫어요. 주변에 슈퍼마켓도 많아서 부엌을 충분히 이용했어요. 침대 매트리스도 매우 편안했습니다. 다음에 바르셀로나 가면 또 갈거에요. 완전 추천합니다
Très bien
Tse is very friendly and helpful. The apartment is near the train station and the metro. There are lots of shops and cafes nearby.
We had a lovely stay in Tse’s  apartment. Such a great location and starting point for discovering Barcelona. Would stay again!

Appart très fonctionnel, près du métro et de toutes commodité mais si vous venez en voiture le stationnement est cher. Tse est très agréable et attentionnée. Un tout petit bémol sur l'isolation phonique de l'appart.
A recommander malgré cela !
Es un pequeño y comodo puso, ubicado en un hermoso barrio, bien conectado con los lugares turísticos.

Tse’s apartment was just perfect, situated in a quiet area, but close to the tube station and the city. The place was thoughtfully decorated and offered more than I expected. It provides you with basically everything you need - shampoo, nail polish remover, hair drier, cooking supplies etc.
As for Tse, she truly makes an effort to make you feel as comfortable as possible. She is the perfect host - kind, responsive and always on hand.
I really enjoyed staying at the apartment and would definitely recommend it. :)
Great stay in an excellent location, close to everything we needed. The accommodation was comfortable, clean, and exactly as described.

First thing is it’s a total waste of money . The apartment is not at all living friend it’s horrible and is danger for kids because there is sharp nails near to bed and on the walls. Rosa super gentile e disponibile, risposta rapida.
appartamento pulito e ordinato, vicino a ristoranti, movida e mezzi di trasporto.
consigliatissimo
Alloggio strategico e facile da raggiungere per visitare Barcelona

L'appartement est très grand et climatisé ! Un vrai plus quand on vient à Barcelone en été !
Il est à 70m d'une bouche de métro ! Dans la rue il y a des superettes et des restos à tapas et un bus nous emmène en 20 minutes à la plage de la barceloneta ! Hyper chouette ! On a passé un excellent séjour ! Merci Rosa 🥰

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Barcelona.
Rosa war immer erreichbar. Der CheckIn und Checkout verlief einwandfrei und sehr flexible.
Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen und in der Wohnung war alles was man brauchte!
L'appartement est bien situé, près du tram. Il y a un super et grand supermarché.

Lovely apartment, very spacious. Good 20 minute walk to las rambles which is fine for me and my partner. Nice restaurants and cafes close by.
Would stay here again! Rosa was great and answered any of my questions quickly.
还可以

Rosa’s place was great. Perfect location with great tapas restaurants round the corner. Easy links to metro down the street. We felt at home and happy there. Will recommend and will stay again when we return to Barcelona. Many thanks Rosa

Abbiamo trascorso un soggiorno davvero piacevole. La comunicazione con l'host è stata eccellente fin dal primo contatto: sempre disponibile, cordiale e rapido nel rispondere a qualsiasi domanda, facendoci sentire accolti e seguiti durante tutta la permanenza.
La posizione dell'appartamento è ottima, comoda per raggiungere i principali punti di interesse e ben servita da negozi, ristoranti e mezzi pubblici.
L'alloggio era pulito, accogliente e dotato di tutti i comfort necessari per un soggiorno rilassante.
Consigliamo assolutamente questo appartamento a chiunque cerchi una sistemazione comoda, ben posizionata e con un host davvero attento e disponibile. Ci torneremmo volentieri!
Apartment was brilliant for what we needed. Spotless with extra cleaning products and toilet roll if we needed it. Well located to the Paral-lel metro and bus stops. Couldn’t recommend more.

We had a great stay at Rosa’s. She was very friendly and responsive. She was flexible with check in and check out. The balcony was a bit small but makes sense due to it being an older building. Overall, I would recommend!
Rosa is a fantastic, happy and helpful lady. The place was exactly as it was presented on the photos. Close to the stores and to the public transportation. Would happily recommend it to others. ☺️
Estupendo todo, alojamiento y ubicación perfectos

Rosa communique très bien et son père est venu nous remettre les clés. Elle nous a également permis d'arriver un peu à l'avance, ce qui a été très apprécié. L'emplacement est excellent, près du métro, des commerces et des restaurants.
Cependant, le logement ne correspond plus tout à fait aux photos. Le balcon présenté avec une table et deux chaises est maintenant occupé en grande partie par un climatiseur et ne dispose que d'une petite chaise. Dans la salle de bain, le lavabo n'est plus installé comme sur les photos et le comptoir est abîmé. De plus, la couette présentait des taches de sang et des marques jaunâtres.
Great apartment in a fantastic location. Very close to many amenities. Rosa was great and responsive owner who made our experience very easy.

Fui con mis padres al departamento de Rosa y nos pareció bastante cómodo y espacioso para 3 personas. La comunicación fue muy efectiva a pesar de pequeñas modificaciones a última hora. El sitio está muy bien ubicado, y te dan buenas indicaciones de lugares para salir a conocer y/o comer.

Rosa a été très réactive pour répondre à nos questions sur les restaurants ou autre .
Le quartier est vivant et facile d'accès.

This place was perfect for our stay! Was so close to many places we wanted to visit and also easy to get a cab or take the metro if needed! Rosa was super friendly and made us feel like family! The bed was comfy and the space had everything we needed for our weekend trip!
very good place, near beach, everything went smoothly

L'apartament està molt ben ubicat al barri de Poblenou de Barcelona: a prop de la platja i molt a prop del metro.
L'apartament és correcte en relació amb la higiene, els estris de cuina i de bany.
Volem agrair a la Tere la seva rebuda i davant de qualsevol dubte, sempre ens ha ajudat.
Gràcies i fins aviat!

Todo muy bien.
La zona es perfecta y el apartamento es conforme indica el anuncio.
Tere muy amable y atenta.

Excelente experiencia. Teresa fue una anfitriona muy amable, atenta y siempre disponible para cualquier cosa que necesitáramos. La comunicación fue muy fácil desde el principio y todo estuvo tal como esperábamos. El alojamiento estaba limpio, cómodo y muy bien ubicado. Nos sentimos muy a gusto durante toda la estadía.
Sin duda volveríamos a alojarnos aquí y lo recomendamos totalmente. ¡Muchas gracias por todo, Teresa!

Cumple. Por ubicación y barrio. Acceso en metro a una cuadra. Cerca de la playa y del monumento Glorie. Es pequeño pero tiene dos habitaciones . Si estas todo el día de excursión y lo utilizas para descansar va bien. Muy buena estancia en Barcelona.
Had a smooth check-in and a wonderful stay.

Siamo stati accolti da Teresa, molto gentile e disponibile.
L'appartamento era come descritto, zona comoda per raggiungere le stazioni della metropolitana, una decina di minuti a piedi da un buon supermercato, a pochi minuti da diversi locali dove mangiare un bocadillo o bere una birra.

We had a wonderful stay at Gabriele and Teres’ apartment. The house was clean, comfortable, and welcoming. The location was excellent - close to the beach as well as many great attractions, which made it very convenient for exploring the area. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this home to others!

Nous avons passées une super semaine à Barcelone.
L’appartement était très propre et très bien situé. La communication était parfaite. Je recommande vraiment cet airbnb.
Merci à Tere pour son accueil et sa sympathie !
Thank you for a lovely stay! The apartment was very comfortable, and we really enjoyed our time here.

We had a great stay! Tere helped us out so much and was nice and patient enough to explain how to use amenities within the apartment. The location is very walkable and the air conditioning was perfect for the heat as most other Airbnbs in Europe tend to overstate how effective their cooling systems are 😅.

Appartamento confortevole e in posizione comoda, a 5 minuti dalla fermata della metro. La zona è anche comoda alla spiaggia. Ottimo l' impianto di climatizzazione. Host molto gentile e disponibile. Ci siamo trovati bene.

Logement fonctionnel très proche par le métro des nombreux lieux de visite. Il est également proche de la plage de Barcelone.
Il est assez petit mais suffisant pour 4 personnes qui ne l’utilisent que comme pied à terre pour visiter Barcelone.
Merci à Tere de sa gentillesse et de sa disponibilité pour rendre le séjour agréable.
Nice place, the appartment was clean

We loved stayed here in Barcelona! The neighborhood has walkability but it is actually pretty quiet as well. You can walk to the beach, and the apartment has an elevator so you don’t have to haul all your luggage to the third floor.
Walkable to market, metro and beach!
Il soggiorno è stato piacevole, alcuni spazi risultavo ristretti ma comunque sfruttati al meglio per garantire comfort al cliente. Zona tranquilla e ben collegata ai mezzi pubblici.
Schöner Aufenthalt

Alloggio pulito, ordinato e in un'ottima posizione rispetto alla città. Ben fornito dai mezzi pubblici e in prossimità di piccoli locali e supermercati.
Al chek-in qualche difficoltà di comunicazione data la poca padronanza dell'inglese da parte della donna che ci ha accolti, che è comunque rimasta disponibile e amichevole nei nostri confronti.
Assolutamente consigliato.

Tere was a brilliant and friendly host and made us feel welcome as soon as we arrived. I appreciated how quickly she responded to questions I had whilst we were there.
The apartment was clean, had all necessary amenities, a good size for a family of 4 and a great deal for the price. Only drawback was that the twin beds were not the most comfortable.
Muy amable y una estancia increíble, muy atenta siempre con cualquier cosa. Muy recomendable!

My partner and I took his sister to Spain for her birthday and this place was just what we needed after a 17 hour travel day. It was located right near La Sagrada Família, a few gelato and tapas places, and super easy to navigate. Mari, the host, was so responsive and friendly. She was flexible when our check in time changed due to some baggage delays at the airport and gave great recommendations for local spots to enjoy food and culture.  Would definitely stay here again :)
Fantastic throughout

The place was really cute and well kept. I got confused during check-in, but that was probably just because of my jet lag and Marie was super communicative and able to help me out with anything I needed.
Location was great you could get to sagrada Familia and unlimited nice cafés within two or three minutes
Added bonus, there is a laundromat underneath the apartment, which I ended up making use of.

Highly recommend! Beautiful home! Mari was an excellent host and provided great recommendations. She was responsive and proactive. The location was perfect to get everywhere we hoped. We will be back!

Mari was an outstanding host and we very much enjoyed our stay at her property. Very easy to get to and conveniently located to a lot of Barcelonas biggest attractions as well as quick access to public transit for getting around town. Her place was very well equipped with just about any possible need and she was very responsive to any questions we had. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great stay in Barcelona.

Mari's place is so quiet that you wouldn't know you are in the middle of everything. Sagrada Familia just steps away, tree-lined streets, and the metro with major lines just a few blocks from the place. It is so clean and was decorated well. There isn't an oven which is the only downside we found which isn't a huge thing while on vacation but nice to have just in case. Overall, such a great place to call home for a few nights.

Merci à Mari pour cet accueil chaleureux. L’appartement était très propre et confortable.
L’emplacement était vraiment super à 5 minutes de la sagrada familia et pleins de petits magasin à proximité ainsi que des restaurants.
Nous recommandons ce logement.

Thank you so much for hosting us! We had a great visit of Barcelona and loved your place! Sagrada Família is literally around the corner! If you don’t mind walking you’ll find some great restaurants in the area. There’s also a laundromat right downstairs next to the building which made it perfect for washing and drying clothes!
非常好的位置，离圣家教堂就2分钟的路。不足就是卫生间太小，4个人使用实在有点紧张及挤压。被子也没有，只能用毛毯。睡的不是很好。
Great stay.
We loved and enjoyed our 2 nights in Mari's loft apartment.  It was safe, clean and comfortable.  Mari was a delight to meet!
Location really made this spot, and the apartment was so beautiful. My kids did not want to leave. Thank you again.

We had a great time at Mari’s place - extremely walkable to many restaurants, shops, public transport, and of course to La Sagrada Familia. We used the metro frequently, and it was always a treat to pop up and see the basilica towering nearby. The place was clean and easy to use. We didn’t do any cooking, so can’t speak to whether there were all the amenities needed. But there were enough cups, plates, etc, which worked for us. We were traveling during a heatwave and were grateful for the air conditioning, allowing us to rest well at night. There is one flight of stairs up to the apartment, as well as an elevator. There was some slight confusion on getting into the building upon arrival, so be sure to have a clear understanding of things beforehand. We were traveling internationally, and didn’t yet have our phone set up, so no way to call Mari (which was what we realized we were supposed to do). In any case, it all worked out just fine.

Mari’s warmth, her pride in keeping her beautiful loft clean and tidy made my stay in Barcelona even more special.
Location: can’t get better than being literally steps away from Sagrada Família, but still living on a quiet tree-lined street
Loft: clean, well maintained and equipped (exactly as described), having the modern amenities (thank goodness for AC during this heat wave), but still keeping the charm of old buildings.
Host: Mari is warm, responsive, takes pride in keeping her place in top shape.
Recommend without any reservations
Exactly as advertised. Amazing location, very clean and a very relaxing and peaceful apartment. Mari is extremely responsive and helpful with suggestions for Barcelona. We will be back.

Mari was a wonderful host and had a place that was decorated beautifully and showcased the love and care she had. Mari accommodated our early arrival with kindness and flexibility. All of her communication was fast and responsive and Mari gave us a bunch of recommendations on where to eat and what to visit when we arrived. The place was just around the corner from the Sagrada, but despite this it did not seem touristy at all. There was an easy area for taxis to pickup up right outside the place as well as the bus stop. Right downstairs from Mari’s place, there was a great restaurant (Lepanto) that had excellent food and even better service, with extremely friendly and accommodating staff that made us feel like we were family.
Our family of 3 were extremely comfortable during our stay l and we are grateful for the opportunity to stay at Mari’s place and we appreciate all of her assistance with our stay.
Highly recommend!
Mari was fantastic. We loved our stay at her place in Barcelona!!
Great location. Responsive host.

My family and I absolutely loved Mari’s apartment. She greeted us at check-in, and was very responsive and accommodating to our needs. The apartment was spotless, and we enjoyed how close it was to everything that we needed and wanted to see, including Sagrada Família. Would stay here again!
Die Wohnung war top, genau so wie beschrieben. Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt und würden sie jederzeit wieder buchen.

Hi guys, thanks again for making your place our home away from home. It’s was perfect! The market just up the road and Peruvian restaurant around the corner were a bonus. We’ll keep you in mind for future visits. Much appreciated!
Una experiencia maravillosa,gracias

Muy buena estancia. Agradecimos que el apartamento estuviera fresco con el aire acondicionado encendido a la llegada, especialmente con el calor de Barcelona. El departamento esta en buenas condiciones y limpio. Muy buena ubicación, en mi opinión tendría una valoración de 5 salvo porque la comunicacion considero que no fue adecuada, tuve que insistir varias veces para que me indicaran si habia parkin cerca, la respuesta fue en varias ocasiones que mirase las instrucciones para llegar pero en estas no menciona nada acerca de los parkin, no se molestaron ni en revisar si la información que les pedía estaba o no y me hicieron leer la descripcion varias veces sin mencionar nada al respecto en estas,  sin embargo fueron muy demandantes para conmigo incluso pidiéndome que cambiará la foto de mi perfil, cosa que no tienen como requisito en la estancia y no tuve problema en hacerlo. Logement très agréable et bien situé.
Pere et Eva sont très réactifs et très attentionnés.
Nous avons apprécié.

La estancia en este apartamento ha sido excelente. El apartamento está muy bien, está bien situado, la comunicación con los propietarios ha sido sencilla y efectiva. Las instrucciones han sido muy claras en todo momento. Totalmente recomendable.

Perfect place for 5 of us.
Good area to visit Barcelona.
Really great hosts, they were going above and beyond to help us.
We thank you!

A group of 5 of us stayed here - the place has everything you need, nice location, good transport links & supermarkets nearby. Hosts were helpful and responsive with questions we had on amenities. Overall this was perfect for us and we enjoyed our stay.
The only thing is that the kitchen is quite small (probably only 1 person can use it at a time comfortably), but nothing surprising as this is clear from the pictures :)

Had a wonderful stay in Barcelona. The location is perfect for a mix betweenn touristic places but also to feel like a local. The access to the apartment was super convenient and the place itself was even nicer than it looked in the pictures. Great place to stay

This place has a great location, walkable to good restaurants, clubs and shopping malls… but this peaceful when you want to sleep already.
Dank je wel voor de gastvrijheid. Alles is schoon en charmant ingericht. Er is geen contact met buiten behalve lucht via binnen schachten. Het is daardoor wel een rustig appartement.

La casa si trova in un’ottima posizione, tranquilla e collegata a tutte le zone. Ci siamo trovate bene se non fosse per la regola del silenzio… noi siamo state molto attente ma dai vicini provenivano rumori forti ad ogni ora del giorno e della notte. Per il resto casa ok, c’è a chi potrebbe dare fastidio non avere finestre in camera o averle con affaccio interno ma a noi è andato benissimo cosi!

Bonjour, nous avons passé 3 nuits dans ce logement très confortable et fonctionnel. C’était très bien!  Il se trouve dans une résidence sécurisée et au calme. Le logement est spacieux et agréable. Nous avions même de l’eau, jus de fruits et lait dans le frigo, ce qui a été très apprécié.  Cependant, nous avons été gênées par les voisins du dessus bruyants le soir un peu trop tard. Ça c’est dommage!  Sinon, le logement est plutôt bien situé à 15’ à pied d’une bouche de métro desservant très bien les centres d’intérêts de Barcelone en quelques stations.

We really loved this place. Location is perfect, apartment itself is clean and has everything you need for a family vacation. Shout out to the host for allowing us to store our bags in the apartment before the official check-in time :)
Really great time at Barcelona!
great place. Extremele clean and well organised, amazing location... 100% worth
Great location. Clean. And easy check-in

Very convenient appartement, suitable for 5 people for a long weekend.
We love the proximity with the Mercat Galvany for the best tortilla in town !
Note that the kitchen and the bathroom are really small, no views on the streets, very small windows. It’s a great place to settle and go visit the city for a weekend.
The beds, sheets, pillows are great !
It’s important to be quiet and respect the neighbors because you can hear everything behind these walls !
The building and the appartement are very safe, we had a code to get in so that’s very convenient.
Thank you very much Pere and Eva, we had an amazing time !
Logement agréable et bien situé ! Hôtes réactifs et sympathiques!

We had a great stay at Apartment Marti! We were five people and had plenty of space for everyone. The apartment is in a quiet and convenient location, and everything was exactly as described in the listing.
The hosts were super friendly, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. We really appreciated their hospitality and would definitely recommend the apartment to others visiting Barcelona. Thank you for a great stay!

We had a great stay in this apartment. It is well located, with a metro station nearby, making it easy to get around Barcelona. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and matched the description, and we really enjoyed our time here.
The only downside was a small issue with the air conditioning, which was a bit frustrating during our stay. Apart from that, everything went well.
Overall, we had a good stay and would recommend this apartment.
A fantastic stay ,memories made forever in a beautiful apartment .Organised and everything explained very well. Will definitely stay again

Tuvimos todo lo necesario y más a nuestra disposición en nuestra visita. Está muy bien ubicado y nuestra host fue sumamente atenta
Excelente experiencia

Very helpful by leaving a map and giving us feedback about different attractions.  Let us keep our bags in the apartment after check out to explore the city a little more before heading to the airport.  Location close to public transportation and walkable. Thank you Rosario and Alex!
很好的住宿环境

Very hot inside the apartment, need to open windows to sleep, after opening windows there are mosquitos came into the bedroom.  So sleeping is difficult and uncomfortable due to no real air-conditioning and with mosquito.

Alex and Maria are great, offered great advice and information about the city on arrival. The flat is clean and tidy and certainly enough space for the 4 of us, however easily room for a 5th. Flat can be quite warm due to being on the 9th floor, however a lovely view from the balcony.
Great location from the metro and only a few stops away from central Barcelona.

Appartement fonctionnel conforme à la description et aux photos . Maria a été très accueillante, pro-active sur notre arrivée . Elle nous a donné toutes les informations nécessaires pour rendre notre séjour agréable. Avec nos 2 ados, emplacement à proximité du métro nous permettant de nous rendre facilement dans tous les quartiers à visiter et le clou la vue sur La Sagrada Familia (enfin le haut des tours!). Je recommande vivement cet appartement pour une découverte de Barcelone .
Very nice apartment to stay in

Schöne Wohnung im 9. Stock mit drei Schlafzimmern und kleinem Balkon (jedoch nur für 2 Personen zum Draußensitzen) und Lift. Gut ausgestattete Küche mit schönem Esszimmer und Blick über die Dächer. Insgesamt eher ruhige Wohngegend, jedoch auch nicht so ansprechend, dass man gerne abends dort ausgeht. Zu zwei näheren Metrostationen läuft man ca. 8-10 Minuten.
Sehr gute Kommunikation und Betreuung durch Vermieter.
环境不错 安静 值得拥有

Host was lovely really responsive and easy to talk to , gave us lots of recommendations and went out of their way to make sure we knew where to go. Apartment was great looks exactly like it does on photos. The building is right next to the metro station so transport is perfect

Bardzo piękne mieszkanie, dokładnie jak na zdjęciach. Wszystko zgodnie z opisem. Przestronne, winda, blisko sklepy spożywcze oraz bary i restauracje. Dobry dojazd z lotniska, blisko metro. Spokojna uliczka, nie było słychać hałasu z głównej ulicy. Super kontakt z właścicielem.
We really enjoyed our stay and our apartment was perfect. The host was really sweet and helpful and answering quickly, even provided us tips on sights and restaurants which was really helpful.
Mieszkanie zgodne z opisem, blisko stacji metra.
Ringrazio per la disponibilità

The place is nice, clean, and neat, but when we arrive the heater was not working even though we already turned it on and Alex doesn’t help much  about that so my friends and I are quiet shivering while staying

This home is in the hills overlooking Barcelona with amazing views of the city. The place was wonderful...The host, Vanessa, was very responsive, friendly, and flexible in check in / check out to help with our travel needs. The living room is especially spacious and comfortable with a balcony that shows you the entire city and the sea beyond. Zero complaints - everything was great!
Tutto perfetto

Beautiful place with a very friendly host,
Thank you for the stay!

I stayed with my family and close friend for a few days over May half term. We had a wonderful time exploring the city. The apartment is well located close to 2 metro stations and a great base with lots of supermarkets, cafes and a bakery right outside. The view is wonderful - we can see why Vanessa was taken with it. And it was great to be in a neighbourhood slightly further out from the tourist hustle and bustle of La Rambla. We could also walk to Parc Güell  and there was several other green spaces within 5 mins of the apartment. The apartment had everything we needed but we weren’t there much as there are so many things to see and do in Barcelona.

Ho soggiornato con la mia famiglia e siamo stati molto bene. Zona tranquilla vista stupenda. Fuori dal caos ma con una passeggiata di 15/20 minuti sei in centro. Maglio che stare in zone turistiche. Tanti supermercati e negozio di ogni genere nelle vicinanze .

Vanessa's apartment is really something special! The apartment lies in a lovely, calm, and safe neighbourhood with absolutely fantastic view over the ocean and the Sagrada Familia, which is in walking distance from the apartment.
The apartment is well equipped furniture- and amenities-wise. We were two sisters and four children and the three bedrooms were ideal for us.
The only drawback was the somewhat loud traffic noise from the street below.
Vanessa was a very helpful and responsive host, replying quickly when we had questions.
Highly recommend this place!
spacious, clean, well equipped and comfortable

The apartment is very spacious, comfortable beds and has everything you need in it.
The elevator works well, the only thing that we found out that the place is a bit on a noisy side, you can hear the neighbors going in and out of their apartment, the street is a bit busy and at night the garbage trucks and the busses are passing by.
Overall we loved the place, the supermarkets right beside the apartment, the bus stop 2 min walk, Sagra Famila 20 min walk. Lots of restaurants and cafes. for sure will go back.
Vanessa was very friendly and when we asked her for something, was done in no time.
Thank you Vanessa for hosting us and helping us with everything. A nice place with a beautiful view and a great host who  was very responsive and helpful. Absolutely recomendable!
这间房子景色非常优美，能看到巴塞罗那的海景和著名的圣家堂建筑。房子楼下就有很多超市，以及公交车站，步行到地铁口也只需要5-10分钟，出行十分方便。房东回应也很及时，入住和退房时间灵活，值得推荐

Beautiful apartment with an amazing view! Perfect size for our group. Vanessa was very welcoming and helpful and gave us lots of dinner recommendations. The apartment is great value for Barcelona and within easy reach of the metro. I would highly recommend!

Wir waren jetzt mit Freunden zum zweiten Mal in Vanessas Wohnung. Für uns ist die Lage perfekt, weil unsere spanischen Freunde direkt um die Ecke wohnen. Obwohl man bei offenen Fenstern viel von der Straße mitbekommt, ist der Blick über Barcelona traumhaft. Alle Sehenswürdigkeiten sind gut zu erreichen (Metro fußläufig. Bus direkt vor der Tür).

Wir hatten einen sehr tollen Aufenthalt. Der Check In und Out verlief reibungslos. Es wurde auf all unsere Wünsche eingegangen. Die Wohnung ist sehr zentral, man findet alles was man braucht. Geschäfte sowie Bus und Bahn sind Flussläufig zu erreichen. Es ist etwas hellhörig. Vielen Dank für die tolle Zeit 🫶🏻

We really enjoyed our stay at Vanessa’s.  The apartment is very nice, has ample room for six people and breathtaking views of the city and the sea.  Also, we enjoyed that the apartment is located in a non-touristy area, which felt like a more authentic experience of the city.  The metro stop is a short walk distance away and the walk to Sagrada Familia was about half an hour of leisurely walk. Vanessa is a kind and responsive host.  Everything about our stay was perfect and we would be happy to return!

Wir hatten eine fantastische Zeit in dieser wunderschönen Wohnung in Barcelona! Die Lage ist perfekt, alles ist nah und die Wohnung ist sauber und komfortabel. Die Ausstattung ist top und die Kommunikation mit der Vermieterin war sehr freundlich und hilfreich. Besonders beeindruckend ist der atemberaubende Blick aus der Wohnung, der uns jeden Morgen aufs Neue begeistert hat. Wir haben uns wie zu Hause gefühlt und können diese Wohnung nur weiterempfehlen. Vielen Dank für die schöne Zeit in Barcelona!
Was a very nice appartement.

Merci Vanessa, beaucoup d’attention et de réactivité.  L’appartement est conforme à la description . Il est spacieux et 3 vrais chambres confortables . La cuisine est très bien équipée. Il y a 2 petites salles de douche  avec un wc dans chaque . La terrasse est très bien aménagée et la vue remarquable car nous sommes sur une colline . Le système d’ouverture de l’immeuble est un peu difficile la première fois pour des novices mais Vanessa est très disponible . Je conseillerais sans soucis cet appartement pour un séjour à Barcelone .

We had a fabulous stay at Vanessa’s condo in Barcelona! The location is excellent — close to everything yet peaceful and perfect for families. The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and equipped with everything we needed. Vanessa is a wonderful, responsive host who made our stay seamless and enjoyable. We definitely recommend this place and would love to return!
loved it here. the view is stunning. we stayed for 4 days. would highly recommend, especially for the bus stop right outside of the place!

Nous avons passé un très beau séjour. Vanessa nous a offert une alternative facile pour ouvrir la porte dû à un mal fonctionnement. Nous avons aussi suivi ses recommandations de restaurants et de taxi également. L’appartement offre une très belle vue de Barcelone. Il est aussi très accessible via les transports en commun qui sont très faciles à utiliser à Barcelone. L’appartement est aussi très près de deux petites épiceries (littéralement quelques mètres plus loin). Nous avons grandement apprécié les deux salles de bain également. Merci Vanessa pour le bel accueil!

De host was zeer vriendelijk, bereikbaar en behulpzaam. De airbnb voldeed aan alle verwachtingen. Het centrum is zeer vlot bereikbaar met de metro en er zijn voldoende supermarkten op wandelafstand. We hebben er heel erg van genoten!!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Casa perfetta, esattamente come nella descrizione. Posizione comodissima: la metro Maragall è a soli 4 minuti a piedi, ma l’appartamento si trova in una via laterale, quindi la zona è molto silenziosa nonostante la vicinanza alla fermata. L’alloggio è piccolo ma estremamente pulito e funzionale, ideale per chi cerca praticità senza rinunciare al comfort. La host è stata gentilissima e super disponibile: una vera Super Host! Consigliatissima.

It is a nice place to stay while visiting Barcelona. It is not a short walk to the major sites but only a few metro stops. Excellent shape of the apartment, with all amenities included and we didn’t miss anything during the stay. The communication was flawless and friendly. We were even allowed early check in, which was greatly appreciated since we arrived early in town. Great value for the price. Overall, I would highly recommend this place to stay. Thank you!
Alloggio molto accogliente dotato di qualsiasi confort. Mercé sempre disponibile per soddisfare qualsiasi esigenza. Davvero molto soddisfatta. Lo consiglio.
Merces son greeted us at the apt and allowed us to store our luggage before check in. The apartment was located in a quiet neighborhood and is conveniently accessible to the subway station.
Nos encantó, Merce es súper amable, el apartamento está muy bien y el trato a sido increíble. A parte tiene el metro a 3 min por lo que está muy bien comunicado. Recomendadisimo

Nous avons passé quelques jours à Barcelone en profitant de cet appartement comme pied à terre. Très bien situé par rapport aux lignes de bus et de métro, l'appartement est agréable et bien équipé. Malgré des nuits très chaudes, nous avons pu bien dormir grâce aux ventilateurs mis à disposition.
La propriétaire a été très réactive dans les échanges.
Je recommande

Merci à Mercè pour nos échanges et d’être réactif à nos questions. Appartement très propre et équipés , proche du métro à quelques stations du centre. On trouve facilement des places de parking autour sinon un parking à 5 minutes à pieds.
Hemos estado muy cómodos en este apartamento, tanto por lo bien equipado que está como por su cercanía de parking metros y autobuses para visitar Barcelona. Merce ha sido muy amable. Lo recomendamos!
Es war alles prima, gerne wieder:-)

Fabulous place, highly recommend!
We share a family with 2 kids, stayed for 2 nights and felt very comfortable.
The apartment is perfectly equipped, situated in a great location and the owner is very helpful, communicative and flexible.
Thanks a lot Merce and team!

Mussten kurzfristig Umbuchen, hätten nicht's besseres finden können .
So eine liebe herzliche Gastgeberin einfach top!!!!

Mercè fue muy amable y estuvo muy pendiente de todo haciéndonos algunas recomendaciones muy útiles. El piso muy completo y relativamente cerca del centro para poder ir a pie. Zona muy tranquila y familiar con supermercados cerca y buenas cafeterías para desayunar. Repetiría sin duda.

Wij hebben het heel fijn gehad in dit appartement! Fijne ruimte en heerlijk licht en schoon. Mercé is een snel reagerende en vriendelijke host. De locatie is dichtbij het centrum en om de hoek zitten de metro en een supermarkt. Dus echt een aanrader als verblijf in Barcelona.
Had a wonderful few days in Mercé's appt. Mercé is a wonderful host, very responsive and helpful. Her flat is beautiful and kept very well. Would highly recommend for any trip to Barcelona.

Además de todo lo reflejado decir que debe mejorar la cerradura de la puerta, es un primero sin ascensor y sobre todo no ir con coche porque todo es aparcamiento para residentes, por tanto debes proveer económicamente el pago de un parking.

Appartement fonctionnel, acces proche métro pour visiter Barcelone facilement en famille avec 2 enfants de 7 et 10 ans.
Merci est très réactive. nous avons passé 2 très bonnes nuits
Wszystko zgodne z opisem. Mieszkanie bardzo czyste, właścicielka bardzo mila. Blisko do metra, w pobliżu jest co zjeść. Spokojna bezpieczna okolica. polecam 🙂

très bel appartement. Bonne literie. accès métro facile. parking payant voiture à 400 mètres.
contente d'être arrivée avec une clim en marche et une bouteille d'eau au frigo.
Increíble estancia, muy ordenado y limpio el apartamento.

Mein Partner und ich waren für 5 Tage in Barcelona und haben uns hierfür Angeles' Wohnung ausgesucht - was soll ich sagen: WOW!
Die Wohnung und die große Terrasse sind wunderschön, die Öffis sind zu Fuß gut erreichbar & das Viertel ist insgesamt sehr angenehm, man fühlt sich hier sehr wohl!
Angeles ist eine super liebe Gastgeberin und stand uns bei Fragen jederzeit zur Verfügung.
Wir sagen Gracias und kommen sehr gerne wieder! 😊

We really enjoyed our first time in Barcelona, we will definitely be coming back.
Angeles’ place was great for us, it was spacious, clean and had great views.
It was slightly further out of the city than we anticipated but the metro is really easy to get the hang of (recommend getting a 10 trip pass , much better value)
Parking Sótano - 15 minute walk from the apartment- was one of the best steaks we had ever had, seriously recommend
Bar Pimentel - in the city centre - absolutely amazing tapas
Thank you Angeles

Riesige Terrasse
Tolle Lage
Really beautiful place with breathtaking view. Huge terrace with lounge options. We really loved it and would recommend it any time
The accommodation is as described online, very clean, pretty and charming. The localisation is good. Angeles is very nice and helpful. I really recommend it and will surely come back here one day!

Es war wundervoll, die Wohnung ist wunderschön eingerichtet und der Balkon ist Mega, richtiger Jackpot, ein paar süße Bäcker sind auch in der Nähe. Angeles hat ganz schnell immer geantwortet, und alles war super, eine Sache hätte ich nur für die Angeles aber nichts kann, wenn man im Sommer dort ist und Strand eingeplant hat liegt die Wohnung leider ungünstig, da eine 1 1/2h Bus Fahrt zum täglichen Programm gehört. Das ist einfach ein blöder Zufall, aber alles was mit der Wohnung zutun hat ist wundervoll !!! Wenn es sich ergibt, kommen wir aufjedenfall wieder !!!!!!!!

Angeles let us do an early check in as the apartment was not rented the night before. It was helpful due to our long flight. We did have one issue, the night of Spain beating Belgium was an old night all around. They were celebrating all over. No fault of his. Just wish I was in a bar to celebrate with the locals
Such a beautiful place. Loved the balcony.

A fabulous place to stay with a great host. The apartment had everything we needed and more. The location is great with lots of amenities close by. The highlight was the beautiful terrace. We would love to stay again if we return to Barcelona.

You won’t find many better and more special places in Barcelona. The location is very walkable to most areas of Barcelona, if you don’t mind getting the steps in. The apartment and particularly the balcony are incredible and we were very lucky to be there.

Fantastic apartment with amazing terrace. Comfortable bed and everything you need for your stay. Excellent location for metro, trains and buses. Angeles was an excellent host and very accommodating. Highly recommend this apartment.

Superbe terrasse super agréable
L’appartement est très bien placé
Et Angeles est très réactif
Merci pour les chocolats :)

Angeles' apartment was clean and comfortable and has a light and airy feel. The terrace was great for reading and relaxing, and we loved watching and listening to the birds in the mornings. Great communication and clear instructions from Angeles from the time of booking. She was very understanding when our flight (and therefore our check in) was delayed by several hours and we arrived late at night. This was the third time I stayed in Gracia and my favourite accommodation so far. My mum and I had a lovely stay. Thank you!

Wonderful stay at the airbnb. We were very comfortable and the terrace is really nice. We really enjoyed our little quiet place from the busy city. The bed was very comfortable and we slept very well. The kitchen is on the smaller side but still functional and nothing that we needed was missing. Really a nice spot that we really enjoyed. Angeles was very friendly, helpful and we had a little treat when we checked in which was very thoughtful.

Great place to stay. Angeles was a great host, very organised and responsive to any questions. Really helpful information about places to eat close by and local supermarket. Beautiful terrace with amazing views. Would highly recommend the apartment when staying in Barcelona.

Wow this Airbnb was amazing! Angeles our host was very communicative and recommended us some great cafes/restaurants and was very responsive if we had a question. The location is great and very close to public transport. And the terrace! Wow such a highlight - beautiful views of the city. Will definitely stay here again
広いテラスで朝食がとても気持ち良かったです。

Angeles was a great host, great communication and instructions. Very helpful and informative about how to get to the apartment and around Barcelona. 5* hosting. The apartment was amazing and clean, had everything we needed for our weekend break. Great location to loads of nearby supermarket and coffee shops and bus and train into the centre of Barcelona. Would highly recommend staying here and we definitely will again if we return.
this accommodation was beautiful. we took advantage of the sunshine on the amazing rooftop terrace
beautiful space that was perfect for our couple of days in Barcelona. INCREDIBLE view!
Amazing place, and friendly host.

Квартира Мо выглядит лучше чем на картинках. В ней было все для комфортной жизни от геля для стирки до капсул для кофе. Важным плюсом для нас было наличие 2 туалетов и большого пространства, где каждому из нашей компании нашлось место. Сама Мо была очень доброжелательной, открытой. Она встретила нас в квартире после самолёта и объяснила базовые правила проживания в ней. Важно отметить, что квартира находится на 5 этаже без лифта. При бронировании мы это пропустили, но это не отразилось на нашем впечатлении от квартиры.
Мо, спасибо вам за гостеприимство!

Mo's apartment was the perfect place to stay as a family (one 13yo) for our short visit to the city for Festa Major de Gràcia. The neighbourhood is full of character and super easy to explore; a short walk to Metro and buses also. The apartment itself is big, spacious, clean and very nicely presented and the a/c was a certainly a welcome relief from the very hot weather during our stay! The lightning around the apartment is great and that always makes such a difference to a place feeling homely and comfortable. Two proper separate bedrooms are a great bonus, as a family, and there was plenty of storage in both. The Wi-Fi was faultless. It is quite a steep narrow climb up the stairs from the street level so be prepared for a good workout! We would certainly stay again in future and recommend the apartment highly!

Mooi, ruim appartement. Goede bedden, grote koelkast, 2 airco’s. Ook badkamer met douche, wc en wastafel en nog een aparte wc.  2 woonkamers en een keuken. Schoon en dichtbij een supermarkt, bakker en het openbaar vervoer.

Absolutely excellent- had everything we needed, was cool and comfortable in the heat, central location made it easy to get around. Only downside is the walk up, which is clearly noted (and makes the AC feel great). Would easily stay here again, and recommend.

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohlgefühlt! Sie war für uns zu dritt sehr geräumig, mit allem ausgestattet, was man für einen Aufenthalt braucht und hat eine wunderbare Lage. Wir waren drei Nächte dort und sowohl die Kommunikation als auch der Check-in und Check-out haben problemlos geklappt. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder – klare Empfehlung!

I stayed with my family in Barcelona for several days before our return flight home. If I have the chance to return and stay for longer, I would hope to be able to stay in Mo's place again. It is a lovely apartment. It is clean, bright, and well located, sort of on the border of Gracia and Eixample. There are many cafes and restaurants nearby, and the apartment itself is a pleasant place to relax. We loved staying in this apartment!

Fantastic apartment in a very quiet area with no noise from neighbours, lots of room inside and very comfortable beds and seating area.  Close to 3 metro stations and 10 mins walk to Sagrada Família.  Aldi shop right outside the front door and I would definitely stay here again.  Highly recommended
Tout était parfait. Merci Mo pour votre accueil et logement de qualité

Wir wurden persönlich begrüßt und hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit. Die Wohnung (4.Etage) entspricht den Bildern u. Beschreibung und liegt ideal. Man erreicht zu Fuß fix Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants und ÖPNV. Klare Empfehlung.
Bel appartement bien situé je le recommande à 100%
We loved our stay! It is a great neighborhood and the apartment has all of the modern luxuries we wanted while maintaining the charm and elegance of historical Barcelona.

Atrakcyjnie położony apartament, w niedalekiej odległości liczne atrakcje turystyczne, kilka supermarketów i różne restauracje (w tym bezglutenowe). Trzeba być gotowym na wchodzenie na czwarte piętro po schodach, ale doskonała lokalizacja to rekompensuje.
We had a wonderful stay in the apartment. Fantastic location for exploring the city and the apartment had all the amenities we needed for our stay.

Great location ,steps to Aldi and many places to eat , never felt unsafe late at night , great neighbourhood , only negative was the stairs to unit which we knew about , would recommend just because location outstanding , half hour walk to gothic quarters and 10 minute walk to gaudi Batlló.

Mo’s place was beautiful and as described. The stairs were tough (5 flights x 17 steps each), especially with luggage b/c they are narrow but walking into an AC home was so worth it.
She waited late for us and showed us around the home. Well stocked, clean and spacious. The middle bedroom can get really hot (window opens to an enclosed space that gets no air flow and there’s no AC in that room so we brought in an extra fan. I appreciate having the washer & drying rack. Traveled as family of 4 and my kids enjoyed having separate beds. Thank you Mo.

L appartamento di Mo è stupendo, confortevole, comodo e super fornito. Ha un meraviglioso affaccio sulla Sagrada Familia e a piedi si possono raggiungere tutti i siti di maggiore interesse!!! è stato bellissimo stare da te!!! grazie ancora
Casa accogliente e attrezzata. Posizione comoda e tranquilla. Proprietaria gentile e disponibile
We loved the neighbourhood! Mo was very responsive and friendly. We would stay here again.

Die Unterkunft liegt gut 500 Meter von der Metrostation Diagonal entfernt und ist zu Fuß in ein paar Minuten zu erreichen. Sie ist in der 5. Etage und die Treppe ist sehr schmal. Die Wohnung selber ist geräumig und entspricht den Bildern.
Wir konnten auf Nachfrage bereits um 11:30 Uhr unsere Koffer dort abstellen und haben den Schlüssel bekommen. In der Zeit bis 14 Uhr wurde dort noch gereinigt.
In der Umgebung gibt es zahlreiche Bistros und Restaurants. Die Sagrada Familia ist vom Balkon zu sehen und nur 10 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt.
Fazit: Die Unterkunft ist zentral gelegen und für den Preis OK. Es ist zwar alles etwas in die Jahre gekommen, aber man ist ja meist nur zum schlafen da. Für uns war es OK.
Really friendly and communicative host, super nice and clean Airbnb. Comfortable, they have ac, there was a washing machine and two balconies.

Vi havde et dejligt ophold. Lejligheden har en god placering tæt på stranden og byen.
Lejligheden passede godt til os, en familie på fire.
Faciliteterne er fine blandt andet med god aircondition.
Vi har været tilfredse med opholdet.
Bel appartement exceptionnellement proche de la plage. L'hôte est très sympathique et ses recommandations sur Barcelone étaient vraiment super !

We had a wonderful stay! The place is charming, spotlessly clean, and fully equipped with everything we needed. The beach is just a two minutes walk, and the area is fantastic, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, and grocery shops nearby. Despite being so convenient, the neighbourhood is quiet and peaceful, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
Alejandro was an amazing host. He was always quick to respond to any questions and incredibly helpful with recommendations, which made everything so easy.
Thank you, Alejandro, for everything and for making our stay so enjoyable. We would absolutely love to come back!
This is a cute spot within walking distance of a lot of great spots. The terrace alone makes it worth it.

Ons verblijf bij het appartement van Alejandro in Poblenou was redelijk goed.
Er was geen persoonlijke ontvangst, alle communicatie verliep via de app. Appartement bij aankomst openen via de vive app en sleutels lagen op de tafel. Even uitzoeken maar het werkt.
Het gebouw is oud maar het appartement is opgefrist met witte wanden en een strakke vloer. De keuken is klein en de badkamer is ondermaats. Het is eigenlijk een nis in de hal. De douche was vies, toilet zitting versleten en je kijkt vanuit de douche in een gat met de afvoeren.
Wij vonden het appartement redelijk in orde maar prijs/ kwaliteit niet helemaal in verhouding. Ook de balkons zijn klein, maar ze zijn er wel.
Omgeving was goed. Dichtbij het strand. Openbaar vervoer verschillende opties dichtbij. De Rambla de Poblenou zit om de hoek en heeft veel restaurantjes en winkels.
Everything was really perfect! Thank you, host! ❤️
Lovely place, super kind host, place is so close to the beach, but easy access to the lively parts of the city via metro!! 10/10 would recommend!
This was such a great spot for a girls trip. We were able to walk to most places and had cheap taxis to the more touristy spots.

We had a fantastic stay in this charming apartment in Poblenou. The location is perfect for a Barcelona city break with a beach focus, just a short walk from the sea and surrounded by lovely cafés and restaurants.
The apartment was spotless, very comfortable, and had everything we needed. The beds were super comfy, the WiFi was excellent, and the shower pressure was great too!
Our host was attentive, friendly, and proactive throughout, making everything easy from start to finish. We’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for the best of both the city and the beach.
The apartment was in a great location for waking to the beach and shops. It was clean and just what we needed for our weekend at the beach.

Een hele fijne locatie, in de buurt van het strand. Het appartement was perfect en de omgeving zeer fijn. Alejandro was goed bereikbaar maar attent dat hij vroeg hoe we waren aangekomen en of we nog dingen nodig hadden. Echt een aanrader.

The only downside was the Barcelona tourist tax. We were charged the tax for all the adults in our group, which came as a surprise. Jordi mentioned that it was included in the listing description, but I went back to check and couldn’t find that information. During our trip, we stayed in Madrid, Valencia, and two other Airbnb properties in Barcelona before and after visiting France, and we were never asked to pay an additional municipal tax separately. It would provide a better guest experience if this cost were included in the Airbnb booking price, or at least made much more prominent before booking, so guests aren’t surprised by an unexpected cash payment upon arrival.
