O apto estava de acordo com a descrição e fotos, local tranquilo, bairro residencial, fácil acesso ao Metrô, na Sagrada Familia e parque Güell fomos caminhando, conhecendo região, comunicação fácil com o Jordi, deu dicas da região e até contato para táxi para retorno ao aeroporto, porém não utilizamos, deu tudo certo, com certeza se voltar para Barcelona outro vez, tentaremos retornar neste mesmo apto
vše ok, dobrá lokace, dobře se spalo, klid, chyběla nám akorát varná konvice

Anders’ apartment is perfectly located for getting around Barcelona. The apartment itself was exactly what we wanted—the beds were comfortable, everything was clean, the balcony was cozy, and we had all the supplies we needed for our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend it! 👌

El piso estaba bien, tal cual la publicacion, en mi caso solo dormi una noche alli y mas que suficiente.  La zona no me agrado mucho, hay obras justo en la calle donde esta el piso pero nunca escuchamos nada. Buena comunicacion con el anfitrion sin embargo bastante insistente con preguntas que me parecian innecesarias sobre la llegada y la salida. Por ultimo creo que podrian tener el gesto de dejar una botellita de agua, es un tercero sin ascensor y por la inclinacion de las escaleras llevas arriba exhausto.
Everything went smoothly. AC working brilliantly!

Very clean, comfortable, and centrally located apartment with excellent public transport connections. It was spacious enough for four people. The main downside was the very steep and narrow stairs to the fourth floor, especially with large luggage. Communication at check-in was difficult as the person welcoming us did not speak English. The kitchen was well equipped, but a few basics such as salt and sugar would have been appreciated. Overall, a very good stay.

Posizione ottimale, vicinissimo alla fermata delle metro, ben arredato, aria condizionata essenziale considerato che abbiamo soggiornato in un agosto molto afoso. Unico neo le ripide scale. Per il resto ottimo.

Appartement bien placé.
A 2 minutes à pied du métro Paral-lel
Voyager léger car il y a l entre sol et les 3 étages à monter !
Il manque des rangements dans la salle de bain.

Anders is a fantastic host. He made checking in and checking out very easy. The place was very clean and tidy. The kitchen, air conditioning, nespresso machine, and laundry washer were perfect for us. The shower water pressure and temperature were outstanding. We really enjoyed the very walkable location, with stores, restaurants, and sight seeing close by. I only wish we had more time to stay there.

We had a great stay! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and in a great location for exploring Barcelona. The host was extremely accommodating, professional, and easy to communicate with, which made everything from arrival to checkout very smooth. The apartment is on the 4th floor, so just something to keep in mind if travelling with lots of luggage, but it certainly didn’t take away from our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend it!

Öncelikle bizim mesajlarımıza hızlı dönmesi ve ilgilenmesi bizi çok mutlu etti. Ev normaldi kirli değildi. Biz ulaşımdan dolayı 1 saat geç kalmamıza rağmen bizi beklediler ve çok yardımcı oldular.  Hatta eve geldiğimizde klimayı da açmışlardı. Tek problem 3. Katta olması ve merdivenlerin dar olmasıydı. Çünkü valiz çıkarmak çok zor oldu.
Leuke locatie in de wijk Poble-Sec. het appartement ligt op de derde verdieping (70 treden). Vanuit het appartement is de stad goed te ontdekken, zeker als je fietsen huurt.

We had a great stay at the apartment. It was easy to find, clean, and exactly as described. The beds were comfortable, and the apartment had everything we needed. The air conditioning was great, and having laundry facilities was a huge bonus. It’s conveniently located close to the metro and bus stops, making it easy to get around the city. The location is great, and the host was friendly, responsive, and very helpful throughout our stay. Thank you for having us.

Die Unterkunft war super. Alles war sehr gepflegt, sauber und gemütlich eingerichtet. Auch die Beschreibung stimmte mit allem überein. Die Übergabe war reibungslos und auch sehr flexibel mit der Ankunftszeit, es war zur jederzeit jemand zu erreichen.
Vielen Dank an den Gastgeber.

Hola la verdad que el apto estaba muy limpio y acogedor.
Las cama cómodas todo impecable
Lo recomiendo y si fuese yo volvería de nuevo
Very good location, within walking distance from L Rambla and close to metro. Clean apartment, good value for money
Logement idéal pour visiter Barcelone. Très bien situé.
Grande Anders

It was a wonderful apartment in a convenient location. I was with two kids (18 and 14) We could walk many places and metro makes us even easier to access to everywhere! The place has everything which we needed and also their description about the house was very helpful. The stairs were hard to go up with luggage’s but we knew before booking the place. Anders were great host to guide us. Thanks for the easy communication. I would like to recommend this place!
Gracias Anders por dejarnos alojar 1 noche. Estaba todo perfecto, limpio y cómodo. Muy agradecidos

We had a lovely stay at Mire’s apartment! The location is great, close to both Sagrada Família and Park Güell, and the neighborhood is really nice. The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures, which was great.
Mire was kind and helpful throughout our stay and made sure we had everything we needed. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again!

El piso es increíble y está exactamente como aparece en las fotos. Todo está muy cuidado, limpio y en perfecto estado, por lo que no hay sorpresas al llegar. Es un alojamiento precioso, cómodo y acogedor, ideal para disfrutar de una estancia agradable. Sin duda, una experiencia totalmente recomendable.
buena ubicacion Mire muy responsable el apto impecable lo recomiendo
Lovely apartment with a lovely, very flexible and communicative host 🙏🏼
Sin dudas volveríamos! La atención de Mire muy amable y de súper ayuda con todo lo que necesitábamos. Muy predispuesta
The apartment was nice, comfortable and so quiet! We slept so well. The host is very friendly and welcoming, perfect in communication
Excelente ubicación , lugar perfecto y Mire siempre al pendiente.. lo recomiendo 100%

Logement impeccable proche du centre de Barcelone !
La climatisation était très discrète et bienvenue.
Avec une petite marche, on peut même avoir une vue dégagée sur tout Barcelone !
Merci Mire pour votre accueil
El dpto y la atencion excelente, la ubicacion un poquito lejos, pero super bien conectada con el metro

Mire의 하우스는 매우 정돈잘되어있고 깔끔합니다. 위치도 매우 좋아 주요관광지에 걸어서 갈수있고, 주변이 매우 조용하고 평화롭습니다. Mire는 매우 친절히 응답해주고 열심히 설명해줍니다. 바로 근처에 살고있어 갑작스런 질문이나 상황에 매우 잘 대처해줍니다. 영어 소통은 가능하나 유창하진않습니다만 번역앱을 사용하면 무리없이 소통가능합니다. 다시 바르셀로나로 온다면 꼭 다시 묵고싶은 공간입니다. Mire~ 즐거운 경험이어서 감사해요~~!
Muy bonito y bien ubicado, la anfitriona fue muy amable en todo momento!
Good value apartment and close to public transport. Even nicer in-person than the pictures show.
Gut gelegen in direkter Nähe zu Sagrada Família. Und für angebunden mit der Metro. Freundlicher Host, alles wie beschrieben, sehr zu empfehlen

Mirella’s place is in a great location walkable to the main attractions and with a metro close by.  She was very helpful and made our stay in Barcelona very comfortable.  The apartment could use some updating but was a great value and everyone was so friendly it made for a wonderful visit!
Una excelente opción en Barcelona. Bien ubicado, limpio y agradable

Excelente el trato de Mire e Iván, siempre solucionando cualquier cosa, había mucho calor por la temporada y todavía nos trajo un clima adicional para poder refrescar más los cuartos. Gran disposición de ambos me vuelvo a quedar sin duda ahí por la amabilidad y el trato!! Muchas gracias !!

Mire’s place was exactly as described.  Was a little out of the main tourist areas but the metro was very easy to use and some of the main attractions were about a 25 min walk.  The place was very clean and Mire was so easy to communicate with.   Would recommend staying here if you want a quieter area.

We loved our stay in Barcelona! Mire was a great host and showed us around everything in the Airbnb. The place is beautiful with so much room, sun porch, and living room. We felt right at home here, would definitely be back!
Loved our stay. Super conveniently located. Mire, provided us with helpful information upon our arrival.

Muy buen apartamento con todo lo necesario para pasar unos días en Barcelona.
Es tal cual las fotos, en un barrio muy tranquilo y a 15-20 minutos caminando de la iglesia Notre Dame. Mire fue flexible con la hora de ingreso lo que fue genial ya que viajamos con mis hijas. Metro y súper muy cerca! Lo recomiendo!!!

Thank you Alice! Having stayed more central in the city before, I much prefer this area of Poblenou. Cute bars and cafes, feels much more laid back and minutes from the beach. Feels very safe building too and the communal terrace on the roof is a plus!

Wij hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in Barcelona! Vanaf het moment van boeken was het contact met Feelgoodhome ontzettend prettig: snel, zeer vriendelijk en professioneel.
De locatie van het appartement is echt top. Midden in het gezellige Poblenou en op loopafstand van Rambla del Poblenou, de metro én het strand. Een perfecte uitvalsbasis om Barcelona te ontdekken en tegelijkertijd te genieten van de fijne sfeer van deze wijk.
Het appartement is leuk en netjes ingericht en was bij aankomst prima schoon.
Verder hebben wij hier met ontzettend veel plezier verbleven en kijken we terug op een heerlijke tijd in Barcelona. Zeker een fijne plek om te verblijven!
Ruim appartement op loopafstand metro, echte supermarkt heel dichtbij (ALDI) en ook een gewone supermarkt. Klein supermarktje onder gebouw. Strand op 10 min lopen
Thank you:)

The apartment is in a great location, close to both the beach and the metro. It’s a lovely, comfortable place with everything you need for a pleasant stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would stay again.
Everything was fine, the location was super! 💝

很棒！

The place is very amazing. We love the location so close to the sea. And that balcony with view to the sea or Sagrada Familia.
Fue solo una noche pero muy acogedor apartamento con lo necesario para estar cómodo y fácil acceso a playa y zonas de turismo gracias
tutto perfetto, host molto disponibile e gentile e l’appartamento era come nella descrizione, bello, pulito, fornito, comodo. siamo molto soddisfatte

Local super agradável

War super! :)

Wir waren in der Unterkunft 3 Personen und es hat an nichts gefehlt. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral mit dem Fahrrad, was man sich in der Umgebung ausleihen kann (Bolt,Lime usw…) benötigt man 15 min in die Innenstadt.
Alles war Sauber und die Gastgeberin hat zuverlässig auf Rückfragen geantwortet.
Le logement était très propre et vaste. La terrasse sur le toit était très bien. C’était par contre bruyant.
Magnifique séjour, lieu pas trop touristique assez calme, on y retournera avec plaisir

Excellent séjour ! Accueil très agréable et chaleureux avec recommandations. Logement propre. Équipe d’accueil disponible.
Un souci avec le code d’accès au logement nous a empêché d’entrer dans l’appartement le dernier soir mais le problème a été bien résolu.
Merci beaucoup !

This was our best stay in Europe.  Amazing location, super helpful and responsive host.  The apartment was quite large and nicely renovated.  I would highly recommend this location to anyone looking to spend time in Barcelona.
Was a great stay, place is clean, walkable to shops and train stations. Would stay again!
Everything was perfectly fine. Metro is nearby which was pretty nice.

Zimmer und Bad waren sauber. Sehr gut gelegen zu den Metros als auch Bussen. Cafés und Restaurants sind in der Nähe. Man kommt sehr gut voran zu Sehenswürdigkeiten bzw. Stadtmitte. Check-in und Check-out war unkompliziert. Man kann vor der Check-in Zeit das Gepäck gut verwahren lassen. Besonders gut war, als der Aufzug kaputt war und es am gleichen Tag repariert wurde. Rezeption war sehr freundlich. Alles im ganzen hatten wir eine positive Erfahrung

The place is exactly as described, good location with just minutes to metro and can take you to city centre. Happy with the AC in the hot weather. The washing machine is s little bit old age though and cannot spin fast enough to dry off the clothes. But overall a good place to stay and value for money

Wszystko zgodne z opisem, apartament był czyściutki i miał wszystko, co potrzeba😊 Kontakt z obsługą był bardzo szybki i sprawny. Blisko metra, przystanków autobusowych. W pobliżu jest sporo knajpek i sklepów. Polecam!
Beste Unterkunft in Barcelona zu 100 % weiterzuempfehlen Alice ist eine tolle Gastgeberin
Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt! Die Lage war für uns super. Nicht zu zentral und trotzdem sehr gut angebunden.

Nous avons eu un petit souci de logement car les anciens locataires avaient eu un souci avec le vol et nous avons été reloger directement. On nous a même amené à l’autre logement qui était magnifique. Le séjour était très agréable , je recommande grandement !

Excellent emplacement, proche des transports en commun (gare ferroviaire et métro) mais nous avons choisi de tout faire à pieds, sauf la Sagrada familia. Logement d’une très grande propreté, cuisine bien équipée, cartier tranquille, hôte réactive. Je recommande!
Great accommodation,  clean and modern apartment. Super host 👍

Un lugar lindo, limpio, fácil de llegar desde la estación.

Muy cerca a plaza España que para nosotros era ideal poder ir temprano al otro día al aeropuerto.
Un gran lugar
El apartamento era muy bueno. La zona tranquila, bonita y con muchas cosas a la mano. Metro muy cerca
Io e i miei fratelli ci siamo trovati bene, consigliano l'alloggio. Ottima posizione, vicina alla metro con la quale ci siamo spostati.

La estancia fue excelente. El apartamento estaba muy bien cuidado, limpio y cómodo, y todo funcionó perfectamente durante nuestra visita. La comunicación con Alice fue muy buena y el proceso de llegada y salida resultó sencillo y agradable. Nos sentimos muy a gusto durante toda la estancia. Sin duda, volveríamos a alojarnos aquí y lo recomendamos totalmente.
生活機能佳，附近有餐廳及超市，離地鐵入口很近，火車站也可步行到達。房子很乾淨，住得很舒服，各項設施都齊備，很方便。只是隔音略差，最後一晚來了個很嗨的鄰居，搞到很晚才睡著，除那天之外，其他天都很好睡。

We had a great stay at Feelathome Plaza while travelling with family. The apartment was clean, comfortable and exactly what we needed for our trip. The location was excellent, with good transport links nearby, making it easy to get around Barcelona.
The host was very helpful and communication was great throughout our stay. Check-in was straightforward and hassle-free.
We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
Amazing apartment and great host !!
Muy lindo el departamento, la zona y las prestaciones. Fue genial tener la terraza que aprovechamos todos los días. Andrea siempre atenta.
parfait
C te cool es manifest 👌👌👌💋 10sur 10

The apartment was great location the host were super amazing and friendly speaking perfectly English and work with our booking.   I absolutely recommend and one of the best place I ever stayed with Airbnb.   100% recommended.
Andrea is very kind and responsive. The Airbnb has a beautiful and peaceful location with walking distance to the Metro, groceries, restaurants, cafes and playgrounds. We genuinely enjoyed our stay.

This was a great stay, the apartment is really nice and spacious. The terrace is very nice but we couldn’t use it much due to the sun roof being broken, but it was still a great addition! The place felt safe and secure and check in/out was smooth. The area is accessible to trains and busses, and lots of food around. Andrea and Vanessa are great hosts and I Would definitely stay here again!
Very helpful host, great apartment and amenities, tiny ant problem.
Great location and responsive host. Everything we needed for our stay.

Appartement très confortable, parfait pour découvrir la vie dans un authentique de Barcelone, un accès facile à tous les sites touristiques, mais aussi à la montagne et à la plage.
Nous avons également télétravaillé depuis l'appartement, c'était parfait grâce à la climatisation, l'espace-temps l'agencement de l'appartement.

Das Appartement war sehr geräumig und verfügt über eine tolle Terrasse. In der Umgebung sind viele Restaurants und das Viertel ist sympathisch.
Die Kommunikation mit Andrea war sehr einfach und sie hat immer schnell geantwortet. Jederzeit wieder!

The apartment has everything you need for a short or longer stay, lovely amount of room and facility's are adequate.
Really enjoyed the balcony space, huge sun trap and shade if required.

Great stay at Andrea’s place check in was a breeze with Vanessa and then we enjoyed the peaceful location close to the metro and train station. The terrace was a great extra to enjoy breakfast and nights. Good bed and shower. We may repeat.

This place was clean, well appointed, and easy to get where you wanted to go.  I appreciated that the neighborhood was quiet, but also had all the things you would need in easy walking distance.  The close proximity to the metro made it easy to get around.  The patio and washer/dryer were nice perks. The only thing that made it a bit tricky were having so many keys.  However, the instructions were clear and after one day, we had it down.  We would definitely stay there again.
家裏需求的這裡都有、住家非常的安靜、隔音優秀、交通方便、地鐵都可以到達景點、比較了市區其它房源，此房源算是CP值較高的、空間也夠大、值得推薦

The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. The bed was comfortable, the terrace welcoming and it was very quiet and private. Andrea was a great communicator. We were less than 5 minutes from the metro and close to restaurants.

Andrea hat super schnell auf Fragen reagiert. Die Beschreibungen und Erklärungen waren klar formuliert.
Wir wollten vor allem mit unseren Sohn ins Camp Nou, das fussläufig leicht erreichbar ist. Zum Zentrum ist es etwas weiter, aber mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder wenn man einen längeren Spaziergang machen möchte ebenfalls gut zu erreichen. Das Wohnhaus ist ruhig und ordentlich. Definitiv kein Party Haus. Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt und unser Frühstück auf der ausladenden Terrasse genossen. Auch am Abend kann man da noch schön sitzen.
Insgesamt hatten wir einen schönen Aufenthalt,

Notre séjour était parfait
Le logement est propre et Andrea est très réactive
Le prix reste quand même élevé mais c’est le cas de tous les logements à Barcelone
Super séjour et  Hôte très accueillant, logement propre et conforme à l'annonce. Je recommande sans hésiter

Un apartament pozitionat foarte bine, aproape de 2 statii de metrou: Les Corts si Placa del Centre. De asemenea, la doar 10 minute de mers pe jos de gara Barcelona Sants. Se gasesc in zona suficiente magazine, farmacii si locuri in care poti manca. Apartamentul este foarte spatios, iar terasa este foarte generoasa. Cu usurinta ar fi putut acomoda chiar si 4 persoane. Intr-adevar patul scartaie destul de tare, dar a fost confortabil. As recomanda pe viitor schimbarea patului si a capacului de wc care era destul de ciobit si la prima vedere mi a dat senzatia ca nu ar fi suficient de curat, iar la sejururile mai mari de 3 zile as lasa cel putin 2 seturi de prosoape. De asemenea, mesajele si reminderele referitoare la check-out mi s-au parut putin cam intruzive. Stiu ca nu au fost adresate cu rautate, dar pot fi deranjante. As reconsidera putin modalitatea de abordare.
Per total este un apartament excelent pentru a vizita Barcelona si m-as intoarce, recomand apartamentul Andreei!

Andrea was an extremely responsive and helpful host.
The location of the property was close to a metro station and had good restaurants and supermarkets in close proximity.
We particularly enjoyed the outside space and looked forward to chilling out on the sunny terrace each evening before dinner.

Je recommande le logement ! Le logement est spacieux est très beau. L’environnement est très calme, aucun dérangement durant la nuit. Les transports sont aussi à côté. Charlie a été présent durant mon voyage, tout s’est très bien déroulé. Merci Charlie !☺️

Tout était tel que nous l'attendions. Le loft est très spacieux, il est parfaitement aménagé et est bien desservi par les transports publics barcelonais. Je reviendrais avec plaisir si je reviens à Barcelone. La climatisation était un vrai plus avec les chaleurs de cet été !

Nicely decorated retro appartment in a quiet neighborhood not far from transports that take you to the city center in about 20 min. We particularly appreciated the recommended restaurant by the park. The apartment is very comfortable for two people. Charlie is very friendly. We recommend it!
Sejour trrs agreable dans un appartement tout confort ! A booker sans hesiter.

L’appartement de Charlie est idéal pour découvrir Barcelone. Un peu à l’écart du centre, il se trouve dans un quartier calme, avec des commerces, des restaurants et des petits bars. On découvre une autre facette de la ville, tout en restant proche du centre et de la plage grâce au métro.
L’appartement est joliment décoré et plein de charme. Aménagé dans un ancien atelier, il a une vraie personnalité. On s’y sent rapidement comme chez soi ! 😌

Nagyon szép, a képeknek tökéletesen megfelel. Könnyen elérhető több tömegközlekedési eszköz. Kicsit külvárosi, sok helyi emberrel akik rendkívül segítőkészek voltak bár kevés angol tudással de a mutogatás nemzetközi. Meglepődtünk azon, hogy nagyon sok törölköző volt, illetve voltak napernyők is. A mosógép teljesen jól működött, de a zárolást elsőre nem érzékelte, érdemes erre figyelni. Összességében otthonos volt és jól éreztük magunkat.

Die Loft-Wohnung ist in einer sehr ruhigen Gegend von Barcelona angesiedelt. Viele tolle Restaurants und Parks waren in fußläufiger Nähe. Wir haben so viele tolle Speisen essen dürfen, die Leute waren super entspannt und angenehm.
Da diese Gegend nicht viele Touristen aufsuchen, sprechen einige nicht gut oder garnicht englisch, waren aber trotzdem sehr herzlich und wir haben uns teilweise auf spanisch und teilweise auf englisch zu helfen gewusst.
Keiner hat uns abgewiesen, weil wir nicht alles verstanden haben und wir fanden alle super herzlich und offen. Charlie hat uns immer gut mit Infos versorgt und wir hatten unsere Privatsphäre. Er war auch schnell erreichbar und konnte uns immer direkt weiterhelfen.
Wenn wir nach Barcelona wieder reisen sollten, dann definitiv zu Charlie! :)

Tutti come da descrizione, appartamento come da foto.
Host cortese e sempre disponibile.
Ci ha fornito indicazioni utili si supermercati di zona e sui ristoranti.
Che dire tutto ok. A++++

L’alloggio è facilmente raggiungibile con la metro. Zona tranquilla ideale se non si vuol stare nel caos del centro. L’host molto gentile e reattivo nelle risposte. Appartamento pulito e dotato di tutti i confort. Consigliato!

Charlie’s place is truly special. It’s unique, cozy, and incredibly comfortable, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. The location is excellent, offering a peaceful atmosphere while still being conveniently close to public transportation. Charlie is a fantastic host. He’s kind, welcoming, and always accommodating. We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.

Rigtig sikkert sted med en politistation kun 100 meter væk. Der er også to metrostationer, som kører direkte til centrum. Den eneste ulempe er, at stedet ligger et stykke fra centrum, men alle i boligblokken var søde og imødekommende.
Der var dog et par negative ting. Brusebadets dør gik i stykker på vores første dag – den faldt bare ned midt under badet. Derudover virkede TV’et slet ikke.
Udover de to ting var stedet virkelig hyggeligt, pænt og meget smukt. Vi havde et rigtig godt ophold.

A lovely apartment with everything we needed for our stay in Barcelona. The apartment was very clean and tidy and all as described. Short walk and metro ride to the city centre. Great communication from Charlie throughout. Would happily recommend, thank you Charlie.

Appartamento leggermente fuori dal centro ma ci si sposta facilmente con i mezzi, in 7/8 minuti a piedi si raggiungono le metro vicine e anche la fermata dell’autobus.
Ho trovato tutto pulito e ordinato, host reattivo e gentilissimo.
Tutto perfetto

Very lovely apartment and very lovely host. Charlie was very accommodating and helpful with recommendations, the apartment is nicely decorated and clean, in a good location with short walks to the L3 and L4 metro. Would definitely recommend :)

Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit in Charlies Unterkunft. Das Apartment ist klein, aber fein, gemütlich und top ausgestattet. Alles, was man braucht, ist zu Fuß erreichbar - Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants, Café, Bar und mehr. Die Gegend ist ruhig und etwas außerhalb, aber man ist schnell an der Metro und erreicht Stadtzentrum, Strand und Co. unkompliziert, schnell und ohne Umsteigen. Wir würden immer wieder kommen! Danke für die schöne Zeit :-)

Gostámos imenso da estadia!
O grande destaque vai sem dúvida para a localização. Fica numa zona residencial muito tranquila, a apenas 10 minutos a pé do metro e com fácil acesso à autoestrada, o que foi perfeito para nós. O proprietário foi extremamente atencioso e prestável, dando-nos logo dicas úteis sobre onde estacionar o carro gratuitamente.
Uma nota importante: o alojamento situa-se mesmo na face da rua e parece ter sido convertido a partir de uma antiga loja ou espaço comercial. Não tivemos qualquer problema (a zona é muito calma e segura), mas foi algo que nos surpreendeu um pouco quando chegámos, já que não era exatamente o que esperávamos pela descrição/fotos.
Ainda assim, o espaço está muito bem preparado e equipado. Tem de tudo: desde guarda-chuvas a água oxigenada, e não nos faltou nada. Recomendamos!

O loft é ótimo e super aconchegante. O bairro é bem tranquilo e super localizado. Todos os pontos turísticos da cidade são de fácil acesso porque há muitas linhas de transporte público por perto. Sem contar que tudo estava impecável e o Charlie foi um ótimo anfitrião.

Charlie was very communicative and his place was perfect for our trip, would definitely recommend!
The shop was very close by and the metro into the city was easy to navigate from the apartment as well.

Our stay was amazing. Everything was very clean and the host was very friendly and replied quickly.
The Apartment was very well equipped and the connection to the city center with the L3 and L4 is good.

Great host and wonderful stay. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout the entire visit, which made everything easy and stress-free. The space was clean, check-in was simple, and we really enjoyed staying in a part of Barcelona I might not have explored otherwise. It was a great experience overall, and I’d happily stay here again.
Super solicito e a acomodação foi satisfatória.

Good stay! The host was excellent, highly practical, and quick to resolve an issue for us. The property had all our necessities, though sleep quality could be improved as the beds were uncomfortable and there were no blackout curtains in the main bedroom.

The place is 5 mins walk to the metro station. Very secure and safe to walk at night. Appartment correctly equipped and clean. However, the master bedroom lacks an aircon. The aircon in the living room does not suffice to cool down the room.

Had a great stay in Oroil’s apartment. He sent really useful videos about the check in & car park access process & was very responsive to our queries. He was also flexible when we wanted to make changes to our booking.
The place was not that spacious but we did have 8 people in our group & everything was as described. It was central enough to be able to walk to Sagrada Família in around 15 mins & had plenty of shops & restaurants nearby.
I’d definitely recommend this place for a small group especially if you need private parking & don’t mind walking to the main tourist hotspots.
We didn’t want to leave this home! We felt right at home and our host was the best. A perfect stay with our four young kids.

Za tú cenu nemožno čakať Hilton, drobné nedostatky sa našli, provizórne opravené tesnenie vane a tesnenie chladničky, ale nič, čo by nás obmedzovalo. Pre rodiny super bývanie. V blízkosti park, obchody, kaviarne, zastávka metra a autobusov. Do centra je to 15 minút pešo, na pláž 20 minút metrom. Dve klimatizácie na celý apartmán sú málo, v spálni bolo v týchto horúčavách príliš teplo. Bolo to dané aj veľmi horúcimi nocami, vetranie nepomáhalo.
Veľmi oceňujeme dve samostatné kúpeľne s toaletou, práčku, umývačku, kávovar.
Pár drobností, na ktoré sme zvyknutí z našej domácnosti sme bez problému kúpili za málo peňazí v obchode vo vedľajšej ulici.

We had a wonderful stay! The flat is spacious, fully equipped, and perfect for a family. From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home.
The apartment had everything we could possibly need, including full-size toiletries, kitchen towels, and pantry essentials like salt, sugar, and oil. It's those little details that make a stay feel so much more comfortable. It truly felt like we were staying at a friend's home rather than a rental.
The directions and check-in instructions were also clear and accurate, making everything smooth and stress-free.
We would happily recommend this place to anyone visiting Barcelona and wouldn't hesitate to stay here again on our next trip!

Siamo stati una settimana in questo appartamento in 8 persone e ci siamo trovati benissimo. La vicinanza alla fermata degli autobus/metro sicuramente lo rende strategico. Vicinissimo al supermercato e fruttivendolo e a diversi locali dove poter cenare. L' appartamento era ben pulito, e completo di ogni cosa, forse l'unica cosa metterei qualche stoviglia in più, pentole, padelle. Ottimo appartamento lo consiglio.

Beautiful, comfortable, spacious! Great location and perfect for a family of 5😊
Oriol was especially helpful in helping us retrieve an item left behind.

todo fue perfecto, el lugar es muy cerca a parc Guell y a Sagrada Familia, solo caminando. El piso es eapectacular, limpio y amplifier. perfecto para una familia grande, los alrededores siempre encontramos lo necesario

We had only one full sized towel in the master bath and two small towels for the other bathroom. No wash clothes.
The beds were extremely uncomfortable. No padding and I could feel the springs. I used blankets to cover the mattress so I could sleep. Bring ear plugs as the large bed is on the street and very noisy. I booked here as it is close to Park Guell and Sagrada Familia.
Merkeze yakın konaklama için uygun bir bölge.

We were two families of four and we were quite comfortable. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. The neighbourhood is nice, with shops and restaurants nearby, five minutes from the underground.

We had a wonderful stay. Oriol is a great host, responsive and helpful throughout our visit. The apartment was clean, the beds were comfortable, and the location was both quiet and convenient, with easy access to public transport and the metro.
The kitchen was adequately equipped for our needs. However, it would be beneficial to renew some of the kitchen utensils, such as cooking spatulas, knives, and the cutting board.
The bathroom towels should also be replaced, as they had an unpleasant odor, and the shower curtains could use renewal as well.
Overall, we had a great experience and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We would gladly recommend this place to friends.

Conforme à la description

Η περιοχή ήταν σε καλό σημείο σε ότι αφορά το δίκτυο συγκοινωνιών. Το σπίτι ήταν άνετο και σχεδόν όπως στις φωτογραφίες, θα ήθελε λίγη περιποίηση ακόμα. Αυτό που σίγουρα πρέπει άμεσα να διορθωθεί είναι οι πετσέτες προσώπου και σώματος οι οποίες χρήζουν άμεσης αντικατάστασης διότι μυρίζουν πολύ άσχημα!!
Muy lindo departamento, cómodo.

Το σπίτι είναι όπως ακριβώς φαίνεται στις φωτογραφίες. Ήταν πολύ καθαρό και διέθετε όλο τον απαραίτητο εξοπλισμό χωρίς να λείπει κάτι.

Μπραβο Oriol για την φροντίδα του χώρου Κ τις κάθε λεπτομέρειας!!

Hola, todo perfecto... Muy buena ubicación, zona bastante buena...volvería sin dudarlo
Gracias

Sono stato con la mia famiglia in 5… alloggio molto comodo si può girare a piede in zona è tranquilla, bella, vicino ai mezzi in centro praticamente ma peccato che non abbia aria condizionata nelle due camere da letto ma soltanto in salotto… non si poteva dormire nelle camere da letto faceva caldissimo abbiamo dovuto portare i materassi in salotto per potere dormire per il resto tutto apposto…
A sido un lugar muy cómodo y agradable para pasar unos días visitando Barcelona 😊
Fantastyczna lokalizacja, blisko do miasta oraz komunikacji miejskiej. Sam apartament przestronny i schludny. Ogromnym atutem jest klimatyzacja. Serdecznie polecam!

Molto bello, carino e pulito.
Mycket rent och trivsamt boende. Bra läge nära tunnelbanan för att ta sig till olika sevärdheter. Trivdes mycket bra i boendet!

appartamento molto carino in una palazzina datata in zona tranquilla. Check in e check-out semplicissimi, molto pulito, biancheria da bagno presente.
La posizione è ottima,con la metro a 5 minuti a piedi e la avv.Diagonal a pochi passi. I padroni di casa rispondono velocemente se si fa loro qualche richiesta.

Great experience with Pere and this lovely flat. Host was super accommodating, very responsive. The flat was clean and appeared as in the pictures. Area is calm, near nice cafes, and very walkable. Would stay again, would recommend to other travelers. Thanks so much (:
In posizione comoda a tutti mezzi di trasporto, pulito e ordinato

Nous avons passé un bon séjour dans l'appartement de Pere. l'accès est sécurisé et facile grâce aux instructions claires reçues en avance.
l'appartement est grand , bien équipé, très propre. restaurant en bas de l'immeuble, accès bus et métro très proches aussi.
le seul point négatif pour nous mais qui n'a rien à voir avec l'hôte ce sont les nuisances sonores : la nuit les rues sont bruyantes et l'immeuble est mal isolé , on entends les voisins jusqu'à tard la nuit. il est connu que les espagnols sont des couches tard !

Loved our stay. Beautiful and very accessible location and a great neighbourhood if you enjoy good restaurants and boutique stores. The place had everything we needed and the host was very thoughtful and had prepared a city guide for us. I will definitely come back and will highly recommend this place if you want to enjoy Barcelona.
L'appartement de Pere est tres agreable et bien equipe. Le quartier est tres sympa avec de nombreux restaurants a proximite ainsi que tous commerces. Nous recommandons !
Le séjour s'est très bien passé ! Le Airbnb était parfaitement équipé et très bien situé. Rien à redire :)
Appartement très agréable, fonctionnel, bien décoré et tout à fait conforme à la description. Tout a été très simple!
Un piso ubicado en una zona excelente si lo que buscas es tener parques cerca, buenos restaurantes y hacer planes en familia. Muy bonita decoración y Pere y Eva muy amables también!
Very nice apartment! Everything is well prepared. Sofa bed is really comfortable and really good size. Eve helped us to store the luggage which is really helpful. Perfect stay, highly recommend!

Ottimo appartamento, comodo alla metro, presente in vari punti del quartiere. Ci sono supermercati, macelleria, fruttivendolo e forno/pasticceria comodissimi all'appartamento.

El anfintrion atento siempre, respuesta rapida entrada con facilidad, sin embargo creo que la tasa turística que cobran por persona deberia estar dentro del valor total del alquiler, dado que con mi familia nos tomo por sorpresa el coste adicional que debimos pagarle a javier.

Nous avons très bien été accueilli avec la possibilité d accéder au logement une heure avant .

Encarna and Javier were wonderful hosts—friendly, responsive, and easy to communicate with. The apartment is in a convenient location with good access to public transportation, shops, and restaurants. The check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow.
The only point that could be improved is the information about the tourist tax for minors. The instructions were a bit confusing regarding the cutoff age, as it was not clear whether the exemption applies to children under 14 or under 16( or 17?). Clarifying this would make the check-in process even smoother.
Overall, we had a very pleasant stay and would recommend this place to others visiting Barcelona.
Todo estuvo bien.

Host estremamente gentile e disponibile, ci ha fatto sentire a casa sin da subito; l'appartamento era estremamente pulito e ordinato, ben più spazioso di quanto ci aspettassimo. Anche il vicinato si è dimostrato accogliente e tranquillo e sicuramente risulta ottimale la vicinanza con una delle linee metropolitane che ci ha garantito spostamenti rapidi e a qualsiasi ora in tutte le aree della città.

la estancia fue genial, el apartamento muy bonito, cómodo y ordenado. ( todo tal cual la descripción).
la zona super tranquila y bonita .
los anfitriones fueron muy amables y estuvieron atentos a la llegada para brindarles la mejor atención.
lo recomiendo mucho.
La casa è in una località tranquilla,offre tutti i confort. Si trova vicino alla metro comoda per spostarsi e visitare Barcellona
Todo bien, razonable, dentro de los precios de una ciudad como barcelona.

Muy buena ubicación, lo único malo fue que el aire acondicionado estaba dañado, el agua empezó a salirse e inundar la habitación por este motivo no se pudo prender, así que pasamos la noche con un calor insoportable, te cobran una tarifa de €9,5 de una tarifa de turismo por persona y por noche (en la descripción del alojamiento indican q es de €4), me pareció una tarifa exagerada

Apartamento muy bonito, aseado, muy agradable y el anfitrión nos ayudó a ubicarnos en la ciudad, nos dió recomendaciones y siempre dispuesto a ayudarnos brindando información en todo momento con respuesta rápida a las consultas

Apartamento muy limpio y bien equipado. Encarna dio muchas facilidades para la entrada y la entrega de llaves. Respuestas rápidas y claras

Désagréablement surprise par la taxe de séjour de 9,50 euros par jour et par personne.
Próximo de restaurante, lojas e metrô. Tudo muito bom.
The cleaness and amenities of the place overally was good.

Buena ubicación, ofrecen varios servicios y son muy amables

It does feel like a home away from home.  Guests and staff were extremely friendly and considerate. Bed was utilitarian but remarkably comfortable and I slept well.  Awesome kitchen made it easy to save money preparing my own meals.  Guitar has new strings!  🥰
This is first time I stayed in a Hostel. But I'm happy I choose them. There always someone in the front desk. Very helpful and smiling. The location is great and safe. I would recommend them

très bon séjour, bel appartement spacieux au calme et bien positionné. Hôte très réactif. Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour.

We had a great stay at Kristjan & Ana’s Airbnb! The apartment is located in a quiet, residential neighbourhood in Barcelona, but there are some great restaurants nearby (La Gamba, Collonut). A big plus is the large terrace, perfect for eating outside or relaxing in the sun. It takes about 20 minutes by metro to reach the city centre. We would definitely recommend this apartment for your next stay in Barcelona!
Excellent! Would stay again a million times!!!!

Super séjour appartement spacieux bien situé proche métro et bus… Nous avons pu profiter de la belle terrasse. Merci à Maite pour l’accueil et les bons plans … je recommande les yeux fermés 😑 Nous reviendrons c’est sûr ☺️

Schöne moderne Wohnung in hervorragender Lage. Gute Betten, gute Ausstattung Große Tiefgarage, auch für große Autos geeignet mit Aufzug direkt zur Wohnung- alles sehr neu und komfortabel. el apartamento es muy bonito y acogedor.

Gemma and her father were very professional and pleasant to interact with. They gave clear instructions and responded in a timely manner. A few things need improvement to receive a higher rating: Hot water was intermittent. Most showers the 9 of us took were taken cold. We rented during a week when neighbors were doing constructions and there was constant loud banging and drilling against our walls. Most weekdays, the work started at 8am and woke us up. The apartment needs some light repairs. The railings down the stairs is wobbly and needs to be strengthened. Some tiles feel loose under our feet while going up or down the stairs. The best feature of the apartment was its convenient location very accessible with multiple public transportation options.
Ottima ospitalità e ottima struttura, esattamente come in foto, ogni stanza compresa di aria condizionata e ben pulita, lo consiglio vivamente!

Bardzo przyjemny nocleg w świetnej odległości od metra i stadionu. Spokojna okolica, fantastyczni i bardzo mili gospodarze. Apartament jest bardzo przestronny i dobrze wyposażony. Siedmioosobowa ekipa z dziećmi bardzo dziękuje za pobyt!

Very easy access and a comfortable unit for a stay in Barcelona. We were traveling with our two sons (6 and 9) and all fit comfortably. Easily walkable to the beach as well.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Wohnung und würden wiederkommen.

Great spot, we booked same day and Romina was very flexible and responsive!

Romina was very kind and responsive throughout our stay. The location is excellent, in a beautiful neighborhood with plenty nearby. The apartment was very well equipped and had everything we needed. Reibungsloser und unkomplizierter Check-in. Die Wohnung liegt direkt an der Metro, man kann zu Fuß oder auch mit den Öffentlichen schnell in die Altstadt kommen. Ideal für einen Städtetrip. Der Strand ist nur knapp 10 Min. fußläufig entfernt.

Our stay with Cristina was fantastic. The entire stay was smooth, comfortable and completely problem-free. It was also wonderful for my son to have Ian's company. Thank you, Cristina, for being such a gracious host. We would happily stay here again !
um local maravilhoso, a Cristina super atenciosa, com certeza eu voltando em Barcelona ficarei lá
Everything was easy and apartment was clean. Five stars to this airbnb apartment.

Кристина - замечательный человек, она очень гостеприимная, добрая. Старается помочь по любым вопросам, всегда на связи.

Хотела бы ещё добавить про очень удобное расположение. До ближайшей станции метро – L5 Virrei Amat несколько метров. До ближайшей станции линии L1 10 минут ходьбы. Это очень удобно!
Популярные супермаркеты Mercadona, Dia, Condis – всё рядом. Также рядом с домом: продуктовый рынок, магазины фруктов, прачечная и многое другое.
Если приезжаете с детьми, то вам будет интересны развлечения для детей. А их тут множество. Рядом с домом есть большая детская площадка, которая точно понравится ребёнку. Также рекомендую сходить в Parque de la Pegaso, там огромный игровой комплекс для детей любого возраста. И Parque de Can Dragó, там тоже найдёте детские комплексы. Оба в пешей доступности от дома Кристины.
Надеюсь, в ближайшее время снова приехать в Барселону и ещё раз остановиться у Кристины 😊 Ребёнок говорит, что будет очень скучать по Кристине и по ее сыну. Нам очень понравилось пребывание в этом доме! Спасибо за всё!

Nuestra estancia con Cristina fue una maravilla! El alojamiento es tal las fotos, el metro a 2 minutos andando es maravilloso, super bien conectado con el centro, orden y limpieza a la orden del día! It was a pleasure to stay in Cristina’s apartment. Highly recommend for booking. Cristina is very welcome and open person. She constantly answered to all our questions and was ready to help in every moment.)

Но мы попали на холодную погоду, я простыла и в квартире было для меня прохладно. Порадовала кровать, она широкая, удобная. И совсем не скрипит.Теплое большое одеяло, удобные подушки. I had a really good time, Cristina is a great host. She gave us a lot of tips and recommended a very nice restaurant :) I would definately come back!

Все было прекрасно. Кристина открытая и заботливая. По прилете сразу рассказала, как дешевле добраться из аэропорта до города и помогала практическими советами в течении всей поездки. Great place at perfect quiet location on metro line 5. Cristina is perfect host, she was always prepared with usefull informations and advices. I strongly recomend this room, we spent nice week in Barcelona.

Prenotazione per sei: abbiamo trovato una pentola per la pasta un pentolino per il latte. Piatti solo per la frutta. Cinque sedie.

L'appartamento si trova in un'ottima posizione, vicino alla metro e con tanti posti dove mangiare di sotto. Non siamo stati avvisati del fatto che la tassa di soggiorno fosse aumentata, l'abbiamo scoperto una volta di fronte alla reception. Per quanto riguarda l'interno dell'appartamento mancavano determinate cose: eravamo in 6 e non c'erano neanche 6 sedie per potersi sedere tutti insieme a tavola. Stesso discorso per piatti bicchieri e posate che abbiamo dovuto arrangiarci.  C'era solo una pentola enorme dove cuocere la pasta ma non c'era lo scolapasta. C'era la muffa nei bocchettoni dell'aria condizionata, e nella camera da letto piccola l'aria è sparata completamente in faccia ai due che dormono in quel letto matrimoniale, il che rende abbastanza difficile addormentarsi. Riguardo al resto, i bagni erano a posto, i letti erano comodi, la terrazza è bella grande per stendere i panni fuori e la cucina era dotata di lavatrice, microonde e macchina del caffè. Tutto sommato sufficiente
Mi sono trovato benissimo in questo appartamento. È pulito, accogliente e la posizione è ottima per esplorare la zona. Buona comunicazione con l'host. Consigliatissimo!

Muy fácil de llegar, el apartamento está muy cerca de estaciones del metro y en una zona muy tranquila, lo cual permite caminar y llegar rápidamente a la zona de playa, su ubicación también permite conseguir servicios de transporte con facilidad.

Non ci è stato comunicato l'aumento del prezzo della tassa di soggiorno. Inoltre servizi pessimi: abbiamo trovato solo 3 forchette, 4 sedie e piattini piccoli (quelli per le torte) ed eravamo in cinque.

Forchette, coltelli e piatti c’erano e in condizioni perfette. Purtroppo ci hanno dato solamente due asciugamani a testa e non li hanno mai cambiati. Non erano previste pulizie durante il soggiorno, però non ci è stato dato niente per pulire, non c’era neanche una scopa o un qualunque detergente (neanche per le mani) a parte il sapone per i piatti. Appena arrivati la casa era molto sporca per terra, pure gli specchi erano molto sporchi.

I bagni perdevano acqua e feci.
Buon alloggio. Posizione comoda. Non troppo rumore.

Some of the rooms had a strong musty, almost sewage like smell, and there was noticeable dust across the headboards. Overall, it definitely was not as clean as we expected.
Our biggest concern, however, was safety. There was no 24/7 security, and we frequently noticed people on the street watching us as we entered and exited the building. Coming back at night with my family, I definitely did not feel safe or comfortable.

Logement spacieux avec un grand balcon. L'appartement est propre et bien rangé. Il est fonctionnel et conforme aux photos. L'emplacement est parfait (près de deux stations de métro, ce qui permet de visiter Barcelone en transports en commun). Marta nous a laissé sa place de parking non loin du logement (voiture en sécurité, c'est un gros avantage).
Marta est réactive avant l'arrivée. Marta est accueillante et parle français. Je conseille ce logement. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour à Barcelone.

L’un des meilleurs logements dans lesquels il m’ait été donné de rester.
Le quartier est agréable, proche de toutes commodités, l’appartement sublime, calme et confortable, on pourrait y vivre à l’année…
Mon contact Sergio a été très amical, arrangeant et de bon conseil.
Je reviendrai dans cet appartement ou dans l’un des autres que propose En Ville, ils semblent tous être très agréables.
Our flight arrived early in the morning and Magali was very helpful with letting us leave our bags in the En Ville office until we could check-in. Super responsive hosts.

Positive Aspects
The property is a pleasant and cosy space, well-suited to comfortably accommodate a family of eight.
The hosts were exceptionally friendly, responsive, and accommodating. They were proactive in addressing all our queries and provided support whenever required.
The small bar located on the ground floor (managed by the same owners) is an excellent addition, offering a great ambiance and well-crafted drinks.
Areas for Improvement
Location: The property is situated in a relatively noisy neighbourhood, with disturbances from the adjacent premises even during late hours (as late as 2 AM). Additionally, the bedroom windows face a neighbouring house at a very close distance (less than two metres), which limits privacy and natural light.
Maintenance: The house would benefit from some general upkeep and maintenance to enhance the overall experience.

We had a lovely stay at En Ville. First day there we were met at the apartment by Magali who was very friendly,informative,helpful and answered any questions we had. First night there,we were left without electricity as the fuse box blew because of a faulty lamp in one of the bedrooms. Me being me I didn’t want to bother anyone as it was close to midnight. So I messaged the host first thing in the morning. Eduard called me immediately and sent the maintenance man around who confirmed the light was faulty. But this situation was dealt with quickly and efficiently. Starting our day was delayed a little as we needed to charge our phones etc. That is the only reason it lost one star. The rooms were lovely and beds were comfortable. Apartment was well equipped. We were given 3 sets of keys which was very handy as we could all return at different times and let ourselves in.
Plus point was having the AC unit. It was extremely hot while we were there, so popped in and out throughout the day.

Hello! It was a lovely stay. Great, big apartment, amazing host. She communicated instantly and was very helpful
We had an amazing time with her and the apartment. We loved it.

We had a family-girls trip and the apartment made us feel almost locals - it felt home away from home. Great location, Magali gave us all the instructions, recommendations and more - we couldn’t have chosen a better place to stay.
Can only recommend it!

Équipe très professionnelle.
Très bon emplacement.
Appartement en bon état.
Super appartement pour visiter Barcelone. Rapport qualité prix au top.

We had a great time staying at En Ville! The apartment was exactly as pictured with more than enough room for our group of five. Sergio met us to check us in, showed us around the apartment, and provided many local recommendations. There is an elevator, but it is up one flight of even stairs. The rest of the way up has fairly uneven and worn down stairs, if mobility is a concern. The beds were comfortable and bathrooms as expected, though like most showers in Europe it’s not fully enclosed. The air conditioning was wonderful to come back to after walking around Barcelona in the heat. Extremely walkable, the metro stop was just around the corner and La Rambla was a short walk from the apartment. I would highly recommend this unit for a group looking to stay in the heart of Barcelona.

We stayed in a four bedroom and three bathroom suite which was perfect for our large family. Great location. Easy access to metro and walkable. Air conditioning worked well in the July heat.

The apartment is in the heart of the Gothic quarter, just steps from the Jaume I subway. The bed is large and comfortable and even though there are window/doors on two walls, the old wooden window shades completely darkened the room. There was considerable street noise as garbage trucks seem to come every day, but ear plugs solved that. The balcony is tiny there is a delightful place to sit in the evening and watch the street activity. The kitchen is functional and the dining area quite small, but it is advertised as a studio and it was fine for the one meal a day that we ate there. The bathroom was comfortable and had everything we needed. All in all it was an excellent place to stay, in the heart of old Barcelona.

This was the perfect unit for our week stay in Barcelona! The walkability if the Gothic Quarter was exactly what we were hoping for, and it was an even greater convenience than we were anticipating.

A special mention must go to our host, Georgina, who was absolutely fabulous. She was incredibly efficient, helpful and attentive throughout our stay, making everything easy and stress-free. Communication was excellent and nothing was ever too much trouble.
We couldn’t have asked for a better Airbnb experience and would happily stay here again 🤩🥰

My brother, who is staying with me, checked in with his ID — I didn’t know I had to do it myself. I was fully willing to cooperate and provide my ID when asked, yet the host still accused me of “identity theft,” which is offensive and unacceptable. Second, on arrival I was given an apartment that looked different from what I booked, and the host even changed the photos in my reservation afterward, which is misleading. Third, I booked this place because the listing said a washing machine was available, but there wasn’t one — and the host changed the listing after my arrival to remove it. Overall, this experience was disrespectful, misleading, and deeply disappointing.

Nous avons passé 2 nuits dans cet immeuble composés de différents logements disponibles. Le quartier est sympathique et calme, bien desservi en transport en commun.. Notre appartement au 3ème étage (sur 4) était très convenable bien qu'un  peu décevant vu le tarif (nous ne connaissons pas plus que ça les prix sur Barcelone). Arrivant du Japon où tout était impeccable, ici l'endroit est propre mais un peu passé. Quelques traces sur les murs et surtout des portes qui craquent et frottent au sol (dilatation d'été peut-être...). La 2ème chambre est très étroite et une fois le lit coulissant sorti, il n'est plus possible de passer. Du coup ma fille a préféré le canapé lit et l'espace du salon. Pour le reste c'est bien ! La communication a été très bonne et les instructions d'arrivée claires. Il est possible d'avoir une arrivée anticipée mais elle est payante en supplément. Bref à notre avis c'est un logement très correct mais pas exceptionnel, par contre l'emplacement est vraiment pratique

La posizione dell'Hotel è eccellente, in quanto si trova in un quartiere centrale e tranquillo. Ottima anche la bakery, con prodotti di qualità. La biancheria era pulita, e il getto della doccia potente e piacevole, ma per il resto l'esperienza è stata deludente. La stanza era davvero troppo piccola. Non c'era un minimo punto d'appoggio che non fossero i comodini, e non c'era nemmeno una sedia; mancava anche lo scopino per il WC. Elementi basilari che ci si aspetterebbe di trovare in un albergo. Inoltre era molto sporca, si vedeva che non veniva pulita con attenzione da tempo per via della polvere depositata su molte superfici. La scarsa pulizia, riscontrata sia all'arrivo che durante il soggiorno, mi ha creato un grosso disagio, perchè la pulizia è la cosa più importante negli alloggi turistici e qui la carenza era davvero molto evidente. Oltre alla sporcizia, era tutto vecchio, trascurato e cadente. Il prezzo è davvero sproporzionato rispetto alle condizioni della struttura.

The balcony was also misleading. The old, deteriorating doors were difficult to open and took up almost all the available space, leaving barely a foot to stand in. Being on the top floor, it also felt quite unsafe.
Several basic amenities were missing, including drinking water, coffee and an iron, which I’d expect at this price.
The air conditioning was visibly full of dust and struggled to cool the room, meaning we had to leave it running day and night.
Finally, the sheets felt cheap and uncomfortable. I have mildly sensitive skin but rarely have issues when travelling, yet these noticeably irritated my skin.

Positiv hervorzuheben ist auf jeden Fall die Lage, die ist wirklich super und sehr praktisch.
Leider war es für uns als Familie ziemlich schwierig, weil es sehr laut war. Schon früh morgens begann der Lärm durch eine Baustelle direkt vor dem Haus. Zusätzlich ist die Wohnung sehr hellhörig, man hört viel von den Nachbarn, und abends gab es teilweise bis spät eine laute Geräuschkulisse (z. B. Musik/Schlagzeug von unten).
Auch der Check-in war etwas chaotisch organisiert. Er wurde an eine externe Person ausgelagert, die zudem zu spät kam, was die Ankunft unnötig stressig gemacht hat.
Der Zustand der Wohnung könnte ebenfalls verbessert werden, da einige Dinge bereits deutlich abgenutzt sind.
Für einen kurzen Aufenthalt ohne Kinder ist es vielleicht in Ordnung, aber mit Kindern war es für uns eher anstrengend
Si todo de acuerdo a lo contratado y ofrecido !
brilliant stay, thank you. would definitely return and recommend to others.

schöne Wohnung. die Zimmer waren in Wirklichkeit kleiner, als es auf den Bildern den Eindruck machte. Aber drei Schlafzimmer, dass beide Kinder ihr eigenes Zimmer haben, ist super.
gerne wieder.

Unseren Aufenthalt in Barcelona haben wir insgesamt sehr genossen. Der Austausch mit dem Gastgeber war durchweg freundlich und angenehm, was den Aufenthalt von Anfang an unkompliziert gemacht hat.
Die Wohnung ist genauso, wie auf den Bildern dargestellt: klein, aber für 4 Personen völlig ausreichend und zudem geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Auch die Lage war wie beschrieben. So konnten wir die Sagrada Familia einfach zu Fuß erreichen. Ebenso die Metro-Stationen, die nur wenige Minuten von der Wohnung entfernt sind.
Besonders schön fanden wir das kleine Willkommensgeschenk, über das wir uns sehr gefreut haben. Eine sehr nette Aufmerksamkeit.
Ein kleiner Kritikpunkt ist die Sauberkeit, die leider nicht ganz unseren Erwartungen entsprochen hat. Zudem gab es vor unserem Haus eine Baustelle, die zeitweise etwas störend war.
Insgesamt hatten wir aber eine schöne Zeit und einen angenehm Aufenthalt und bedanken uns herzlich dafür.

Marta and Raul were responsive hosts and quickly sent technicians when the toilet had issues. The apartment has a cute small kitchen and the washing machine was helpful. However, there is significant construction noise in the building starting around 7 AM — the walls would shake and even earplugs didn’t help much. There was also noticeable noise from neighbors. Until the construction is finished, we don’t feel the stay reflects the price.

Positives: ample space for four adults, good A/C, in unit combination washer/dryer, elevator
Negatives: en suite bathroom was noticeably moldy, there was a sticky substance on the kitchen floor upon arrival, floor throughout apartment was sandy/dirty upon arrival, bedsheets were scratchy.
Similar to other reviews, I felt this apartment met our basic needs but I would not describe it as luxurious.
Great location! Great communication would recommend to any. Lovely especially because of the lift

Wouldn’t recommend for families with little kids.

Sher gute Lage. Könnte etwas sauberer sein, beim Check-In haben wir die Schuhe ausgezogen es war noch spürbar Sand und Kies am Boden.

Alt i alt en rigtig god lejlighed med masser af plads og god lokation. Virkelig skønt med vaskemaskine/tørretumbler i lejligheden. Wifi var dog ikke vildt godt, men ellers er det svært at finde negative ting at sige om stedet
Amazing location within Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter. Great privacy, very walkable, and surrounded by everything you need. Highly recommend!

The apartment was as described and in a perfect location. We had even more space than expected and the place was fully stocked. We would definitely stay there again!! Thank you for a wonderful time.

Boendet var rent och hade ett bra läge nära både La Rambla och stranden, vilket gjorde det enkelt att ta sig runt och hitta aktiviteter.
Det som drar ner betyget var att dom var extremt strikta reglerna kring tysta timmar (även på helger) – man kunde knappt föra en vanlig konversation i normal samtalston utan att bli tillsagd både av värdarna och folk runt om ( till och med utanför dom närliggande barerna).
Det saknades också sopkvast och dammsugare, vilket gjorde det svårt att hålla rent från sand som lätt följde med in från stranden, trots att vi inte hade skor inomhus och moppade regelbundet.
Rekommenderar för barnfamiljer men inte kompisgäng.

Satisfactory stay, though I would not necessarily describe the unit as “luxury”- it’s pretty basic. The cold AC was a blessing, but I really struggled with noise from the neighbors- as other guests said, the doors to the units are extremely heavy and tend to get slammed often. Voices in the stairwell are loud. The upstairs neighbors sounded like they were moving furniture at 4am. The second bedroom is an attached lock-off unit, fine- but not the vibe we were hoping for. Location is in a gothic alleyway - lots of restaurants and stores to walk to, and very touristy- some people love that.
In summary, this unit was pretty clean and spacious and fitted our needs ok but was not the highlight of our trip.

The host was flexible and had someone meet us to let us into the apartment. We would definitely stay here again in the future.

The location was amazing and the restaurant selection was high quality. Loved that we could walk to the beach, marina and in the gothic quarter. Biggest perk is that it’s located 10 minutes away from the hot spots and metro stations so if you’re after somewhere for location over anything, this is a good option.

We really enjoyed our stay with Aspasios Garden. There was plenty of room for us as a family of 4, with a large living room including large dining table and front balcony, an efficiency kitchen with a dishwasher and laundry machine, one smaller bedroom with two single beds for the kids, and a large main bedroom with a rear patio. The kitchen stove has only 2 burners, though we preferred to eat out anyways so this wasn’t a problem. The bathroom is smallish but not unexpected for a big city. The space overall is very clean and modern, and comes with many amenities that you’ll need for your stay. Access is entirely self-service via entry codes, and we appreciated free use of the large lockers. The location is central and walkable to many restaurants, shops, and markets. We felt safe walking the neighborhood including at night. And the pool was a wonderful escape from the summer heat, set in a green garden in the building next door. The host was very responsive. We’d stay here again.

We also raised this with the front desk, as it was disappointing to have an ongoing maintenance issue that wasn’t addressed.
Aside from this, the staff were very friendly and helpful, and it was particularly useful to be able to leave our luggage before and after our stay.
Overall, we enjoyed the location and the space, but the property would benefit from better maintenance and more prompt attention to issues reported by guests.
100 x 100 recomendable. Volveré. Gracias

Apartment is large and fits a family 7. One room is on the smaller size with just a single bed in it and room just to drop a carry on in. The one washroom by the kitchen has a curtain around d the shower and is difficult to manoeuvre in and you can see all the water damage from the wear and tear of it. We could not get the second shower to heat up.
There was a constant rumble ( fan like ) that you could hear in two of the rooms. Wasn’t sure if it was coming from above.
Location isn’t bad just pampered on the first few days of our stay which was closer to the main quarters.
Het appartement is super ruim op een goede locatie. Leuke straat met leuke winkels en restaurantjes/cafes. Aardige mensen die in het appartementencomplex werken. Aanrader!

Très grand appartement, bien localisée.
La literie était très confortable.
L’appartement était bien propre.
Le seul petit inconvénient était vraiment le manque d’isolation, on entendait tout ce qui se passait autour de l’appartement.
Le quartier est assez safe est environ à 15/30min de transports des lieux touristiques.
En globalité, ce fut un très très bon séjour!
Nice area, the kitchen area has a funny smell but overall was smooth

Muy buen lugar para quedarse. Estuvimos poco tiempo. Y definitivamente vamos a regresar. Cerca de la estación de trenes, fácil checkin.

Me alojé junto con mi familia y nos gustó bastante. La estación del metro está justo a la salida y de allí nos pudimos mover muy fácil a todos los lugares. Cerca hay zonas de comidas, supermercado, farmacia, todo muy conveniente.
Caminando se llega a la fuente mágica, solo revisa qué día hay show en la fuente y vale la pena ir.
Una experiencia excepcional y muy  recomendable

Bel appartement, tout était très propre et rangé. La vue sur la ville est superbe du balcon. Deux petits points plus négatifs, nous n’avons pas été en mesure d’avoir de l’eau chaude dans la douche. Sinon, l’emplacement est bien mais nécessite de marcher assez longtemps pour se rendre vers le port ou prendre le métro qui lui, est vraiment très proche de l’appartement.
Buena ubicación, limpio, amplio y todo nuevo! Muy bien!!

His place is 100% exactly as described.
It was clean, private, convenient and modern. It has a Contemporary-Scandinavian interior with complete appliances.
Communication with him was great.
He's a responsive and friendly host.
We are very particular with security, and his place is well-secured.
The price was reasonable too.
The metro is literally one block away from the unit.
The grocery and bakeshops are also around the corner.
The space is actually bigger than the photos, so yeah, you get what you pay for.

We had a wonderful month at Tomas' apartment. The location is served by 2 metro lines and 5+ buses, which make it just 20 mins to the Casa Batlló. The apartment itself was well lit, spacious, well-equipped (see listed amenities; all were there). We were in winter, and it was warm inside, but there were 2 ACs as well. The Wi-Fi speed of 400 Mbps is more than enough for remote work (but there is no dedicated workspace other than the kitchen table). Overall, nothing to complain about. We would stay again!
Such a beautiful apartment, in an amazing area!
Отличная квартира , рекомендую .

De ruimte was enorm netjes, mooi uitgerust, modern. Alles was aanwezig in de Airbnb waardoor we alleen boodschappen voor eten hoefde te doen, wat een enorme luxe was!
Het contact met de host was ook enorm goed! Kregen meerdere keren de vraag hoe het verblijf was of hij kon helpen en erg snelle reacties, dus dit was enorm fijn!
De buurt was prima, schoon en veilig. Toch wel verder van het centrum dan verwacht.
Het enige: buitenkeuken & barbecue waren vermeldt in de advertentie. Er stond alleen een barbecue die kapot was. In de eerste week aangegeven, maar gehele verblijf van een maand niemand langs geweest om het op te lossen, wel vaker contact over gehad. We hadden deze Airbnb vooral gekozen om deze reden, dus waren hier wel teleurgesteld over.
Daarnaast verbleven wij een maand en hebben we in die tijd 3 kakkerlakken gevonden. Geen idee of het toevallig is door het warme weer of dat ze vaker problemen hebben (wel lag er al gif in de lades).

The apartment is well located in Maragall, in a real Barcelona suburb, it's convenient to shops and public transport. The apartment is comfortable with all the services you could need. The tourist sites and venues are easily accessible a short bus or metro ride away. We have stayed here twice, which must be a good recommendation!

Tomas es un excelente anfitrión, muy amigable y flexible.
El departamento está muy bien equipado y cómodo. Está bien para 1-2 personas.

We stayed a month at this beautiful apartment and were incredibly happy with everything!
The communication with Tómas was great and the apartment the best equipped Airbnb we have ever stayed at - and we have stayed at many. We directly felt at home and having floor heating was just wonderful (and so seldom to find in Barcelona even though apartments get really cold in winter). Also it was SUPER clean!
The bed and its linen were super comfortable, we loved the sofa and the fluffy towels and the towel warmer.
The kitchen is equipped with anything you could wish for and more (and a wine fridge!). Lots of closet space and having a washer/dryer combination was of great help for our long stay.
The apartment is super quiet and its location in a residential area with quick access to two metro lines really good.
We would stay anytime again at Tómas' apartment and can only highly recommend it!

Nuestra estadía en el ático fue maravillosa. Pasamos 45 días en el piso y siempre que necesitamos hablar con Tomás, él fue súper rápido y proactivo en atendernos. El piso está recién reformado y todo es nuevo y limpio, de buena calidad, además de ser muy bonito. Al abrir las ventanas, siempre hay buena luz y una excelente circulación de aire. Los ambientes son lindos y funcionales.
La cocina está equipada con todos los utensilios necesarios, y los electrodomésticos funcionan muy bien. El baño también está completo, con buenos productos, secador, etc. La ropa de cama y las toallas son de buena calidad y nuevas.
Nosotros no tuvimos ningún problema con las escaleras, pero si alguien tiene dificultades de accesibilidad, es importante tener en cuenta que no hay ascensor.
La ubicación es buena, con estaciones de metro y paradas de autobús cercanas. También hay mercados y restaurantes alrededor. La zona es tranquila y no hay ruido de vecinos ni de la calle.
Súper recomendamos el piso.

Tomás is een behulpzame host. Hij communiceert snel en duidelijk. Ook is hij erg behulpzaam en meedenkend. De ruimte is nog mooier dan op de foto’s. Ook de buitenruimte is erg ruim en fijn. De check-in verliep soepel. Het appartement ligt vlakbij een metrostation. Vanuit hier is alles goed te bereiken. Ik heb ruim een maand doorgebracht in het verblijf van Tomás, maar ik had absoluut langer willen blijven. Ik zou het dit verblijf absoluut opnieuw boeken!

All perfect, honestly. The apartment is good for 2 people, with all the amenities and more.
Also he helped us at the end with keeping the luggages for some hours on the terrace.
I recommend this place and it doesn’t cost too much seen the prices in Barcelona.

Tomas’s apartment is located in the Barcelona suburb of Maragall with easy access by efficient, public transport to the city’s attractions. The apartment is accurately shown in the online description and pictures; it was clean, spacious, with comfortable furnishings and a range of appliances. The neighbourhood has all the facilities you could want; including supermarkets, bakeries, restaurants, bars and general retail stores. While the apartment is on an upper floor without a lift, we, although in our mid 70s, found the stair access acceptable. Tomas contacted us periodically during our stay and was responsive to our needs without being intrusive. We had a very enjoyable stay there and recommend this apartment to anyone considering a short or extended stay in Barcelona.

We stayed a few weeks and it felt like home! Such a clean and comfortable spot. We both had to work and the wifi was great, and we loved having our morning coffee on the sunny terrace. Peaceful neighborhood but super convenient off two very central metro lines. He also provided local recs which we loved! Would definitely stay again.

Die Unterkunft ist wunderschön und mit allem ausgestattet, was man für einen Langzeitaufenthalt braucht. Mir hat während meiner 77 Nächte, die ich dort verbracht habe, nichts gefehlt. Die Wohnung ist in einem sehr ruhigen Viertel gelegen. In 15 - 20 Minuten ist man mit der Metro im Stadtzentrum. Tomás ist ein toller Gastgeber. Die Kommunikation war sehr gut und Tomás hat sich um alle meine Anliegen sehr schnell und zuverlässig gekümmert.
Ich habe nur zwei kleine Verbesserungsvorschläge. Zum einen könnte die Sauberkeit ein klein wenig besser sein. Und zum anderen hätte ich mir höherwertigere Küchenutensilien gewünscht (insbesondere schärfere Messer oder Töpfe und Pfannen, die die Wärme besser verteilen).
Dennoch würde ich die Unterkunft sofort wieder für einen längeren Aufenthalt in Barcelona buchen. Vielen Dank für die tolle Zeit in Deiner Unterkunft!

This is an incredible apartment that you didn’t want to leave! We felt very good, Thomas was always in touch and checked whether everything was fine with us and whether we needed anything else. I recommend it 1000%! If you return to Barcelona, ​​then only to Thomas
Enjoyed our stay! Beautiful and clean space, incredible location.

Très bon séjour, nous avons été très bien accueillis à notre arrivée. Le logement est vraiment agréable, le lit est très confortable et la grande terrasse est un vrai plus. Nous avons passé un très bon moment et nous reviendrons avec plaisir !
Great stay
Nice place, mostly very clean, and a great location
This is about the location, not the apartment. Las Ramblas is  going thru a lot of construction so it’s very dirty and noisy

I really enjoyed my stay here. The apartment was clean, spacious, and well-equipped, with a large balcony that was a great bonus. The host was very helpful, and I appreciated having a concierge available. The location is excellent—it’s very walkable and made it easy to explore the city. I think this is a great place to stay, especially if it’s your first time visiting Barcelona or if you’re traveling solo.
The location is the selling point here. the rooms are very nice, comfortable bed, very nicely laid out toilet. Plenty of room for two with privacy if needed
Un lugar muy bonito para descansar y muy ubicado para conocer

급하게 예약한 숙소였는데 정말 최고로 마음에 들었어요. 특히 어린 아이와 함께한다면 이보다 더 좋은 곳을 찾기 힘들거라고 생각해요. 모든 편의 사항들이 매우 편리했던 것은 기본이었고, 리셉션의 모든 분들이 항상 친절하고 필요한 경우 아주 적극적으로 도와주셨습니다. 방 자체도 매우 깨끗하고 아늑하며 예쁘기까지 했고요. 신시가지 쪽만 고집하다가 처음으로 올드타운 근처에서 지낸 것인데, 이 위치가 훨씬 더 좋았습니다. (근처에 있는 카페인 cafe local barcelona도 이 숙소가 완벽해지는 데에 한 몫을 했어요!) 그리고 꼭대기 층의 테라스도 여행 마지막 날 알게 된 것이 너무 아쉬울 정도로 좋았습니다. 다음에 바르셀로나에 또 방문하게 된다면 반드시 이 곳에 묵고 싶어요!
Clean, tidy, and easy to check in.  On the downside, it’s noisy at night due to its location on a busy street

Great location! We loved our stay here. It was perfect for us (me, my wife, and our daughter). Easy access to all major sites and the metro. We enjoyed a few drinks and meals in Plaza de Real and shopping along Carrer de Ferran. The Gothic Quarter and El Born areas were our favorites. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona.
Appart hotel in the lively center

Britt and Joan are incredibly friendly and accommodating, and Fluffy, their little dog, is an absolute angel! The area is quiet and welcoming. The room is simple but has everything you need. I really enjoyed my stay! Thanks again to both of you for everything! :)
Ambiente muy grato y la habitación es tal como aparece en las fotos. La vista que se tiene de Barcelona desde la terraza es excelente!

Nos encantó nuestra estancia en este alojamiento, todo fue perfecto gracias a nuestros anfitriones, personas increíbles, respetuosas, amigables y siempre dispuestas a colaborar sin invadir nuestros espacios. El lugar es impecable, cómodo y muy bien ubicado para nuestros intereses. Pero lo que realmente hizo que nuestra estancia fuera inolvidable fue la calidez y el cariño de Flufly, su mascota, que es tan cariñoso, juguetón y juicioso que se ganó nuestro corazón. Nos sentimos como en casa, gracias por hacer que nuestra experiencia fuera tan especial. Sin duda, volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí con gusto. ¡Excelente opción para cualquier viajero que busque un lugar acogedor y familiar! 😊
Such a sweet and helpful family and a quiet and comfy room. Just steps the metro and grocery stores and everything you could need. Loved spending time with fluffy as well :)
Very friendly and accommodating hosts!
Joan e Brit foram super amáveis e o quarto tem um tamanho ótimo! A região do ap é afastada das áreas mais turísticas, mas a estação de metrô próxima nos ajudou bastante.

Joan and Britt are a great host. Britt greeted us upon our arrival and welcomed us. We felt right at home. The walk to the train and bus station is just a 5 minute walk from the house. The view from the balcony of Barcelona city is magnificent. A great accommodation if you are coming to Barcelona!
Justo lo que necesitaba para mi estancia. Siempre me sentí segura y los anfitriones respetan mucho el espacio y la privacidad. Tuve una estancia muy agradable.
Joan and his wife were very welcoming and friendly! I would recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona!!

El apartamento estaba en una zona un poco apartada, pero muy cerca de las líneas de metro y autobús, con mercados cercanos. Los anfitriones fueron geniales, fue una estancia muy tranquila. La habitación es muy espaciosa, estuvimos muy cómodos. Y Fluffly es un amor, muy querido.
Thank you Joann and his beautiful wife for hosting me and my sister) Their place is lovely) We had a beautiful and clean room! We spent such a good days in this house ❤️

Friendly and welcoming host and very new ce dog who quickly made friends with ours. Clean room with access to kitchen and bath: all you need as a tourist to Barcelona. Near subway which takes you downtown in 20 minutes. Can be recommended!

Joan, su compañera "Bri" (así le llamaba yo), y la tierna Fluffy fueron muy amables y super atentos! me sentí como en  casita y re mil cómoda. Es un barrio super tranquilo y hay de todo cerca, incluso el metro! Definitivamente volvería con ellos por tan hermosa estadía. Gracies, gracies, gracies!!!

We were welcomed by very nice and helpful people. They speak English very well. The room is spacious and has everything you need. The neighborhood is charming and quiet. There are beautiful views from both the streets and the apartment’s terrace. The little dog is very cute. We enjoyed our stay. Thank you!
Very kind people with an adorable dog.
Joan fue muy amigable y flexible. Sin duda un buen lugar para quedarse.

Nous avons passé un excellent Séjour chez Joan. Son logement est très bien situé, sur la ligne L3 qui permet d'atteindre le centre de Barcelone en ligne directe. Joan est très accueillante, très discrète, nous a donné de bonnes recommandations et de bonnes instructions pour trouver son logement. Son chien est adorable. Et le logement était impeccable. Merci beaucoup !
I had a great time while staying at Joan's. Him and his wife are realy friendly, and will help you with anything you need. I absolutely recommend =)

We had a good stay it is super close to the metro. The guest lady and dog were very friendly
Would recommend!
Zimmer wie beschrieben, die Gastgeber waren sehr nett - zu empfehlen 😊
Excellent communication, looks like the pictures, was cool enough that I could sleep well without AC, close to the metro, has everything needed for a short stay
