L’appartamento si trova in una zona tranquilla e poco trafficata, nonostante questo comoda perché vicino a una fermata della metro e a diverse fermate autobus.
La stanza dispone di un piccolo frigorifero, armadio a due ante, due ventilatori e una grande finestra; il bagno privato, piccolo ma funzionale, disponeva di phon, bagnoschiuma e shampoo.
Grazie a Riccardo per l’ospitalità!
Muy lindo el lugar, aún mejor que en las fotos. Super limpio e impecable todo. Sin dudas lo recomiendo 😀

I had a great stay. A big thank you to Ricardo for being so accommodating throughout my visit. Communication was excellent from start to finish, making everything easy and stress free.
The location was good, with a metro station nearby for easy access to the city. It's also perfect if you don't want to stay right in the middle of the party area, as it's nice and quiet at night.
The room was clean, cozy, and comfortable. I would definitely recommend staying here and would happily book again

Al menos hay un lavabo antes de acceder a la zona del váter y la ducha.
Todo lo demás aceptable, espacio comunes muy agradables con buenas instalaciones y acomodaciones para relajarte.

Ostello pulito, ben collegato con le principali attrazioni di Barcellona.  Consigliato

Definitely coming back!

I wouldn’t say it’s not near things just most people go out downtown in different areas than here. Place is super nice & hostel is super clean. Has events each nice with a decent amount attended so super easy to meet people. Worth the buy imo. Train is close so worth saving the money if you wanna stay cheap!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean, comfortable, and easy to find. The location was perfect, within walking distance of everything we wanted to see and do while in Barcelona, which made exploring the city so convenient. We really enjoyed our stay and would 100% recommend this place to anyone visiting Barcelona!
Amazing location and even better than the photos inside. Very comfortable beds and a great shower, AC was nice and cold and everything was very clean. Would absolutely stay here again.

Absolutely wonderful stay! The condo was beautiful, spotless, comfortable, and in an amazing location with so much within walking distance. Check-in was incredibly smooth, and the hosts were so accommodating, allowing us to store our luggage early and even check in a little ahead of time.
The beds were very comfortable, there were plenty of extra towels and multiple keys for our group, and the kitchen was thoughtfully stocked with little extras like coffee, sugar, salt, and seasonings. Most importantly, we felt very safe and completely at ease throughout our stay.
One of the best city Airbnbs I’ve stayed in. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!

素晴らしい滞在でした。
連絡や質問をオンラインですると、常に迅速に正確な回答をもらえました。安心して予約から滞在まで進むことができました。また朝から深夜まで、建物の入口にスタッフがいてくれるので、いつでも質問できるし、ゴミ袋など必要なものを補充することができました。
部屋は新しく広く清潔でとても気持ちよく滞在できました。空調も機能していて、暑い日々の中で快適に過ごせました。
深夜の到着時にもスタッフが対応してくれましたし、早朝の出発に対しても適切に情報をくれコミュニケーションできて、完璧でした。
バルセロナを訪れる皆さんに推薦できる場所です。
Highly recommended place 👌🏽
Perfect voor stedentrip naar Barcelona.
We loved Carlos' apartment! It had everything we needed, the place was lovely and everyone at the front desk were very kind and helpful. Would definitely come back!

Had an issue upon check-in as my toilet had a small leak, that was taken care of the next day promptly. Besides that issue, the place was nice and clean. The walls are not that sound proof so you can hear next door neighbors noise and also upstairs noise for those who are sensitive to some noise at night time.

We enjoyed our weekend at Carlos' place.  The receptionists were excellent and very hospitable and helpful.  They were also in the office till 2 am and the building was very secure.  The only issue we had was that the patio is not the most private and upper units can look down onto the terrace and noise travels a lot in this building so we could hear echos of conversations from neighboring units and upper units and we could hear screeching furniture every morning from the unit above us which made it very hard to relax and sleep in later during our holiday. Other than that, the location was great and it is walkable to the metro and it is easy to access transportation as well. We enjoyed our stay.
とても綺麗で過ごしやすい家でした。従業員のみなさんもとても優しいです。アクセスもよく気に入りました。ありがとうございました。

Hôte très réactif et très accueillant. Le logement était propre. À proximité d’un métro donc tout se fait à pied à partir de l’appartement. Ils nous ont permis de ranger nos bagages durant la journée, un gros plus !

We had a great stay at Carlos’s apartment. The apartment itself was bright, airy and super clean. The reception area always smelt amazing! Great location, easy walking distance to Parc Güell and the Gràcia neighbourhood. We really enjoyed exploring the cool neighbourhood areas near the apartment.
Todo perfecto, el hospedaje impecable en todo sentido y el anfitrión súper amable y servicial. Lo recomiendo
Große, gute eingerichtete und saubere Wohnung. Gute Anbindung an den ÖPNV. Rezeption fast immer besetzt.
Everything was great! :)
Very nice apartment. Has everything that you would need during your stay in Barcelona. Short walk from park guell.
Great apartment in a great location

素敵な時間を過ごせました😍！

Carlos' place was fantastic! Great values, really comfortable beds The location could not be beat! Huge patio. The location was great, very close to anywhere you want to go on foot or by transit. I would definitely stay here again
Super recomendo

Vrlo cisto i uredno. Domacini su ljubazni , pristojni i stvarno susretljivi. Pomoc je uvijek tu kad zatreba. Stan je savrsen. Cijena odgovara kvalitetu pa cak i vise.
Lokacija je odlicna. Jako nam se svidio boravak i kada bi opet dosli u Barcelonu odabrali bi ovo mjesto. Pohvale.

Great stay and loved the independent apartment style. Rooms are clean, equipped with utensils and amenities. Located in a nice residential area, no loud noises from the street, although other residents can be heard earlier in the day (5am ish) when they depart/return. Otherwise enjoyed the stay and would recommend for small families.
Stedet var rent og pent! Alt var som beskrevet i annonsen. Perfekt sted for 3 personer. Fin takterasse!

Overall we were very pleased with the apartment and location. There are lots of cafes and restaurants nearby. Park Güell and Casa Vicens are also close by which were cool to check out
The metro station (Lesseps station) is just a few blocks away which made it super convenient to travel to attractions across the city. The Gràcia neighbourhood is about a 5-10 minute walk as well, which is a charming/cozy feel to the area
In terms of the host, we felt supported and had clear communication with them. The building itself felt secure and the apartment was clean. 5/5 stay, and would recommend to others if they are okay with staying in a less touristy side of the city, but still well connected

Nice and clean place. 2-3 mins walk to nearest metro station connecting to major attractions. If you like a stroll, nice straight 30-40 mins walk covering multiple Gaudi attractions, markets, and other historic architecture (cathedral etc). Nice cafes at a short walking distance. Overall, I would recommend this place.

Petit séjour pour mon premier voyage en solo, j’ai décidé d’aller visiter Barcelone et j’ai pu profiter de ce Airbnb qui correspondait totalement à mes attentes. L’appartement a été nickel. Je n’ai rien à dire la literie était confortable. Les autres étaient très agréable très sympathique et accueillant, je recommande à 100 %
Sehr freundliches Personal, immer hilfsbereit, tolle Wohnung wo alles in Ordnung war und wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder
I love the location and the apartment was very clean

这是我们第一次来巴塞罗那，这个历程非常棒因为这个住宿真的太棒了，Carols 非常的友好并且给了我们很多的额外帮助，我对于遇到Carols 感到非常荣幸，他像朋友一样对待我和家人！
我强烈推荐这个住宿，希望有机会再次合作。
This was a great stay. Responsive team and very clean space.

Tivemos uma ótima estadia em Barcelona! 😊 O alojamento estava muito limpo e bem cuidado, e a localização é excelente, perto das principais atrações turísticas. Para nós, não foi problema nenhum fazer cerca de 15 a 30 minutos a pé para chegar aos diferentes pontos de interesse, e até gostámos de conhecer a cidade assim.
O check-in foi muito rápido e toda a equipa foi extremamente atenciosa e prestável. No último dia, chegámos a pensar que tínhamos perdido a carteira e o senhor da receção, cujo nome infelizmente não me lembro, foi super atencioso, disponível e fez de tudo para nos ajudar. Foi um gesto que valorizámos muito! ❤️
Sem dúvida, uma experiência muito positiva. Recomendamos e voltaríamos a ficar aqui!

Wonderful place for a stay. Exactly as advertised and the manager was available most of the day and night if you needed anything. Free bag storage offered if you arrive or leave later and beautiful roof top to hang out on. Such a terrific place and close to the metro. Will be back! Thanks!

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt. Die Unterkunft war sauber, gemütlich und gut ausgestattet. Die Lage war ebenfalls super und die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber unkompliziert und freundlich. Insgesamt haben wir uns sehr wohlgefühlt und würden die Unterkunft jederzeit weiterempfehlen.

The apartment was clean/ tidy not over crowded and provided a lot of amenities which is great if you are staying a long time. Everyone was friendly the location was great as short walk into Gracia centre or the Lessepes metro. Would return or recommend to anyone, we had a very late check in due to delayed flight since we contacted Carlos he assured us that we would still be able to gain access to the property as he waited for our arrival, however due to our late check in the housekeeping team had not set up the property for three guests only one bedroom was set up meaning that Carlos tried to find the correct linens for us once we arrived after 2am the efforts were appreciated and the team rectified the issue early the next morning once we responded to there waiting message. Great time over all.
Отличные апартаменты , все очень чисто, уютно . Хороший вайфай , достаточно удобное местоположение . Оооочень приятный хозяин Карлос

Todo súper limpio y ordenado,el personal súper amable y disponible para cualquier necesidad además la ubicación era perfecta y súper tranquilo con muchos negocios y restaurantes cerca de la zona y también sobretodo porque estaba cerca de la estación de Metro que era súper cómoda para llegar hasta el centro de la ciudad.
Perfect verblijf, goede ligging superschoon. Heel mooi en iedereen was superbehulpzaam

Spacious, safe, quiet, clean apartment in the Gracia neighborhood of Barcelona. Off the tourist path but still a 20-30 minute subway ride or 15 minute drive away. It is a professionally managed building and subsequently requests a bit more from a guest than typical (for example, you get a pre-allocated amount of laundry detergent and take the trash out before you leave), but it's good value for the price point, especially in high-season.
Really nice stay, everything clean and very nice staff! Also great location to stay when in Barcelona.

This was my second stay at this apartment, and I was genuinely glad to be back ; that alone should tell you something !
The place is exactly as good as I remembered: clean, comfortable, and well thought out for a longer stay. Carlos and the team were friendly and responsive throughout, quick to help whenever I reached out.
The location is excellent : very easy walking distance to the city center, with the metro close by for anything further.
I'd happily book again, and recommend it without hesitation !
Todo bien y lugar muy bien comunicado
Heel goed!
Buena ubicación,  bien comunicado

We had a lovely stay here! The studio is cosy and thoughtfully designed, with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The location is great, close to all the essentials and with easy access to public transportation. The area is quiet and relaxed, which was perfect after a busy day exploring Barcelona. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back. Thanks for having us!

Great location, 20 mins to almost any major attractions by public transport. For a 4 day stay, we always used public transport.
Easy to communicate and very helpful host, surrounded by shops, restaurants and other amenities within 5 mins walk in any direction.
If I am picky, the only problem we had was that the studio flat was a bit small for us (party of 3 people). Once the bed it set up, hardly any place to move around.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour ! Le logement correspondait parfaitement à la description, il était propre et bien entretenu. Les hôtes étaient très réactifs et disponibles, ce qui a été très appréciable. Le métro est également à proximité, ce qui facilite beaucoup les déplacements.
Petit bémol : le quartier peut sembler un peu moins rassurant le soir, mais cela n’a pas empêché de passer un excellent séjour. Nous recommandons sans hésiter !

Soggiorno andato bene, la casa trovata come da descrizione, nessuna grande pecca, farei solo aggiustare/sostituire la porta che è un pò difettosa, per il resto tutto ottimo. La casa è molto piccola, ma come scritto nella descrizione e l’host è molto disponibile.
Hôte très réactif et emplacement à  3 mn de la station de métro

Uns hat der Aufenthalt in der Wohnung sehr gut gefallen. Die Wohnung war sauber und gemütlich.
Die Gegend war weniger touristisch, war für uns aber angenehmer. Zwei Minuten von der U-Bahn Station entfernt, hat man eine gute Verbindung zu den verschiedenen Orten der Stadt.
Exactly as advertised, hosts were excellent communicators and space was clean and located near metro into city.
Estudio funcional y conforme en el barrio muy agradable de Sant Andreu. El acceso desde el aeropuerto es directo y el metro está muy cerca. Una buena opción para evitar las multitudes.

An amazing and friendly host who was proactive and gave us very clear instructions and also additional information that was useful for our stay. Couldn’t ask for a better host!!! The apartment had everything we needed and it was really convenient to be able to visit Barcelona.

Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft. Bis auf wenige Kleinigkeiten im Badezimmer, war alles sehr sauber und ordentlich. Die Kommunikation war sehr zuvorkommend. Alle notwendigen Informationen standen direkt zur Verfügung. Die Lage war hervorragend. Sehr zentral und gut angebunden an die Öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel.
Für drei Personen und einen Kurztrip ausreichend!
The place was great and looks just like the pictures , the host was helpful  and very responsive 🙏🏻
Ha sido una experiencia fantástica. Todo acorde con la descripción y las expectativas descritas. Jordi y Aina unos anfitriones estupendos. Repetiría sin duda!
Très bien placé. L’appartement est très propre. Tout les premières nécessaires y sont à notre arrivée et cela est très pratique qu’on arrive tardivement.
Enjoyed our stay in this apartment, had all we need for 3 days. Close to metro, usually took 1 change to the center.  Supermarket is around the corner, bug fridge and equipped kitchen.

Logement très propre et très proche du métro pour visiter le centre de Barcelone dans les meilleures conditions. Petite attention à notre arrivée. Il ne manque rien au logement. Je recommande toutefois

Mi estadía en Blau fue muy cómoda, sin inconvenientes. El departamento tiene todo lo que se pueda necesitar, con bastante espacio de guardado. Matías en la recepción fue muy amable y atento. Lo recomiendo!

Excellent séjour ! Tout était vraiment au top. Le personnel est très accueillant, sympathique et disponible, ce qui rend l’expérience encore plus agréable.
La piscine et la salle de sport sont un véritable plus, surtout pour pouvoir se détendre après une journée de visite. L’hôtel est également très bien situé, à proximité de tout, dans un quartier agréable et rassurant.
Je reviendrai avec grand plaisir lors de mon prochain séjour ! Je recommande sans hésiter. 😊
Blau has an amazing facilities and community but you still have your own private space.
Nice, clean, and felt safe. Fun experience with Spanish classes :)
Ruhig gelegenes Wohnheim, die Mitarbeitenden sind super freundlich und es gibt kostenlosen Spanisch Unterricht und viele andere Aktivitäten, um Leute kennen zu lernen!

The amenities are great, particularly the gym, and the staff were lovely. However, I had issues with the room. There was no bedding when I arrived, and nobody with the authority to give me sheets after 11pm. The room had a motion sensor light that kept turning on during the night, despite there being no motion, and which I couldn't deactivate
Good lodgings. Poblenou is a nice part of Barcelona. Easy access to beach and other parts of city. All staff very welcoming.
War Top 👍

Really enjoyed my stay at this apartment. Only gripe was around the visiting hours for guests but I guess that comes with it not being a “standard” Airbnb. Enjoyed the Spanish lessons and would definitely look to staying here again next time I’m in Barcelona. Great value for money spent.
I had a great stay! The different options you got are very nice to have and you can come in contact if you want. The Service Crew was always helpful and friendly.
Great stay
Comfortable stay, friendly staff and great service.

Geweldig verblijf gehad in BLAU. Mooie studio, geen overlast van andere bewoners. Professionele en vlotte communicatie. Andere voorzieningen zoals zwembad, bar, studieruimte, koffiemachine zijn aanwezig.
Toeristische toppers en metrostation is een stukje wandelen, dat is het enige nadeel dat ik kan verzinnen.
Absolute aanrader!

Great stay at Blau. Well equipped gym and terrace with pool. My room was clean with very comfortable bed and useful amenities of fridge freezer and microwave. Used the laundry which was clean and functional. Front desk staff were friendly and helpful and helped me to plan my trips around town

Stayed for 4 weeks, met loads of people, Spanish classes with Sara were phenomenal. Poblenou is the best barrio in Barcelona, great restaurants, coffee shops and the beach (especially Nova de Mar Bella) in close proximity!
Muy lindo todo,
Excellent endroit ! Un peu petit mais ca fait l’affaire ! Tres accessible a velo ! Je recommande fortement

Nagyszerűen éreztem magam az itt töltött idő alatt! A recepción mindenki nagyon segítőkész és barátságos volt. Szuper, hogy volt ruha mosási lehetőség, tetőterasz medencével és egyéb interaktív és szórakoztató programokra lehetőség a szálláshelyen. Alig várom, hogy vissza jöjjek! Köszönöm szépen!
Very nice

Unite and its members were really friendly and helpful. Rooms were really clean. Guests were really easygoing and friendly.
Every room has own bathroom and wc. That is really positive. Maybe separating beds and baths with a thin curtain or smth should be considered because using baths can make too much noise for others is sleeping

I had a very pleasant stay at Unite Hostel Barcelona. The hostel is clean, modern and well located. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the facilities were good. The rooms were comfortable and I enjoyed my stay. I would recommend this hostel and would be happy to stay here again.

Its a nice Hostel near the beach. You can take the bus to go to the city. Always meeting new and kind people there.

We didn’t sleep at all 4 nights. Definitely not returning here. We asked for another room and they said they are full but on internet they were still so many options to book for our dates. The odor in the rooms is the worst.
Bien situé au bord de mer pour se poser après les visites facilement accessible métro...
Ottima posizione, ambiente amichevole. Prezzo buono.
Very good best hostel
It was really clean. Not a lot of space to put things in but overall good! And the lights in the mirrors + sink could be better
Very close to the beach and metro. Great staff.
I liked the placement of the hostel, near the beach and not too far from the subways,  don’t forget the towel and soap if you don’t know if there is.
Pulito e ospitale si trova in una zona tranquilla e conveniente

So beautiful, clean and safe.
It was my second time visiting and I will be back in November. The complimentary breakfast is a lovely touch

I arrived quite late so couldn’t really explore the location, but the hostel stood out. The instructions were so clear that it was easy to navigate around to find my room and bed! This is honestly one of the most beautiful hostels I have ever stayed in and I am already looking forward to be back soon! Also, amazing complimentary breakfast in the morning. The aesthetics are unmatched! Toooooooooooooooo goood!
The staffs are very helpful, the rooms are extremely clean. I’m happy to stay here and will definitely come back again.

I really liked this place. I didn't realize that it was called a boutique hotel at first so I had really low standards. However, I had an exceptional stay. It very aesthetically pleasing as well as cozy (the common areas as well as the bedrooms).

The owner has decorated every corner of the property with such great taste and attention to detail. Everything you could possibly need has been thoughtfully provided. The staff were incredibly friendly, helpful, and welcoming, making us feel right at home.
The entire place was spotless and beautifully maintained. The complimentary breakfast and thoughtful treats were wonderfully generous.
It’s truly a lovely place where you can feel at home, meet wonderful people, and create beautiful memories. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a warm, welcoming, and comfortable stay 😊❤️

Excellent pour voyager en solo mais aussi en couple et famille. La résidence est magnifique et tout est fonctionnel : acceuil , accès, décoration , propreté, calme, ambiance zen, cuisine parfaitement équipée et produits à disposition , espace communs... Bref un vrai coup de cœur car bon compromis en logement chez l'habitant et hotel.
L'emplacement est très pratique car très proche de la gare Barcelone Sants.
Quartier sympathique, typique espagnol (rue, ruelle, petite place et un immense centre commercial avec pleins de marques).
Mention spéciale pour l'accueil chaleureux de l'hôtesse !
좋습니다 ! 바셀에서 같은 돈으로 너무 저렴한 숙소에 묵는것 보다 나은것같아요. 여러명이 자는것외에는 호텔 수준의 청결도와 서비스를 제공합니다.
La verdad que el sitio es muy bonito, todo perfectamente ordenado y limpio. Ofrece muchas comodidades. Sin duda un lugar al que volvería y recomiendo

Everything was absolutely great, exactly as it was described in the pictures. The place is indeed a little far away from all of the tourist places, but the Les Corts metro station is literally around the corner! The AC was working, so no problem occurred. The terrace is very nice and adds a bit of privacy to the place!

This is the nicest hostel I’ve ever stayed in. Clean, safe, rules are clear. Felt like a peaceful haven during these hot few days in busy Barcelona and was easy to navigate to/from with Les Corts station nearby. It was important to me to stay in a hostel or hotel rather than someone’s personal  home given the current state of zoning standards in BCN, and Olivia was a great way to fulfill that initiative.

Definetely one of the better hostels I've been to. The place was spotless clean, the interior and amenities are new, modern and everything you need. The beds and breakfast are decent and locationwise it is easily accesible to the city centre and airport. The neigbourhood feels save even at night. The only thing I missed was a full lenght mirrow, but one can live without.
IMPORTANT NOTE: This hostel is womens only but I did notice couples with males and no children being guest and on my last day I was a bit shocked to see a group of six grown men without a female/ children attending them at the breakfast table. I wasn't able to ask the receptionist what that was about because she wasn't there. But it was a unpleasant surprice. Please beware that it seems like this place does accomodate men also without families!

Es waren tolle 4 Tage. Sehr ordentliche, hübsche Zimmer mit 3 weiteren Personen geteilt. In meinem Fall ein Frauenschlafsaal. Alle waren rücksichtsvoll und es war ein angenehmes zusammenleben. Zum Frühstück stand immer Brot, Obst, Müsli sowie Kaffee und frischer Orangensaft zur Verfügung. Es ist gemütlich und ruhig im Haus. Kann es sehr weiterempfehlen. Vielen Dank für alles :)
Ostello molto curato, ben studiato nell’’arredamento e negli spazi personali e condivisi. Ottima pulizia e comunicazione. Consigliato! Grazie!

İlk kez paylaşımlı bir odada kaldım, endişeliydim ancak Olivia'da oldukça memnun kaldım. Herşey anlatıldığı gibiydi, çarşaf ve havlular temizdi. Tekrar gelirsem konaklama için tercih ederim.

Olivia’s is a beautiful and serene place to stay. Everything is well thought out and beautifully arranged. It feels like home and it’s a nice place to meet nice people too. Will definitely come again on my next trip to Barcelona. Thank you.

This was my first hostel experience, and I was a bit skeptical about it. I have to say  this place exceed my expectations by far, it was clean, well organised and quiet. I was alone the first night and 2 girls joined me the next day. The place is spotless, the common areas too. Breakfast with eggs you can make for yourself is a good touch. I really enjoyed my stay, and it’s a few minutes walk to the metro station easy commute to central Barcelona.
